Since its release on March 7, 2024, with a retail price of $70, the adidas Yeezy Slide Dark Onyx has established itself as a must-have for sneaker enthusiasts and style mavens alike. Its release has been met with enthusiasm, solidifying its status as a timeless piece of casual footwear. title: Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025) (GS)
description:
The Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025) (GS) is a relaunch of the original Jordan 4 White Cement, designed by Tinker Hatfield and released in 1989. It features a simplistic Summit White base with accents in Fire Red, Tech Gray, and black.

When compared to previous Jordan 4 White Cement relaunches, this version most closely replicates the original shoe’s shape, albeit in a kid-friendly size. title: UGG Lowmel Sand (Women's)
description:
The UGG Lowmel Sand (Women's), in women’s sizes, is a lace up casual shoe with a booty or sneaker style silhouette, crafted from ballistic canvas mesh and soft suede.

American brand UGG's origin dates to Southern California in 1978. It was founded by Australian surfer Brian Smith and his partner Doug Jensen, who aimed to provide Americans with the comfortable sheepskin boots that had widely available in Australia. Since then, the brand has revolutionized comfort footwear styling, and has utilized renewable materials, such as rainwater-grown sugarcane instead of petroleum-based EVA. Sand and white plaid laces, made from recycled materials, add detail to the shoe's monochrome aesthetic. UGG branding appears on the tongue and outer heel.

Our experts feel that the best feature of the Lowmel is its lace up silhouette, which offers the versatility to be worn for the elements or just for style. The UGG Lowmel Sand (Women's) released on August 1, 2023, and retailed for $150.

The Ultra Boost 1.0 DNA Triple Black features a Primeknit upper that is both flexible and breathable, allowing for a snug fit that will keep your feet comfortable and supported no matter how long your run or workout. The shoe also features a Boost midsole, which offers energy return and cushioning, making it perfect for those who need protection from the impact of running, jumping, and other high-intensity activities. The shoe's Continental rubber outsole provides traction on both wet and dry surfaces, giving you the confidence to tackle any terrain with ease.

We think that the standout feature of the adidas Ultra Boost 1.0 DNA Triple Black is its sleek design. The use of black on black gives the shoe a clean and minimalist look that is both stylish and understated. The shoe was released on November 30th, 2022 at a retail price of $200.

title: Fear of God Essentials Nylon Fleece Hoodie Jet Black/Jet Black
description:
The Fear of God Essentials Nylon Fleece Hoodie in Jet Black/Jet Black is a premium streetwear staple that combines style and comfort. This hoodie features a sleek nylon exterior paired with a soft fleece interior, offering both durability and warmth. The monochromatic jet black colorway ensures versatility, making it easy to incorporate into various outfits for a modern, urban look.

Designed as part of the SS24 collection, this hoodie showcases Fear of God's commitment to quality and attention to detail. It likely includes signature Essentials branding, a kangaroo pocket for convenience, and a drawstring hood for adjustable coverage. The nylon-fleece blend creates a unique texture and appearance, setting it apart from traditional cotton hoodies while maintaining the comfort expected from the Essentials line.

Our experts state this product is great for those seeking a high-end, versatile piece that can transition seamlessly from casual outings to more stylish occasions. The combination of nylon and fleece makes it an ideal choice for layering in various weather conditions.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Cozy Girl (Women's)
description:
Air Jordan 4 Retro Cozy Girl Womens softens one of Jordan Brand’s most aggressive silhouettes through texture and tone rather than changing its DNA. The Cozy Girl concept leans into comfort and warmth, giving the Air Jordan 4 a more lifestyle focused personality while keeping its iconic shape intact. It feels approachable and confident, designed for everyday wear rather than spectacle.

Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it reinterprets the Jordan 4 in a way that feels natural and wearable. The familiar structure anchors the design, while the cozy elements add freshness and depth. It appeals to fans who enjoy seeing heritage models evolve with subtle creativity rather than dramatic reinvention.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro Cozy Girl Womens was released on 11/01/2025 with a retail price of $220.

title: Jordan 12 Retro Taxi (2025) (GS)
description:
Air Jordan 12 Retro Taxi 2025 GS brings back one of the most iconic Jordan 12 colorways in a form that stays true to its legacy while welcoming a new generation. The Taxi color blocking has always been about contrast and confidence, and it continues to highlight the Jordan 12’s premium structure and performance driven roots. Even in grade school sizing, the shoe carries the same authority and timeless appeal as the original release.

Collectors appreciate this pair because it represents consistency and heritage. The Air Jordan 12’s radiating stitch lines and clean construction feel just as powerful decades later, proving that strong design never fades. It feels like a foundational Jordan release, celebrated not for novelty but for its lasting place in sneaker history.

The Air Jordan 12 Retro Taxi 2025 GS was released on 11/08/2025 with a retail price of $165.

title: adidas Ultra Boost 1.0 DNA Triple White
description:
The adidas Ultra Boost 1.0 DNA Triple White takes on a monochromatic design, dressed in Cloud White from heel to toe, featuring adidas signature technologies, including PRIMEKNIT and Boost.

The Triple White adidas Ultra Boost 1.0 DNA upper is made of PRIMEKNIT material, which gives it a lightweight and breathable feel. The midsole features adidas’ Boost technology, ensuring support and comfort. Underfoot, the Stretchweb outsole flexes naturally, while the Continental™ rubber outsole provides traction and grip. For brand recognition, the sneaker features the iconic 3-Stripes on the lateral and medial sides, with an adidas logo on the tongue tag. With a lace closure for a secure fit, this shoe provides both comfort and an eco-conscious design.

What stands out in the adidas Ultra Boost 1.0 DNA Triple White is its commitment to sustainability, as its upper incorporates a high-performance yarn made from at least 50% Parley Ocean Plastic, repurposed from plastic waste intercepted in remote coastal areas and shorelines, preventing ocean pollution. The remaining 50% of the yarn is recycled polyester. The shoe was released on January 1st, 2023, for $200.

title: Salomon XT-6 Earth Brown Walnut
description:
The Salomon XT 6 Earth Brown Walnut embraces earthy tones across one of the most recognizable trail silhouettes in modern rotation. Earth Brown and Walnut flow across the upper, complemented by subtle Footwear Silver accents that highlight the technical framework. The streamlined shape and Quicklace system preserve the XT 6 signature identity.

The XT 6 has become a staple in both trail communities and streetwear circles, appreciated for its durability and bold design lines. Earth toned executions feel especially fitting for a model rooted in outdoor performance. For fans who gravitate toward grounded palettes with technical credibility, this release strikes the right balance between rugged function and everyday wearability.

The Salomon XT 6 Earth Brown Walnut was released on January 15, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

title: Jordan 5 Retro OG Black Metallic Reimagined
description:
The Air Jordan 5 Retro OG Black Metallic Reimagined pays homage to one of Jordan Brand’s most iconic designs, first debuted in 1990. This updated version reimagines the timeless sneaker with subtle yet impactful modern tweaks, staying true to its legendary roots. Featuring a sleek black nubuck upper, reflective metallic silver tongues, and bold fire red accents on the Jumpman logo, this sneaker effortlessly blends heritage with innovation.

Every detail has been carefully crafted to elevate its legacy. The 3M reflective tongue and metallic silver shark teeth on the midsole add depth and dimension, while translucent netting and a visible Air unit in the heel enhance both style and comfort. Beloved touches like the "Nike Air" branding on the heel and upside-down "Air Jordan" text inside the tongue provide nostalgic nods to the original design while keeping the sneaker relevant.

Released on February 8, 2025,the Air Jordan 5 Black Metallic Reimagined retailed for $210. This version marks the 35th anniversary of the silhouette and is part of Jordan Brand’s highly anticipated Reimagined lineup, giving both longtime fans and newcomers a fresh reason to celebrate.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver Pink (Women's)
description:
The ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver Pink (Women's) gives the Gel-1130 a contemporary upgrade with a colorway of Pure Silver and light pink.

Drawing design inspiration from version nine of the Gel-1000 series and the Gel-Kayano 14, the Gel-1130 was initially launched in 2008. The "White Pure Silver Pink" colorway repurposes genuine leather overlays with synthetic leather for a more durable finish. The white mesh upper is lightweight and serves as a backdrop for the Pure Silver and pink overlays. Padding in the collar and the gel technology in the heel contribute to the sneaker’s slightly bulky, technical silhouette, while the front lace closure provides a secure fit.

Our experts like the combination of pink, Pure Silver, black, and white colors on the rubber outsole because they complement the hues on the upper. The women’s size ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver Pink (Women's) was originally released on June 1, 2024, and sold for $95.

title: ASICS GEL-Kayano 14 Cream Sweet Pink
description:
The ASICS GEL-Kayano 14 Cream Sweet Pink is a technical running sneaker boasting metallic silver and Sweet Pink accents.

While the Cream Sweet Pink ASICS GEL-Kayano 14’s mesh construction, including the web of faux-leather overlays and mesh underlays, pays homage to GEL-Kayano models from the early 2000s, the use of shiny metallic silver gives the sneaker a futuristic upgrade. In addition, Sweet Pink accents add pops of color on the midsole pods, the ASICS branding, and the rubber outsole. Toshikazu Kayano didn’t design this version of the GEL-Kayano; however, the shoe still maintains its iconic layered construction and GEL technology underfoot. This cushioning system provides advanced shock absorption without weighing down the foot.

Our experts at StockX appreciate the sneaker’s sustainable features, including the sockliner, which is crafted using a dyeing process that reduces water consumption by 33 percent and carbon emissions by 45 percent. The ASICS GEL-Kayano 14 Cream Sweet Pink was released on May 1, 2024, and retailed at $150.

title: Jordan 14 Retro Ferrari (2025)
description:
The Jordan 14 Retro Ferrari (2025) races back into the spotlight, dripping in sleek, performance-inspired design. Dressed in challenge red suede with black and vibrant yellow accents, this pair doesn’t whisper, it’s got that supercar growl. The build is aerodynamic bold, echoing the lines of a Ferrari with Jordan’s basketball legacy riding shotgun.

Carbon fiber detailing and that iconic chrome shank plate keep things aggressive, while the Jumpman shield on the collar adds a subtle nod to Italian speed. The suede upper hugs the shoe in one solid piece, giving it the same seamless precision you’d expect. Whether you’re stomping pavement or flexing in a fit pic, these deliver serious horsepower. The Jordan 14 Ferrari (2025) Dropped on June 11, 2025, and hit shelves at $215, dressed in challenge red, black, vibrant yellow, and anthracite. If you missed the original, this re-release gives you another chance to drive the heat.

title: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Reverse Grinch
description:
Step into the future while honoring a legend with the Nike Kobe 6 Protro Reverse Grinch. This long-awaited sneaker, flips the script on the iconic Grinch colorway. Boasting a Bright Crimson upper that mirrors the intensity of Kobe's game, this shoe is a standout piece in any collection. The snakeskin-textured upper, a nod to the Black Mamba himself, is complemented by black Swooshes and electrifying Electric Green accents.

The Reverse Grinch doesn't just turn heads with its colorway; it pays homage to Kobe Bryant's enduring legacy. Electric Green laces and Kobe branding on the tongues and heels add to its unique charm. The midsole and heel counter, wrapped in Bright Crimson, maintain the shoe’s bold and cohesive look, ensuring it stands out on the court and in the streets.

Set to release on December 16, 2023, for $190, the Nike Kobe 6 Protro Reverse Grinch is more than a sneaker—it's a tribute to a basketball icon. With its vivid colors and sleek design, it's a must-have for sneakerheads and basketball fans alike.

title: Nike Air Griffey Max 1 Freshwater (2021/2025)
description:
Designed for former MLB player Ken Griffey Jr, the Nike Air Griffey Max 1 Freshwater (2021/2025) is a retro-inspired sneaker from the Air Griffey Max 1 pack in a ‘Freshwater’ colorway.

This sneaker features an upper made of a synthetic Freshwater base with black nubuck overlays, ankle straps, heel pull tabs, and tongue. White accents appear on the laces, Griffey’s jersey number "24" on the ankle straps, forefoot Swooshes, and the Nike checks on the heel and tongue. The heel Swoosh features Bold Red stitching. Rounding out the design is a black chunky sole unit with white pods throughout the midsole. 

The Nike Air Griffey Max 1 Freshwater (2021/2025) was released on August 1, 2021 for a retail price of $170.

title: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro Michael Jackson Moonwalker (2025)
description:
The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro "Moonwalker" (2025) channels performance and pop-culture energy in equal measure. Draped in hyper grape, white and cave purple, the Flyknit upper commands attention and the metallic silver Swoosh glints like stage lights on the King of Pop. A low-cut collar keeps things sleek, while the black and purple midsole bridges court-ready tech with bold aesthetic.

On the technical side, the "Moonwalker" edition doesn’t play it safe: it’s upgraded with React foam cushioning, a carbon-fiber plate for stability, and a translucent outsole embedding a moonrock graphic, a subtle nod to the legendary moonwalk. Every element works to deliver both story and serious performance.

When the Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro "Moonwalker" dropped, it retailed for $220 and arrived on October 30, 2025. It’s one of those releases where pop culture and innovation meet—a court-ready silhouette that doubles as a standout piece in any rotation.

title: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Silver Off White
description:
The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 drops in a striking Silver/Off White palette, seamlessly merging vintage vibes with contemporary fashion.

At the forefront of the sneaker game, this classic silhouette has reinvented itself once again. Featuring leather craftsmanship, the shimmering silver upper is complemented beautifully by muted off-white highlights, and an off white midsole making it an instant head-turner. But it isn't just about aesthetics; the Mexico 66 is a statement piece with a history. When you lace up, you're not only joining the fashion-forward crowd but also honoring the iconic legacy of Onitsuka Tiger.

This trendsetting blends classic old-school charm with modern flair. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 in Silver/Off White was available at an initial retail price of $120.

title: Fear of God Essentials Fleece Hoodie (FW24) Heather Gray
description:
The Fear of God Essentials Fleece Hoodie (FW24) in Heather Gray is a premium streetwear staple that combines comfort and style. Crafted from high-quality fleece material, this hoodie offers warmth and softness for everyday wear. The heather gray colorway provides a versatile look that easily pairs with various outfits, making it a go-to piece for any casual ensemble.

Designed as part of the Fall/Winter 2024 collection, this hoodie features the signature Essentials aesthetic that Fear of God is known for. With its relaxed fit and minimalist design, it embodies the brand's commitment to elevated basics. The hoodie likely includes practical elements such as a kangaroo pocket and adjustable drawstring hood, enhancing its functionality and appeal.

Our team thinks this product is great for those seeking a high-quality, comfortable hoodie that effortlessly elevates their streetwear style. Its versatility and timeless design make it a valuable addition to any wardrobe.

description:

The chestnut colorway feels warm and familiar, reinforcing the Tasman II’s reputation as a dependable everyday staple. It captures UGG’s ability to make relaxation feel intentional and stylish rather than purely functional.

What draws collectors and casual wearers alike is how seamlessly the Tasman II fits into daily life. The structured shape offers a sense of purpose, while the cozy feel keeps it rooted in comfort. It feels like a piece people return to again and again, valued for consistency, warmth, and understated design that never feels forced or outdated.

The UGG Tasman II Slipper Chestnut Womens was released on 02/28/2025 with a retail price of $120.

title: Nike Air Max Plus White
description:
The Nike Air Max Plus White is a versatile shoe, ideal for everyday use and an active lifestyle. There is air cushioning on the heels and forefront, allowing for full-length cushion and support. The ankles are also well-supported. The wavy design lines are complemented with the plastic accents and breathable mesh on the upper of the shoe. The shoe also features colored air pods to provide a touch of contrast, and the all-white color of the Nike Air Plus White gives it a clean look.

The Nike Air Max Plus White was released in January of 2019 for $150.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air (GS)
description:
The Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air (GS) brings an iconic hoops silhouette to growing sneaker rotations with a bold mix of Black, Fire Red, Deep Royal Blue, Dark Smoke Grey, and Tech Grey. Classic AJ4 cues, like the breathable grid mesh, molded lace wings, and a secure mid-cut profile, deliver support from school days to weekend adventures. Underfoot, the visible Air unit cushions every step, while a sturdy foam midsole and herringbone-pattern rubber outsole provide reliable traction on sidewalks and courts alike. The "Rare Air" detailing nods to heritage style, pairing premium textures with sharp color blocking for a look that’s easy to dress up or down. 

Thoughtfully built for grade school sizing, this Jordan 4 balances durability and comfort with a padded collar, a snug lace system, and a structured heel tab for easy on-and-off. The IB4171-003 style code underscores its place in the Jordan lineage, and the eye-catching palette stands out without sacrificing versatility. Whether they’re lacing up for a big day or grabbing a statement pair for everyday wear, this release captures the timeless energy of the Air Jordan 4 with kid-ready comfort and stability. Scheduled for a July 26, 2025 release, it’s a head-turning essential for any young sneaker fan.

Our team thinks this product is great for delivering everyday comfort and standout style in a durable, kid-friendly package that celebrates classic Jordan design.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Cave Stone (GS)
description:
Air Jordan 4 Retro Cave Stone GS brings an earthy and grounded tone to one of Jordan Brand’s most iconic silhouettes. The Cave Stone colorway emphasizes texture and depth, giving the Air Jordan 4 a mature and composed look that feels timeless rather than trend driven. In grade school sizing, the shoe still carries the same strength and identity as the adult versions.

Collectors gravitate toward this release because of its versatility and balance. The muted palette allows the classic Jordan 4 details to stand out naturally, from the mesh panels to the wing eyelets. It feels like a colorway designed to age gracefully, appealing to fans who appreciate subtle reinterpretations of heritage silhouettes.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro Cave Stone GS was released on 09/06/2025 with a retail price of $160.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 White (Women's)
description:
The women's Nike Air Force 1 Low White silhouette (W) continues the tradition of the 1982 Air Force 1. The sneaker features an all-white leather upper with a perforated toe box and Swoosh overlays. A Nike heel embroidery and white sole completes the design.

The women's Nike Air Force 1 Low White 2018 (W) released in January 2018 and retailed for $90. The retail price was increased to $115 in 2023.

title: Nike GT Future Metallic Red Bronze
description:
The Nike GT Future Metallic Red Bronze elevates the futuristic silhouette with a shimmering Metallic Red Bronze finish that catches light from every angle. Black detailing provides contrast, sharpening the layered construction beneath the glossy surface. The streamlined build keeps the focus on performance while the finish adds undeniable flair.

Metallic executions often amplify a shoe presence, and this version of the GT Future feels especially bold. The bronze inspired tone gives it a slightly luxurious edge while still maintaining aggressive court ready energy. For collectors who appreciate standout finishes on modern basketball models, this release blends innovation with eye catching detail.

The Nike GT Future Metallic Red Bronze was released on February 20, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

title: Nike Ja 3 Max Volume
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Max Volume turns heads on and off the court with a high-energy palette of Hyper Pink, Mint Foam, Black, and Viotech. Designed for quick guards and explosive slashes to the rim, this men’s basketball shoe pairs a lightweight, breathable upper with supportive overlays that keep your foot locked in through hard cuts and step-backs. A plush, responsive midsole helps soften landings and spring you into your next move, while the padded collar and sculpted heel provide a secure, comfortable fit for full-court runs. Underfoot, its grippy outsole pattern is engineered to bite on fast stops and sudden changes of direction, giving you confident traction from tip-off to clutch time.

Style codes HF2793-600 / HF2794-600 and the bold "Max Volume" treatment make this Nike Ja 3 a standout addition to your rotation. Thoughtful details, like durable toe reinforcement, strategic ventilation zones, and a streamlined profile, balance performance with everyday wearability. Whether you’re chasing buckets at the park or pairing them with streetwear, the color-blocking amplifies every fit, while the performance build keeps pace with the game’s most dynamic playstyles. If you’re searching for a modern basketball sneaker that blends stability, cushioning, and unmistakable flair, the Nike Ja 3 Max Volume delivers.

Our team loves this product because it fuses fast-feel support, lively cushioning, and a statement colorway that energizes every step.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Thunder (2023)
description:
For the first time in over a decade, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Thunder is returning and is being featured as part of the Jordan Brand Spring/Summer 2023 campaign.

Jordan Brand brought back this fan favorite colorway that is constructed using premium black nubuck uppers with splashes of Tour Yellow throughout the midsole, lace eyelets, and tongue. Michael Jordan's iconic Jumpman logo is placed on the heel tab, tongue and insoles of the sneakers.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro Thunder (2023) released May 13, 2023, with a retail price of $210.

title: On Running Cloudtilt Black Ivory
description:
The On Running Cloudtilt Black Ivory is a full-suspension performance shoe that has become renowned for its comfort and cushioning. 
       
This version of the On Running Cloudtilt is made with a recycled polyester upper in Black and Ivory. The shoes have a bit of an ombre look, with the black dots more concentrated near the laces and top of the shoe and fading into more of an Ivory color near the bottom of the upper. The toe box takes on a different knit pattern and contains an On logo on the lateral side in black. The On logo also appears on each side of the shoe and again on the lateral side of the heel and on the tongue. A red Swiss flag patch and the words Swiss Engineering appear in silver also on the lateral heel. It also has a lightweight, smooth midsole for perfect cushioning as well as speed laces. 

The Helion superfoam provides extra cushioning and energy return during movement. The On Running Cloudtilt Black Ivory was released on February 20, 2024, for $160.

title: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Metallic Silver (Women's)
description:
The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Metallic Silver (W) comes in a Photon Dust, Chrome, Gridiron, and Sail color palette.

The Photon Dust Metallic Silver Nike Zoom Vomero 5 (W) features an upper made from breathable fabric, allowing for breathability and comfort. The shoe features Nike's Zoom Air cushioning technology, which provides responsive, energy-returning cushioning. The shoe also features a cushioned and supportive midsole made of soft foam. The sneaker has a TPU heel clip that provides stability and reduces the risk of slipping. The shoe's durable rubber outsole has a waffle pattern for traction. The shoe features a Nike Swoosh on the lateral sides, a "NIKE VOMERO 5" inscription on the tongue, and a small Swoosh on the heel.

The women’s rendition of the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Metallic Silver (W) was released on March 1, 2023, and initially retailed for $160.

title: Jordan 4 Retro SP A Ma Maniére Dark Mocha
description:
Air Jordan 4 Retro SP A Ma Maniere Dark Mocha continues A Ma Maniere’s refined approach to collaboration by reimagining the Air Jordan 4 through tone, texture, and emotion. The dark mocha palette gives the silhouette a grounded and luxurious feel, shifting the Jordan 4 away from aggression and toward elegance. It feels thoughtful and composed, designed to be appreciated slowly rather than shouted from across the room.

Collectors value this release because it balances storytelling and wearability so effortlessly. The familiar Jordan 4 structure anchors the design, while A Ma Maniere’s influence adds depth and maturity. It stands as another example of how collaboration can elevate a classic by respecting its history while giving it new emotional weight and purpose.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro SP A Ma Maniere Dark Mocha was released on 12/23/2025with a retail price of $230.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Red Cement
description:
Unveiled on September 9, 2023, the Jordan 4 Retro Red Cement sees a unique twist on a classic colorway with touches of fire red added throughout the silhouette. Jordan Brand didn't hold back on this release, delivering a bold statement piece for those unafraid to stand out.

Constructed with white premium leather uppers, a mix of fire red and black is applied throughout, while the iconic mesh detailing and Jumpman logo retain their traditional placements. Sat atop a black, white, and fire red midsole, the style stays true to its roots, showcasing why the Jordan 4 model remains one of the most iconic Jordan models of all time.

The Jordan 4 Retro Red Cement released on September 9, 2023, with a retail tag of $210, adding another statement piece to the iconic Jordan legacy.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low Pink Cooler Mulberry Rose
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Low Pink Cooler Mulberry Rose brings playful color and bold contrast to one of Nike’s most timeless silhouettes, giving the Air Force 1 a lively and expressive personality. The mix of pink cooler and mulberry rose feels energetic and modern, while subtle hits of blue and black add balance and depth. It feels fun without being overwhelming, letting color tell the story while the classic AF1 shape keeps everything grounded and familiar.

Fans love this release because it shows how versatile the Air Force 1 really is. The silhouette remains instantly recognizable, but the vibrant palette gives it a fresh emotional tone that feels perfect for statement driven rotation. Collectors appreciate how Nike continues to refresh the AF1 through thoughtful color stories, making this pair feel seasonal, expressive, and wearable without sacrificing the cultural weight that has kept the model relevant for decades.

The Nike Air Force 1 Low Pink Cooler Mulberry Rose was released on December 5, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

title: Nike Air Foamposite Pro Pearl (2025)
description:
Nike Air Foamposite Pro Pearl 2025 revives one of basketball’s most futuristic silhouettes with a finish that feels smooth, clean, and timeless. The pearl treatment gives the Foamposite Pro a subtle glow, highlighting its molded shell and fluid shape that once felt years ahead of its time. Even decades later, the design still feels bold and unapologetic.

Collectors are drawn to this release because it celebrates the Foamposite legacy without overcomplication. The minimalist colorway lets the shape speak, reinforcing why this model became a cultural icon both on court and off. It feels like a reminder of an era when Nike pushed boundaries through form and material rather than trends.

The Nike Air Foamposite Pro Pearl 2025 was released on 11/27/2025 with a retail price of $240.

title: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SP Vast Grey
description:
The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SP Vast Grey is a limited-edition release that is part of the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 series.​
​​
​The Vast Grey Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SP features an upper that is made of breathable mesh with durable TecTuff overlays and reflective 3M detailing and has a midsole that is equipped with a combination of Zoom Air technology and Cushlon foam cushioning to provide support and protection for the foot. The shoe has a Vast Grey colorway with hits of black and white.
​
​The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SP Vast Grey was released on February 1, 2019 and again on February 22, 2023, at a retail price of $160.

title: adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Dark Glow
description:
The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Dark Glow features a black Primeknit upper with a black TPU cage that glows vivid blue when exposed to the dark. From there, an EVA foam sole adds support for a cushioned fit.

The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Dark Glow released in August of 2021 and retailed for $200.

title: Starbucks Bear "Bearista" Glass Tumbler Cup
description:
The Starbucks Bear Glass Tumbler is a charming and highly collectible drinkware piece that perfectly blends Starbucks’ iconic café style with playful design. Featuring an adorable bear motif integrated into a sleek glass tumbler, this item has become a favorite among Starbucks fans, seasonal collectors, and anyone looking to elevate their daily coffee routine.

Crafted from durable glass, the Starbucks Bear Glass Tumbler offers a premium feel while remaining practical for both hot and cold beverages. The transparent design highlights your drink of choice, while the bear detail adds a fun, cozy touch that stands out from standard Starbucks tumblers. Finished with a reusable lid and straw, this tumbler is designed for everyday use while helping reduce single use plastics.

This tumbler is especially popular as a limited or regionally released Starbucks collectible, making it a sought after item on the resale market. Whether you are a Starbucks merch collector, searching for a unique gift, or simply want a cute and functional cup for iced coffee or matcha, the Starbucks Bear Glass Tumbler checks all the boxes.

With its eye catching design, reusable construction, and strong demand among Starbucks enthusiasts, the Starbucks Bear Glass Tumbler is a standout lifestyle accessory that brings a little extra personality to every sip. The Starbucks Bearista Bear Glass Tumbler was released in November 2025, with an original retail price of $30 USD in Starbucks stores as part of the 2025 holiday merchandise rollout.

title: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Gold (Women's)
description:
The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Gold (Women’s) is a modern running shoe with a geometric design with metallic accents.

This version of the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 comes with a white mesh upper for breathability. The mesh is overlaid by both real and synthetic leather in different shades of white and gold. A matte metallic gold lines the toebox and heel, while shiny metallic gold runs up to the laces and midsole. The midsole features plastic gold caging for extra support. On top of this caging, you’ll find the Nike Swoosh in shiny gold. The Swoosh appears again on the heel, and the tongue contains a Nike Vomero 5 patch. The shoe is complete with Zoom Air cushioning and a rubber sole for traction.

What stands out about this shoe is the plastic gold caging added on the sides for extra support. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Gold (Women’s) was released on March 20, 2024, for a price of $160.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Seafoam Sail (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 4 Retro Seafoam Sail (Women's) is a high-top silhouette in women’s sizing presenting in a calming, seafoam sail colorway.

This high-top Jordan 4 is a retro model and women’s sized sneaker. Dressed in a seafoam, minty green tone, this shoe has a luxurious and elegant aesthetic. The premium nubuck upper adds a velvety touch and while the signature mesh side panels provide breathability. You’ll spot metallic silver detailing in the form of an element that doubles as part of the eye stay. The Jumpman logo is on a patch on the tongue, while the back heel sports the rubberized logo along with the textured pull tab.

StockX experts appreciate the sail-toned midsole that houses the Air unit, while the herringbone-patterned outsole is sail and seafoam with branding underneath. When the Jordan 4 Retro Seafoam Sail (Women's) debuted to the public on March 8, 2025, it sold for $215 retail.

title: ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Cloud Grey
description:
Inspired by the people, culture, and lifestyle of New York City, the ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Cloud Grey dresses the innovative silhouette in a neutral colorway of Cloud Grey and cream.

Originally designed by Angelo Baque, the Cream Cloud Grey ASICS Gel-NYC is a mashup of retro and contemporary influences. For example, the Gel-Nimbus 3 and the Gel-MC Plus V inform the upper, while the tooling system borrows from the Gel Cumulus 16. This gives the sneaker upgraded Gel cushioning in the heel and forefoot but also celebrates running shoes from the early 2000s through the bulky, layered upper. title: Jordan 3 Retro Levi’s Lunar New Year
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Levis Lunar New Year blends heritage basketball design with denim craftsmanship in a way that feels celebratory yet rooted in history. The upper is wrapped in textured Denim, giving the Jordan 3 a casual edge that contrasts beautifully with the structured silhouette Tinker Hatfield introduced decades ago. Sail on the midsole keeps the look clean, while Gym Red accents inject a festive energy that nods to Lunar New Year traditions.

Jordan 3 collaborations always carry weight, and adding Levis into the mix elevates the storytelling through material alone. Denim has long been a staple in street culture, and seeing it reworked on one of the most important Jordan models makes this pair feel instantly collectible. The Lunar New Year theme adds another layer of meaning, turning an already strong collaboration into a culturally resonant release.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Levis Lunar New Year was released on February 20, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

title: Nike Vomero Premium Black Volt
description:
Nike Vomero Premium Black Volt takes a comfort focused running silhouette and gives it a bold visual punch through contrast and tone. The black base grounds the design, while volt accents inject energy and modern attitude, creating a shoe that feels both technical and lifestyle ready. It reflects Nike’s ability to evolve performance heritage into something that fits everyday movement and style.

Collectors appreciate this version of the Vomero because it highlights balance. The premium approach elevates the silhouette beyond pure function, while the color story keeps it expressive without being overwhelming. It feels like a shoe designed for long wear and long term relevance, appealing to fans who value cushioning, presence, and understated confidence in equal measure.

The Nike Vomero Premium Black Volt was released on 11/13/2025 with a retail price of $230.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Forget Me Not (Women's)
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro Forget Me Not (Women's) brings a fresh floral vibe to the iconic silhouette. Dressed in a clean white base, the sneaker features accents of aluminum, blue tint, and oil green, creating a serene and stylish look. Removable floral patches on the tongues pay homage to the forget-me-not flower, adding a unique touch that celebrates Mother's Day.​

This women's-exclusive release continues Jordan Brand's commitment to crafting meaningful sneakers. The combination of soft hues and floral details makes it a standout piece for both collectors and those new to the sneaker scene. The design balances elegance and streetwear appeal, making it versatile for various styles.​

Released on May 3, 2025, at a retail price of $215, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Forget Me Not offers a blend of classic design and thoughtful details. Its colorway of white, aluminum, blue tint, and oil green ensures it stands out in any sneaker rotation.​

title: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Chrome Toe (Women's)
description:
The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Chrome Toe (Women's) is a women's-sized athletic shoe crafted with a mesh upper in White, accented by Metallic Silver at the lace panel, vamp, and the side Swoosh. Linear and mesh caging over the quarter and heel counter heighten the multi-white color palette in Summit White and Pure Platinum, accented by a segmented mid- and outsole in the same color combo. Off-white Swoosh branding on the heel finishes the look. 

American athletic wear brand Nike debuted the Vomero 5 in 2010, which was designed for lightweight comfort during running. The Zoom Vomero 5 is also widely known for its colorways, which give it a distinct look.

In our opinion, the best feature of the Zoom Vomero 5 is its Chrome Toe color story, which highlights its textural aesthetic, and the rounded tor cap. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Chrome Toe (Women's) released on December 20, 2024, and retailed for $160.

title: Jordan 5 Retro Wolf Grey (2026) (TD)
Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Mocha
description:
The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Mocha is a low-top shoe whose design was inspired by the 80s basketball look.
  
The Mocha Jordan 1 Retro Low OG has an upper made of white leather. This material and color form the side panels and the toebox, which also has perforations for extra air flow. A black leather overlay serves as the toecap and mudguard and attaches the bottom eyelets to the midsole. Thin black Nike Swooshes also appear in black leather on each side. Suede in Dark Mocha forms the heel counter and heel collar, and the heel collar also features a black Air Jordan logo. The tongue also bears a Dark Mocha Nike Air patch. A white midsole and black outsole complete the look. 

The most interesting feature of this shoe are the way the black and Dark Mocha colors work together, adding a hint of subtle elegance. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Mocha was released on September 21, 2024, for $140.

title: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Photo Blue
description:
Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Photo Blue brings a clean and focused look to one of Nike Basketball’s most precision driven silhouettes. The white base keeps the design sharp and uncluttered, while photo blue accents inject energy that mirrors the shoe’s quick and reactive identity. It feels purpose built for guards who rely on control and timing, with a visual language that emphasizes clarity and confidence rather than excess.

Collectors appreciate the GT Cut because it represents a modern shift toward feel and responsiveness over flash. The streamlined shape and balanced color blocking highlight the performance roots of the design, making it just as respected among hoopers as it is among fans of minimalist basketball footwear. It feels like a shoe designed to disappear on foot while still holding strong visual presence on shelf.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Photo Blue was released on 11/21/2025 with a retail price of $190.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Cherry (2022)
description:
The Air Jordan 11 Cherry brings a Chicago colorway to the iconic patent leather sneaker. Cherry red patent leather mudguards surround the majority of the upper, alongside white leather and a matching Cherry red Jumpman. The lining features Cherry red cotton and with the signature 23 debossed on the heel tab. An icy blue outsole and Cherry red carbon fiber plate complete 2022’s Jordan 11 iteration.

The Air Jordan 11 Cherry was released on December 10, 2022 with a retail price of $225.

title: Jordan 4 Retro White Thunder
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro White Thunder (GS) is a striking new release that pays homage to one of the most iconic colorways in Jordan Brand history. Inspired by the original Black and Yellow Thunder 4s, this grade school version brings a fresh take to the classic design. The upper features a predominantly black nubuck material, providing a sleek and bold look, while white accents create a sharp contrast. The Jumpman logo appears on both the tongue’s flight patch and the heel, ensuring that this sneaker remains true to its roots while introducing a new visual twist.

The Air Jordan 4 holds a special place in the world of basketball sneakers, originally released in 1989 as the first Jordan model to be released globally. Its unique design elements, such as the plastic wings and mesh netting, set it apart from its predecessors and have made it a fan favorite over the years. The White Thunder colorway continues this legacy by offering a fresh take on the silhouette that captures the essence of the original while adding a modern touch.​

​Released on August 24, 2024, the Air Jordan 4 Retro White Thunder (GS) retailed at $160. The black and white colorway provides a striking contrast that makes this sneaker stand out in any collection. This grade school release ensures that even younger fans of the Jordan brand can step out in style with a piece of basketball history.

title: adidas Handball Spezial Earth Strata Gum (Women's)
description:
The adidas Handball Spezial Earth Strata Gum (Women's) upgrades the Handball Spezial silhouette with a neutral colorway of Earth Strata and Off White.

The upper construction boasts supple suede in Earth Strada and a tonal T-shaped toebox in the same material. Both the 3-Stripes logo and the panels that form the lace cage feature serrated edges. While Earth Strata is the dominant tone, Off White can be found on the 3-Stripes logo, the heel tab, the laces, and the tongue’s logo tag. This logo tag has a vintage-inspired design that finds inspiration in adidas’ retro handball catalog. Other branding details include ‘SPEZIAL’ printed along the 3-Stripes logo in metallic lettering and ‘adidas’ embossed into the outsole.

Our experts at StockX like the inclusion of standard-colored gum on the rubber outsole instead of light or medium gum. It gives the sneaker a vintage appearance. The women’s size adidas Handball Spezial Earth Strata Gum (Women's) was released on November 10th, 2023, and sold for $110.

title: Nike Blazer Mid 77 White Black (Women's)
description:
Drawing inspiration from the original 1973 Nike Blazer, the Nike Blazer Mid 77 White Black (Women's) utilizes simple color blocking to deliver a throwback look. It features a white leather upper with black Swoosh overlays and grey suede mudguards. At the base, a white Sole completes the design.

The Nike Blazer Mid 77 White Black (Women's) was released in April of 2020 for $100.

To shop all Nike Blazer shoes, click here.

title: New Balance 9060 Triple White
description:
The New Balance 9060 Triple White takes the classic 9060 silhouette and adds an all-white colorway. Including white on the upper, outsole, midsole, and lining allows the sneaker’s design elements to stand out.

This version of the 9060 finds inspiration in the 990 and the 860, giving the lifestyle shoe an early 2000s aesthetic. It features wavy leather overlays on the upper that complement the wavy pattern on the thick midsole. The upper is made of breathable mesh, while the heel displays a transparent CR device. This feature can be found on other 9060 models and supports heel stability. Although the curving logo on the tongue resembles the lace jewel on the 991, the diamond-like pattern of the outsole finds inspiration in the 860.

Our StockX experts like how ABZORB cushioning and pods in the midsole contribute to the sneaker’s chunky appearance. The New Balance 9060 Triple White was released on January 12th, 2024, and retailed at $150.

title: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Pink
description:
The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Pink balances technical design with playful contrast by pairing metallic silver with soft pink accents. The result feels approachable yet expressive, letting the silhouette’s layered construction shine while color adds personality. It highlights the ProGrid Omni 9 as a bridge between archival running function and contemporary lifestyle appeal.

Collectors appreciate this pair because it feels versatile and thoughtfully styled. The silver base keeps the look clean, while pink details add warmth and individuality that elevate the shoe beyond pure performance. Fans love how Saucony continues to reframe classic runners for modern wear, making this release a strong example of comfort, nostalgia, and visual balance working together naturally.

The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Pink was released on December 1, 2024 with a retail price of $150.

title: Air Jordan 4 Retro OG SP Nigel Sylvester Brick by Brick
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro OG SP Nigel Sylvester Brick by Brick is a tribute to NYC's red-bricked streets, where Nigel Sylvester honed his BMX skills. As a long-time Jordan Brand collaborator, Sylvester fuses his love for biking with sneaker culture, crafting a bold design that reflects his journey. The firewood orange suede upper and sail midsole deliver a striking contrast, while the Bike Air branding on the heel adds a unique twist to the traditional Nike Air logo.

Details like the mini embroidered Swoosh on the forefoot, reflective 3M accents, and a worn-in aesthetic set this collaboration apart. The rugged build ensures durability for both BMX riders and streetwear enthusiasts alike. Sylvester's storytelling approach extends to the special packaging, reinforcing the "Brick by Brick" theme that symbolizes his rise.

Released on March 14, 2025, for a retail price of $225, the Air Jordan 4 Retro OG SP Nigel Sylvester Brick by Brick continues Sylvester's legacy of merging BMX culture with high-profile sneaker collaborations. Whether you're riding or collecting, this drop is built to turn heads.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Toe
description:
The Jordan 1 High OG UNC Toe is taking the sneaker game by storm. Jordan Brand masterfully integrates a unique colorway combo of University Blue, Black, and White on this iconic silhouette.

The Jordan 1 High OG UNC Toe showcases University Blue on the toe box and heel, which perfectly contrasts with the crisp White leather on the mid-panel and Black on the Swoosh and ankle collar. These kicks sit on a clean white midsole, offset by a vibrant University Blue outsole, creating an impressive visual balance.

The Jordan 1 High OG UNC Toe debuted July 22, 2023, commanding a retail price of $180, truly delivering the essence of style and quality.

title: Nike Mind 002 Light Smoke Grey (Women's)
description:
The Nike Mind 002 Light Smoke Grey Womens softens the futuristic silhouette through a muted and versatile palette. Finished in Light Smoke Grey with Photon Dust, Hyper Crimson, and Chrome accents, the upper emphasizes layered texture and sculpted detail. The clean grey base allows the subtle pops of color to stand out naturally.

Grey tones add refinement and everyday wearability to the Mind 002’s bold structure. Hyper Crimson accents inject controlled energy without overwhelming the design. It feels balanced and modern, offering a wearable take on Nike’s evolving lifestyle direction.

The Nike Mind 002 Light Smoke Grey Womens was released on January 8, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

title: adidas XLG Runner Deluxe Wonder Beige
description:
The adidas XLG Runner Deluxe Wonder Beige is layered in tones of beige, off-white, and cream. The upper of the trainer combines tightly woven mesh with leather and suede overlays, offering breathability. The running shoe has an oversized silhouette with a thick, platform-style midsole wrapped by extra-long cotton laces that loop around the shoe.

The oversized heel extends behind the back of the shoe and has marbled colored details in white, beige, and grey. Elaborate white and beige panels over each other around the upper. Under the panels, Dreamstrike and Lightstrike cushioning deliver lightweight responsiveness, while a rubber outsole adds traction and durability. The adidas XLG Runner Deluxe is maximalist with textured details on the thick midsole and textile panels overlaid with intertwining synthetic panels.

What our experts love the most about the adidas XLG Runner Deluxe Wonder Beige is their comfort and lightness despite the bulky aesthetic. Released on 6th February 2025, they originally retailed for $160.

title: Jordan 6 Retro Low Blackout (Women's)
Nike Dunk Low Pro SB Black White Gum
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Pro SB Black White Gum is a sleek and stylish addition to the iconic SB Dunk line. Featuring a classic color combination, this shoe boasts a black leather upper with contrasting white accents on the Swoosh, heel tab, and midsole. The gum rubber outsole adds a touch of warmth and provides excellent traction, making it perfect for skateboarding or casual wear.

Designed with both style and functionality in mind, the Nike Dunk Low Pro SB incorporates premium materials and advanced cushioning technology. The padded collar and tongue offer enhanced comfort and support, while the Zoom Air unit in the heel delivers responsive cushioning. The durable construction ensures long-lasting wear, whether you're hitting the skate park or navigating city streets. Us at StockX believe this product is great for skaters and sneaker enthusiasts alike, offering a versatile and timeless design that can elevate any outfit.

title: Jordan 12 Retro Flu Game (2025) (GS)
description:
The Jordan 12 Retro Flu Game (2025) (GS) brings one of the most legendary sneakers in basketball history to a new generation. First introduced in 1997 and last seen in 2016, this colorway is tied to Michael Jordan's unforgettable Game 5 performance in the 1997 NBA Finals, where he overcame flu-like symptoms to drop 38 points and secure a crucial win for the Bulls. Now, kids can lace up a piece of basketball history with this downsized edition made just for them.

Staying true to the original design, this GS version features a premium black tumbled leather upper paired with a bold varsity red mudguard and midsole, offering the same sleek and powerful aesthetic. Classic Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel tab keeps the look authentic, while the lightweight cushioning and supportive fit make it perfect for all-day wear whether on the playground or the court.

Released on March 1, 2025, for a retail price of $150, the Jordan 12 Retro Flu Game (2025) (GS) gives kids the chance to rock one of the most historic sneakers in the Air Jordan lineup. With its deep-rooted legacy and bold color-blocking, this pair remains an essential pickup for young sneaker fans.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy
description:
Previously dubbed "Certified Lover Boy", the new premium Drake-inspired AF1 is now known as the "Love You Forever." This sentiment is inspired by Drake’s favorite childhood book with subtle added details of the scripted "Love You Forever" on the midsole, in the same white color. Additional design elements include customized laces, NOCTA logo on left heel, and a new perforation pattern on toe box.
​
The special-edition Drake Nike Air Force 1 Low released December of 2022 for $160.

title: Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott Green Spark
Jordan 1 Retro High OG Rare Air
description:
The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Rare Air pays homage to the original 1985 design with a contemporary twist, blending classic elements with modern updates. This iteration features a white leather base complemented by neutral grey collars and overlays, reminiscent of the OG "Storm Blue" colorway. Deep royal blue accents on the ankle flaps and outsole inject a vibrant touch, while the wear-away black Swooshes reveal a layer of red beneath, adding a dynamic and customizable aspect to the sneaker’s aesthetic.

Notable design details include alternating "Air Jordan" and "Nike Air" lettering on the Wings logos, offering a unique nod to the brand’s heritage. The muslin midsole enhances the vintage-inspired look, making this pair a must-have for collectors and new enthusiasts alike.

Released on April 5, 2025, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Rare Air was available at a retail price of $180.

title: Jordan 6 Retro PRM Bin23
description:
The Air Jordan 6 Retro PRM Bin23 revives one of Jordan Brand most coveted luxury designations with a palette that feels dark, refined, and unapologetically premium. Off Noir wraps the upper in a smooth, elevated finish, while Picante Red accents cut through with controlled intensity. The familiar Jordan 6 structure remains intact, from the sculpted heel tab to the perforated panels, but the Bin23 treatment gives it a more curated and collector driven presence.

Bin23 releases have always lived in a different tier, known for elevated materials and limited appeal aimed squarely at serious enthusiasts. Seeing that stamp return on a Jordan 6 instantly signals exclusivity and craftsmanship. The subtle red detailing against the deep Off Noir base creates a look that feels powerful without relying on loud blocking, making it a standout for collectors who appreciate understated luxury within the Jordan archive.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro PRM Bin23 was released on February 14, 2026 with a retail price of $355.

title: Jordan 1 Low SE Medium Olive Sail
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Medium Olive Sail leans into outdoor inspired tones to give the Jordan 1 Low a rugged yet refined personality. Medium olive dominates the upper with a grounded feel, while sail accents soften the look and keep it versatile. The SE treatment adds subtle texture and depth, making the shoe feel more tactile and purpose driven without straying from the silhouette’s roots.

Collectors are drawn to this release because it blends heritage and utility seamlessly. The Jordan 1 Low’s classic shape anchors the design, while the olive and sail palette adds a sense of exploration and adaptability. Fans appreciate how this colorway feels ready for real world wear, reinforcing the idea that the Jordan 1 continues to evolve through thoughtful material and color choices rather than dramatic reinvention.

The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Medium Olive Sail was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

title: Nike Dunk Low Retro Khaki Team Red Pearl White (Women's)
description:
Nike Dunk Low Retro Khaki Team Red Pearl White Womens brings a grounded, lifestyle focused palette to one of Nike’s most versatile silhouettes, leaning into balance rather than flash. The mix of khaki, team red, and pearl white feels intentional and wearable, giving the Dunk Low a calm presence that still carries classic attitude. This colorway taps into the Dunk’s roots as an everyday shoe, built for rotation and personal style rather than hype driven moments.

What makes this pair resonate with collectors is how effortlessly it fits into modern wardrobes. The muted tones highlight the Dunk Low’s timeless paneling and proportions, letting the shape speak for itself. For fans who appreciate understated color stories, this release feels like a reminder of why the Dunk remains relevant decade after decade, adapting naturally to shifting tastes without losing its core identity.

The Nike Dunk Low Retro Khaki Team Red Pearl White Womens was released on 10/01/2025 with a retail price of $130

title: Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined (GS)
description:
Step into a piece of basketball history with the Air Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined GS. This sneaker revisits the legendary Bred colorway, blending black, cement grey, varsity red, and summit white to create a look that's both classic and fresh. The "Bred Reimagined" offers a new take on a beloved silhouette, honoring the legacy of the renowned shoe while updating the classic nubuck upper with a new supple leather upper.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro is known for its groundbreaking design and performance features, and the Bred Reimagined GS is no exception. Its durable construction and supportive fit make it ideal for everyday wear. The sneaker's iconic colorway and design elements preserve the essence of the original while offering a fresh twist with new materials.

Having made its debut on February 17, 2024, with a retail price of $160, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined GS has been warmly received by Jordan enthusiasts and sneaker collectors. Its release has reaffirmed the enduring popularity of the Jordan brand and its ability to inspire both nostalgia and innovation. For those seeking to own a piece of sneaker history with a modern twist, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined GS is an essential addition to your collection.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Cool Grey (2021)
description:
Since its debut in 2001, the Air Jordan 11 Cool Grey has become one of the most celebrated colorways in the Jordan 11 catalog.

The Air Jordan 11 Cool Grey (2021) features a Cool Grey Durabuck upper with patent leather overlays and a signature Jumpman embroidery on the collar. From there, a white midsole and an icy blue translucent outsole complete the design.

The Air Jordan 11 Cool Grey (2021) released in December of 2021 and retails for $225.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 Black Cream
description:
The ASICS Gel 1130 Black Cream taps directly into the early 2000s running revival, delivering layered paneling and breathable mesh in a colorway that feels effortless. Black dominates the base, giving the upper a sharp and grounded look, while Cream accents soften the contrast and highlight the flowing lines across the silhouette. The result is a pair that balances performance heritage with everyday wearability.

The Gel 1130 has become a quiet staple in rotation for those who appreciate technical runners without chasing hype. Its retro design language, complete with visible cushioning and sweeping overlays, gives it that authentic archival feel. In Black and Cream, the shoe feels versatile and mature, the kind of pair that works seamlessly with relaxed tailoring or casual street fits while still nodding to ASICS deep performance roots.

The ASICS Gel 1130 Black Cream was released on December 12, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

title: Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Neutral Grey
description:
The Jordan 1 Low 85 Neutral Grey represents an effort by Nike to return to the brand’s vintage roots. The sneaker finds inspiration in Michael Jordan’s first lifestyle sneaker, the Air Jordan 1 released in 1985, but bears a similar resemblance to the Nike Dunk Low.

Several details highlight the shoe’s vintage aesthetic, including the lightly pre-yellowed midsole that provides a worn-in appearance. The sneaker features a leather upper, perforations across the vamp, and a prominent Swoosh on the side. The Summit White, Light Smoke Grey, Neutral Grey, and Sail color blocking is similar to the OG version, but the grey tones are darker.

Our experts love that the Jordan 1 85 Neutral Grey updates the Air Jordan 1 Low OG Neutral Grey released in 2020. Unlike the first reissue of the OG model, the Jordan 1 85 Neutral Grey version offers more details that pay homage to the sneakers of 1985. The Jordan 1 Low 85 Neutral Grey was released on October 25, 2023, and retailed at $170.

title: Fear of God Essentials Chest Logo Hoodie Jet Black/Jet Black
description:
The Fear of God Essentials Chest Logo Hoodie Jet Black/Jet Black features a relaxed fit, cotton-polyester blend construction, and a prominent logo graphic on the chest. It also has a ribbed hem and cuffs and a drawstring-adjusted hood for a customizable fit.

The Essentials Chest Logo Hoodie by Fear of God features a classic design with a modern twist. The hoodie is made from a cotton-polyester blend, which provides a soft and comfortable texture. The prominent chest logo graphic is displayed in bold typography, while the ribbed hem and cuffs add a touch of vintage flair. Fear of God's minimalist approach to design is evident in this hoodie's clean lines and simple color palette.

We love the Fear of God Essentials Chest Logo Hoodie Jet Black/Jet Black, which has an adjustable hood and kangaroo pocket. The hood provides a customizable fit, while the kangaroo pocket offers a practical and convenient storage solution. This jersey was released on February 27, 2024, and retailed for $100.
primary_title: Fear of God Essentials Chest Logo Hoodie

title: 2025 Pokémon Mega Evolution Charizard X ex Ultra-Premium Collection
description:
The 2025 Pokémon Mega Evolution Charizard X ex Ultra Premium Collection is a must-have release for Pokémon TCG collectors and Charizard fans alike. Launching in 2025, this ultra premium collection celebrates one of the most iconic Mega Evolutions of all time—Mega Charizard X ex, a fan-favorite known for its striking black-and-blue design and raw power.

This premium box is headlined by an exclusive Mega Charizard X ex promo card, showcasing Charizard in its Mega Evolution form with stunning artwork that instantly stands out in any collection. Alongside the promo, the Ultra Premium Collection is packed with high-end Pokémon TCG accessories designed for both collectors and competitive players, making it an all-in-one showcase piece.

Inside, fans can expect a generous assortment of Pokémon TCG booster packs from recent and popular sets, offering plenty of chances to pull valuable ultra rares, secret rares, and other chase cards. The collection also includes premium display-worthy extras such as themed accessories that elevate the unboxing experience and make this product feel truly special.

With Charizard consistently being one of the most sought-after Pokémon in the hobby, the Mega Evolution Charizard X ex Ultra Premium Collection is highly desirable and likely to be a standout sealed product. Whether you’re looking to rip packs, display a centerpiece Charizard item, or hold onto a premium Pokémon TCG product long term, this Ultra Premium Collection delivers excitement, value, and undeniable Charizard appeal. The Pokémon Mega Evolution Charizard X ex Ultra Premium Collection was released in 2025 with an original retail price of $120.

title: Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black Panda (GS)
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black (GS) silhouette comes in a stark black and white colorway and is made from premium leather materials throughout. Additionally, white Nike lettering complements the rear ankle support of the silhouette while the Nike Air text along with the customary company Swoosh logo adorns the tongue. In keeping with the color scheme, a white midsole resting atop a black outsole rounds out the look of this Dunk Low Retro shoe.

The Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black (GS) released in March of 2021 and retailed for $85.

title: Nike Air Max Plus Pure Platinum University Red Black White
description:
The Nike Air Max Plus Pure Platinum University Red Black White delivers a crisp and high contrast take on the Air Max Plus by combining cool neutrals with classic Nike red accents. The pure platinum base sharpens the silhouette, while university red details add urgency and familiarity rooted in Nike heritage. It feels athletic and assertive, highlighting the Tuned Air structure and flowing cage lines with clarity.

Fans love this pair because it feels timeless and powerful. The Air Max Plus thrives when bold color meets strong form, and this execution strikes that balance cleanly. Collectors appreciate it as a versatile statement sneaker, one that carries attitude without excess and fits naturally into rotation for those who want an Air Max that feels confident, structured, and unmistakably Nike.

The Nike Air Max Plus Pure Platinum University Red Black White was released on April 1, 2025 with a retail price of $180.
secondary_title: Pure Platinum University Red Black White

title: Nike Air Diamond Turf Cowboys
description:
The Nike Air Diamond Turf Cowboys channels team identity into a silhouette built on toughness and versatility. The white, college navy, and metallic silver palette immediately ties the shoe to Cowboys heritage, giving it a strong sports driven personality. The Diamond Turf’s rugged structure and layered design make it feel ready for anything, reflecting the physicality and confidence associated with the franchise.

Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it blends nostalgia and team culture seamlessly. The Diamond Turf has always lived beyond a single sport, and the Cowboys colorway adds emotional connection without overpowering the silhouette. Fans love it as a wearable tribute, a sneaker that represents loyalty, tradition, and the kind of bold attitude that defined an era of Nike training footwear.

The Nike Air Diamond Turf Cowboys was released on December 5, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant City of Champions
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Work Blue honors legacy through a performance inspired reinterpretation. Dressed in Work Blue with Metallic Gold and Summit White accents, the upper maintains the classic AF1 structure while incorporating Protro level refinements. The bold blue base pairs with gold detailing to reflect championship energy.

Kobe themed releases always carry emotional weight, and applying that storytelling to the Air Force 1 gives the silhouette renewed depth. The work blue tone feels strong and confident, while gold hits elevate the look. It stands as a tribute piece that bridges basketball history with a timeless street icon.

The Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Work Blue was released on February 4, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low Flax Wheat
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Low Flax Wheat pays unofficial homage to the classic wheat Timberland work boot with its monochromatic flax suede uppers and overlays. Boot styled two-tone rope laces and top eyelets with metal grommets provide functionality and a rugged appeal. At the base, a matching flax Air sole is geared for daily wear and tear.

The Nike Air Force 1 Low Flax Wheat originally released in September of 2019 for $100, restocked in April of 2022 for $130 and currently sits at a retail price of $135.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Fjord Grey
description:
The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Fjord Grey is a premium running shoe that combines style and performance. Featuring a sleek white upper with fjord grey accents, this sneaker offers a clean and versatile look suitable for both athletic pursuits and casual wear. The Gel-Kayano 14 incorporates ASICS' renowned GEL technology in the heel and forefoot, providing superior shock absorption and cushioning for a comfortable stride.

Built with durability and support in mind, the Gel-Kayano 14 boasts a robust construction that caters to various foot types. The engineered mesh upper ensures breathability, while the reinforced heel counter promotes stability during movement. With its blend of cutting-edge technology and timeless design, this shoe is ideal for runners seeking a reliable and stylish option for their daily training or long-distance runs. Our experts state this product is great for athletes looking for a perfect balance of comfort, performance, and aesthetic appeal in their running footwear.

title: Nike Killshot 2 LTR PRM Tiempo Pack Black
description:
The Nike Killshot 2 LTR PRM Tiempo Pack Black updates the Killshot 2 with premium materials and a soccer-inspired design.

Although the original Killshot from 1979 was created for the tennis court, the Tiempo Pack Black Nike Killshot 2 LTR PRM includes a fold-over "tongue," mimicking 1980s soccer cleats. Although it looks like a tongue, this piece of black leather is actually a removable attachment. The upper is crafted from smooth, black leather with exposed stitching in clean white. The stitching highlights the mudguard, the Swoosh logos, the eyelets, the heel counter, and the collar. Branding details grace the fold-over "tongue," the functional tongue, and the smooth heel tab.

title: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Jalen Brunson Statue of Liberty
description:

Inspired by the iconic Statue of Liberty, the upper is coated in hyper turquoise, a nod to the statue’s patinated copper, while metallic copper accents on the Swoosh, Kobe sheath logos, and heel clip reference the famed landmark’s original material. This creative concept first appeared on-foot during the NBA playoffs and quickly became one of the most talked-about colorways of the season.

What began as a player exclusive for New York Knicks guard Jalen Brunson evolved into a full retail release for Holiday 2025. Fans and sneakerheads gravitated toward the blend of subtle storytelling and dynamic color that embodies both the city’s energy and Brunson’s own rise. Beyond its inspiration, the mix of vibrant turquoise and warm metallic copper makes it a striking year-end release.

description:
The Nike Air Max 95 SB Cacao Wow blends skate influence with one of Nike’s most recognizable running silhouettes. Black and anthracite tones create a dark and grounded base, while cacao wow introduces warmth and contrast across the layered upper. Light graphite, light charcoal, and pearl grey details add depth, giving the shoe a rugged and textured feel that suits its crossover identity.

title: New Balance 9060 Grey Jet Black
description:
The New Balance 9060 Grey Jet Black is an athletic shoe featuring multiple layers on the upper. A Grey mesh fabric base is overlaid with Black suede that borders the midsole. Grey and White leather caging creates the soft geometry of the upper, accented by the linear N logo in White and Grey. The layered, textured mid- and outsole repeat the White, Grey, and Black colors, echoing the upper's layered aesthetic. New Balance branding appears on the tongue and rear heel.

Primarily known for running shoes, American sneaker brand New Balance has been honing its performance styles in Boston, Massachusetts, since 1906. The brand has attracted legions of devotees for its running-focused shoes. The 9060 made its debut in the 2020s, and its vintage-inspired early 2000s aesthetic has proved to be a versatile canvas for colorway improvisation.

Our experts believe that the 9060 Grey's best feature is its substantial sole, which lends it a modern throwback look. The New Balance 9060 Grey Jet Black was released on March 8, 2025, and retailed for $150.

description:
