title: Nike SB Dunk Low Yuto Horigome Matcha
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Yuto Horigome Matcha brings a fresh, nature-inspired take to a classic skateboarding silhouette. Inspired by the shades of green found in matcha, this sneaker blends earthy tones across its premium suede and leather upper. Deep legion green and burnt sienna accents add contrast, while the light khaki base keeps the design grounded and wearable.

Designed with skaters in mind, the sneaker features a padded collar for extra ankle support, a durable rubber outsole for superior grip, and responsive cushioning for impact protection. Yuto Horigome’s signature details are subtly placed throughout, honoring his influence in the skateboarding world.

Releasing on April 5, 2025, the Nike SB Dunk Low Yuto Horigome Matcha retailed for $135. Whether you’re hitting the skatepark or just looking for a unique colorway, this Dunk Low offers style and performance in equal measure.

title: New Balance 9060 Triple Black (GS)
description:
The New Balance 9060 Triple Black (GS) distills the sleek, all-black aesthetic into a kids’ lifestyle sneaker built for comfort and confidence. This Black/Phantom colorway wraps the 9060’s layered design in tonal shades, highlighting the sculpted midsole, wavy lines, and podded outsole that define the silhouette. A breathable mesh base pairs with sturdy overlays for support that stands up to school days and weekend adventures, while reflective hits add a subtle pop in low light. The low-profile shape keeps movement natural, and the stealth palette makes styling effortless with uniforms, joggers, or denim.

Underfoot, the 9060’s signature cushioning delivers plush step-in comfort tailored for all-day wear. A dual-density setup featuring ABZORB and SBS-inspired tech helps soften impact and maintain stability, and the exaggerated outsole lugs grip sidewalks, gym floors, and playground surfaces with ease. The padded collar and tongue create a snug, secure feel without bulk, and the GC9060BB build keeps weight balanced for easy transitions from class to play. With its modern proportions and timeless Triple Black finish, this kids’ 9060 turns everyday outfits into a statement while keeping feet supported and ready for anything.

Our team loves this product because it blends standout style with dependable cushioning and traction, making it a go-to kids’ sneaker for school, sport, and everywhere in between.

title: Jordan 40 Infrared
description:
The Air Jordan 40 Infrared channels one of the most recognizable accents in Jordan history, pairing Black and Dark Grey with striking Infrared 23 hits. The bright red detailing energizes the upper, instantly drawing attention in a way only Infrared can. The sleek construction reinforces that this is a performance first silhouette, even as the colorway taps directly into retro nostalgia.

Infrared has always symbolized boldness within the Jordan archive, and seeing it applied to the fortieth model feels like a deliberate bridge between generations. Fans who grew up on classic Infrared releases will appreciate how this version keeps that spirit alive in a new form. It is both a celebration of the past and a statement that the Jordan line continues to evolve without losing its identity.

The Air Jordan 40 Infrared was released on February 12, 2026 with a retail price of $205.

title: Crocs Classic Clog Marvel Spider-Man Neo
description:
Crocs Classic Clog Marvel Spider Man Neo brings superhero energy into an everyday silhouette that thrives on personality and comfort. Spider Man’s presence adds bold visual storytelling to the Classic Clog, turning a familiar shape into something expressive and fun. The Neo treatment gives it a modern edge that feels playful rather than gimmicky.

What makes this release appealing is how naturally it blends pop culture with practicality. The Classic Clog already lives at the intersection of comfort and individuality, and the Spider Man theme amplifies that without overpowering the design. Collectors and fans enjoy this pair as a wearable tribute that feels lighthearted and accessible while still carrying cultural relevance.

The Crocs Classic Clog Marvel Spider Man Neo was released on 10/15/2025 with a retail price of $75.

title: Nike Air Max 270 White Black
description:
Crafted from a breathable mesh and canvas upper, the Nike Air Max 270 White Black now features 270 degrees of visible Air for extra comfort. Drawing inspiration from the sleek Air Max 180, the Nike Air Max 270 White Black features a slip-in bootie construction to deliver a great fit. The sneaker boasts a Max Air unit with 270 degrees of air encapsulated in the heel. The sneaker utilizes lightweight and soft neoprene across the upper to ensure airflow to the foot.

The Nike Air Max 270 White Black was released in March 2018 at a retail price of $160.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Linen
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Linen revisits a beloved Air Force 1 color story through the lens of Kobe Bryant’s enduring influence. The linen tones give the shoe a calm and understated presence, highlighting texture and warmth rather than contrast. It feels effortless and timeless, blending lifestyle wearability with deeper cultural meaning tied to Kobe’s legacy and philosophy.

Fans love this release because it balances nostalgia and tribute so naturally. The Air Force 1 silhouette remains clean and familiar, while the Protro treatment gives it renewed purpose. Collectors appreciate how the linen colorway feels mature and versatile, making it a sneaker that can be worn daily while still carrying emotional significance and respect for one of the game’s greatest icons.

The Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Linen was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Metallic Gold (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 4 Retro Metallic Gold (Women's) paints the Air Jordan 4 Retro in off-white Sail and upgrades the recognizable silhouette with gold accents.

The Sail upper, outsole, and midsole provide a monochromatic base that allows the metallic gold eyelets to shine. The AJ 4 features a total of four metallic gold eyelets – two on each side of the lace cage. While the upper is primarily composed of smooth leather, the quarter panel displays mesh that provides an airy feel. The midsole houses a visible Air unit in the heel, which adds responsive cushioning without weighing down the shoe. In terms of branding, the Jumpman logo can be found on the tongue and heel counter in Sail.

Our StockX experts appreciate the addition of a gold Jumpman logo underfoot. It creates a surprise pop of color without a metallic sheen. The women’s size Jordan 4 Retro Metallic Gold (Women's) was released on March 9th, 2024, and retailed at $200.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Lucky Shorts
description:
The Jordan 3 Retro Lucky Shorts pays homage to one of Michael Jordan’s most well-known game-day rituals—wearing his UNC practice shorts under his uniform for good luck. This tradition, which began after his iconic 1982 NCAA Championship-winning shot, is now immortalized in sneaker form. The shoe boasts a summit white leather upper, complemented by photon dust grey accents on the toe guard and heel, creating a clean and classic foundation.

A nod to Jordan’s college days, legend blue makes a bold statement on the Jumpman logo and heel, ensuring the heritage is felt throughout the design. One of the standout details is the behind-the-tongue label, designed to mimic the tags found on basketball shorts. It references the years Jordan’s lucky shorts tradition was in full swing, adding a subtle but meaningful touch for die-hard fans. The sail midsole and pure platinum detailing round out the colorway, keeping the design refined yet fresh.

Released on February 22, 2025, the Jordan 3 Retro Lucky Shorts retailed at $200, bringing history and superstition to life through a timeless silhouette. With its mix of summit white, hydrogen blue, legend blue, photon dust, pure platinum, and sail, this pair is a perfect blend of legacy and everyday style.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Seoul 2.0
description:
The Jordan 3 Retro Seoul 2.0 blends basketball heritage with Korean pride in one unforgettable silhouette. A sequel to the ultra-limited 2018 edition, this pair pays homage to South Korea’s cultural iconography and the 1988 Seoul Summer Olympics. It returns with a crisp white leather upper, suede elephant print panels, and bold accents of sport royal and challenge red inspired by the Taegukgi flag.

Jordan Brand added subtle upgrades to set the 2.0 version apart: quilted blue collars, aged yellow midsoles, and the reversal of the original embroidery across the tongues. These thoughtful tweaks make the sneaker feel both fresh and reverent to its roots. It’s a refined evolution of a beloved design that merges MJ’s legacy with Korean flair.

The Jordan 3 Retro Seoul 2.0 was released on May 15, 2025, for a retail price of $200. Done in white, black, sport royal, challenge red, pale vanilla, and college grey, it captures the spirit of Seoul and the DNA of an all-time classic.

title: Fear of God Essentials Fleece Essential Sweatpant Black
description:
The Fear of God Essentials Fleece Essential Sweatpant Black is a pair of sweatpants with elastic cuffs designed by the high-end brand.

This version of the Fear of God Essentials Fleece Essential Sweatpant comes in Black. This color dominates the design, and the only deviation from it is the Fear of God State branding on the top of one leg in yellow stitching. Another logo patch in black is seen just under the waistline on the front. The pants have a drawstring for an adjustable fit and elastic cuffs for heat retention. The sweatpants are made of a warm and soft fleece material, providing extra comfort.

What we think stands out about this pair of sweatpants is the yellow branding found on the thigh. The Fear of God Essentials Fleece Essential Sweatpant Black was first released on August 28, 2024, for an original retail price of $110.

title: Jordan 9 Retro Cool Grey (2025)
description:
A cult favorite returns as the Jordan 9 Retro Cool Grey (2025) makes its comeback, staying true to the 2002 original. First released during MJ's time with the Washington Wizards, this non-OG colorway has gained a legendary status over the years. The medium grey nubuck upper, patent leather mudguards, and crisp white accents create a sleek, timeless aesthetic that continues to stand out decades later.

Signature details remain intact, including the one-pull lacing system, jagged midsole design, and Jumpman branding on the heel and outsole. A semi-translucent outsole rounds out the look, adding a subtle modern touch to the classic silhouette. Whether worn casually or on the court, this AJ9 delivers comfort, durability, and undeniable nostalgia.

Released on March 15, 2025, for a retail price of $210, the Jordan 9 Retro Cool Grey (2025) is a must-have for fans of early 2000s Jordan retros. A perfect blend of heritage and style, this sneaker proves why the Cool Grey colorway remains one of Jordan Brand's most beloved.

title: Nike GT Future Metallic Silver
description:
The Nike GT Future Metallic Silver introduces a futuristic silhouette through bold material and confident structure. Metallic silver defines the upper with a high impact finish, contrasted by black and white details that sharpen the design. The form feels sculptural and intentional, emphasizing motion and innovation through proportion rather than ornamentation.

Fans are drawn to this model because it represents Nike looking ahead rather than back. The GT Future feels experimental and uncompromising, appealing to collectors who enjoy design that challenges convention. The reflective finish amplifies its presence, making it feel almost architectural. It stands as a statement of progress, offering a glimpse into where performance and lifestyle aesthetics may continue to intersect through fearless material choices and modern design language.

The upper of this Retro Air Jordan 4 sneaker is constructed from white leather with black support Wings, a matching black heel tab with embossed Jumpman branding, and navy molded eyelets. title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Lucky Green
description:

title: ASICS Gel-1130 Black Glacier Grey
description:
Built on a silhouette originally launched in 2008, the ASICS Gel-1130 Black Glacier Gray is a stability running shoe that exudes retro vibes infused with more modern details.

title: Jordan 11 Retro H-Town
description:

Fans appreciate the willingness to reinterpret such a sacred model through subtle innovation rather than dramatic change. Perforations enhance breathability, and the smooth, easy-to-clean upper is built to handle school days, weekend outings, and everything in between. The familiar midfoot shape and supportive heel counter offer a secure feel, and the refined all-white finish makes color pairing effortless, from bold socks to neutral layers. With its timeless profile, premium feel, and everyday versatility, the Pure Money colorway stands out as a wardrobe essential for young sneaker fans.

Our team loves this product because it blends iconic Jordan heritage with a fresh, all-occasion look that’s comfortable for all-day wear and simple to style.

title: Nike GT Cut Cross Barely Grape
description:
Built for stop-and-go playmakers, the Nike GT Cut Cross Barely Grape combines sleek court style with agile performance. The layered mesh upper keeps things light and breathable, while targeted overlays add structure through sharp cuts and quick changes of direction. A plush collar and padded tongue enhance comfort from warm‑ups to the final buzzer, and the secure lacing system helps lock down the midfoot without pressure points. Finished in a clean White base with Barely Grape and Pink Foam accents, this colorway pops with subtle contrast, balanced by Light Smoke Grey details for a refined, modern look. Style codes HF0218-100 / HF0231-100 and the 2024-06-01 release mark it as a standout in the Nike Basketball lineup.

Designed for responsiveness, the GT Cut Cross sits low to the ground to keep you connected to the hardwood. A resilient foam midsole cushions hard landings and fuels quick takeoffs, while a stabilizing heel frame adds confidence when you plant and explode. Underfoot, a grippy, multi-directional traction pattern helps you stay glued during crossovers, step-backs, and transition defense. Subtle Swoosh placements and crisp paneling highlight the shoe’s fast silhouette, making it just as strong for everyday wear as it is for competitive runs. If you’re seeking a versatile men’s basketball sneaker that blends speed, support, and standout color, the Nike GT Cut Cross Barely Grape delivers.

Our team thinks this product is great for players who thrive on quick cuts and lockdown control, and our team loves this product because it offers a lightweight build, secure fit, and court-ready traction in a polished Barely Grape palette.

title: Vans OTW Old Skool 36 Pearlized Pack Pink Black

title: Salomon S/Lab XT-6 Adv Triple Black

title: Jordan 5 Retro Awake NY Black

Air Jordan 5 Retro Awake NY Black feels like a confident collision of New York street culture and Jordan Brand heritage, using the Air Jordan 5 as a canvas for Awake NY’s sharp and expressive identity. title: ASICS Gel-1130 Neon Pack Pink (Women's)
description:
The ASICS Gel-1130 Neon Pack Pink (Women's) dresses the Gel-1130 technical silhouette in a pink colorway with contrasting accents in black and metallic silver.

title: Salomon XT-6 White Lunar Rock
description:
The two main hues that define the appearance of the Salomon XT-6 White Lunar Rock include lunar rock and white.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG A Ma Maniére
description:
The Air Jordan 1 A Ma Maniére features a premium cracked leather upper with burgundy reptilian-textural leather collars and Swooshes. Silky quilted lining and custom woven tongue and insole labels add a sense of luxury. At the base, a yellowed sole provides a vintage feel to complete the design.

title: Jordan 1 Low Shattered Backboard Alternate
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Shattered Backboard Alternate brings one of Jordan Brand’s most legendary color stories into a low cut format that feels fresh and accessible. The black, starfish, and sail combination instantly calls back to the Shattered Backboard legacy, tying the shoe to one of the most iconic moments in Michael Jordan history. Even in low form, the color blocking carries undeniable energy and familiarity.

Fans love this release because it offers a new way to wear a beloved story. adidas AE 1 Low 3SSB PE
description:
Built for quick cuts and all-game comfort, the adidas AE 1 Low 3SSB PE blends on-court performance with a clean, modern aesthetic. This low-top take on Anthony Edwards’ signature line keeps you closer to the floor for faster first steps, while a sculpted midsole provides responsive cushioning through long runs and hard landings. A supportive outer shell with strategic ventilation works with a plush inner bootie to lock in your foot without sacrificing breathability. Underfoot, a grippy rubber outsole with directional traction helps you stop on a dime and change pace with confidence, whether you’re attacking in transition or breaking down defenders in the half court. Finished with 3SSB-inspired details and classic Three Stripes DNA, it’s a sharp, team-ready look that translates from warmups to the final buzzer.

Engineered for competitive play, the adidas AE 1 Low 3SSB PE (style JR3915) delivers stability and energy return in a streamlined package. The low collar encourages natural ankle mobility, while raised sidewalls and a secure lacing system create a locked-in feel for lateral moves. Durable materials stand up to daily training, and the smooth interior reduces friction for distraction-free runs. This men’s performance basketball sneaker brings together a court-tuned ride, bold design language, and versatile styling that pairs easily with team uniforms or streetwear fits. Originally releasing on April 19, 2025 with a retail price of $110, it’s a smart pick for players who demand power, speed, and polish in one silhouette.

Our team loves this product because it offers agile court feel, reliable grip, and a standout look that motivates you to play your best every possession.

title: Nike P-6000 Flat Pewter
description:
The Nike P-6000 Flat Pewter is a design inspired by the 2006 Nike Air Pegasus running shoe. This comfortable, supportive, breathable sneaker shoe aims for an early 2000's aesthetic.

The Flat Pewter iteration of the Nike P-6000 sports of base of matte gray mesh overlaid with strips of white leather and metallic-looking synthetic material with hits of aqua-green TPU. Gray suede overlays cover the toe and heel. A Nike swoosh in white leather adorns the side panel while embroidered Nike swooshes grace the toe box and heel tab. The gray tongue features a silver tongue tag with Nike branding and the green insoles that match the TPU have Nike swooshes in black.

What we enjoy most about this shoe is its dependable sole unit. The stacked foam midsole provides cushioning and impact absorption and rests atop a rubber outsole in black, green, and white that provides traction. The Nike P-6000 Flat Pewter was released on September 25, 2023, for a retail price of $120.

title: Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Black Volt
description:
The Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Black Volt is a modernized version of the original Air Max Uptempo 95 released in the mid-90s.

The Air Max Uptempo 95 Black Volt has an upper that is made from leather and synthetic upper. The black monochromatic base is complemented by Volt accents, including the Nike Swoosh on the lateral side and the AIR lettering. The outsole is designed using rubber material, which provides grip on the court – even on dusty surfaces. This allows players to make quick cuts and sudden movements confidently, without worrying about slipping or sliding.

We think that the outstanding feature of the Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Black Volt is its full-length Volt-colored Max Air unit in the midsole. This unit offers cushioning and shock absorption during high-impact activities like basketball, making the shoe ideal for players who need support while jumping and landing. The shoe was released on September 10th, 2019, at a retail cost of $150.

title: Nike Air Foamposite One Deep Royal
description:
Nike Air Foamposite One Deep Royal brings rich color to one of Nike’s most futuristic and uncompromising basketball silhouettes. The Deep Royal finish enhances the Foamposite’s molded shell, emphasizing its smooth curves and almost liquid like form that once felt far ahead of its time. This shoe has always been about presence and confidence, and this colorway reinforces that identity by letting material and shape speak louder than graphics or contrast.

Collectors are drawn to the Foamposite One because it represents a moment when Nike pushed design boundaries without apology. The Deep Royal tone adds depth and elegance, making the silhouette feel powerful rather than flashy. It works as a statement piece on display and a reminder of an era when innovation was driven by form and material rather than trends, keeping the Foamposite legacy intact and respected.

The Nike Air Foamposite One Deep Royal was released on 09/12/2025 with a retail price of $240.

title: Nike x NOCTA Chalet Polar Men's Top Brown
description:
The Nike x NOCTA Chalet Polar Mens Top Brown complements the Chalet lineup with a fleece top designed for warmth and simplicity. The soft polar construction gives it a cozy, insulated feel, while the clean shape and brown colorway keep the design refined and versatile. It feels intentionally minimal, allowing texture and fit to carry the look rather than bold branding or graphics.

Fans love this piece because it fits seamlessly into everyday rotation. It works as a standalone layer or part of a full Chalet set, making it easy to style while still feeling premium. Collectors appreciate how NOCTA pieces emphasize longevity and comfort, offering apparel that feels relevant year after year. This top captures that balance perfectly, serving as a functional cold weather essential with a calm and confident presence.

The Nike x NOCTA Chalet Polar Mens Top Brown was released on November 14, 2025 with a retail price of $120.
primary_title: Nike x NOCTA Chalet Polar Men's Top

title: Jordan 10 Retro OG Steel (2025)
description:
The Jordan 10 Retro OG Steel (2025) revives a timeless court classic with a clean, high-contrast palette that never misses. Dressed in White/Black-Light Steel Grey, this pair balances premium leather up top with a sleek black tongue and collar for a crisp, versatile look that moves from street to sideline with ease. The signature speed-lacing system offers quick lockdown, while a padded collar and plush lining keep every step comfortable. Underfoot, the Jordan 10’s famed striped outsole returns, showcasing Michael’s early-career highlights and delivering dependable traction, so you get heritage storytelling and on-foot performance in one. Style code HJ6779-104 anchors the release for collectors who prioritize the details and the legacy.

True to the Jordan 10 blueprint, cushioning comes courtesy of a responsive Air unit housed in a lightweight midsole, striking a smooth balance between support and all-day wearability. Subtle Light Steel Grey hits add depth to the neutral base, giving this colorway its refined edge and making it easy to pair with denim, joggers, or tailored athleisure. Whether you’re building a rotation around iconic retros or seeking a standout everyday option, the Jordan 10 Retro OG Steel (2025) delivers a polished finish with unmistakable lineage. With its release date set for August 2, 2025 and a retail price of $200, this modern take on a storied silhouette is poised to be a cornerstone pickup for fans of classic Jordan design.

Our team loves this product because it blends heritage detailing, versatile styling, and dependable cushioning, making it a go-to for collectors and daily wear alike.

title: Nike Kobe 4 Protro Girl Dad
description:
The Nike Zoom Kobe 4 Protro Girl Dad celebrates the profound bond between Kobe Bryant and his daughters with a vibrant new colorway. This sneaker features a striking bicoastal and black upper with metallic silver accents, making it a stylish addition to any sneaker collection. The sneaker retains the sleek, low-cut silhouette that made the original Kobe 4 a game-changer, combining aesthetic appeal with high-performance functionality. Whether on the court or off, the Kobe 4 Protro offers the perfect blend of heritage and innovation. ​
​​
​ The Kobe 4 Protro is renowned for its revolutionary approach to basketball footwear, being the first in the Nike Kobe line to adopt a lower cut. This design choice not only enhanced mobility, but also set a new trend in basketball sneaker design. The Girl Dad edition Protro updates this iconic model with advanced technology, ensuring that modern players experience unparalleled comfort and support. This sneaker features "Girl Dad" embroiderd on the inside of the tongue & an orange insole with the iconic Kobe logo printed on top of it.. ​
​​
​ Priced at $190, the Nike Zoom Kobe 4 Protro Girl Dad was released on June 7, 2024. This release not only honors Kobe's legacy but also appeals to a new generation of hoopers with its fresh and dynamic design. Make sure to add this unique and meaningful sneaker to your collection, celebrating both style and heritage with every step.

title: Vans OTW Old Skool 36 Pearlized Pack Marshmallow
description:
Vans OTW Old Skool 36 Pearlized Pack Marshmallow brings a soft and elevated finish to one of skate culture’s most recognizable shoes. The marshmallow tone paired with a pearlized sheen gives the Old Skool a refined personality without losing its laid back roots. It feels light, clean, and expressive, designed for people who appreciate subtle texture and tone over loud contrast.

Collectors enjoy this pair because it reimagines a familiar silhouette in a way that feels fresh but wearable. The Old Skool’s shape anchors the design, while the pearlized finish adds visual interest that catches light without overpowering the shoe. It works equally well as a daily staple or a thoughtful addition to a curated Vans rotation.

The Vans OTW Old Skool 36 Pearlized Pack Marshmallow was released on11/18/2025 with a retail price of $130.

title: Supreme Hand Tied Beanie Multicolor
description:
The Supreme Hand Tied Beanie Multicolor is a cuffed beanie in acrylic. The beanie is crafted from knit columns of bicolor yarn, with visible hand-tied knots exposed on the exterior. The multicolor yarn pattern does not repeat. Supreme branding appears on the cuff in black embroidery.

Supreme was founded in Lower Manhattan in 1994 by James Jebbia, and the skateboarding and streetwear brand has always found its niche by popularizing functionality with a nod to counterculture. The Hand Tied Beanie’s exposed fabrication and lack of pattern recall the offbeat nature of 1990s skate style, when grunge and unusual thrifted items became a documented style worthy of coverage in major publications.

In our opinion, the best feature of the Supreme Hand Tied Beanie Multicolor is its chunky knit, which offers an eye-catching, unisex way to stay warm. The Supreme Hand Tied Beanie Multicolor released on November 16, 2023, and retailed at $54.

title: adidas BW Army Lux White Gum
description:
The adidas BW Army Lux White Gum is a casual lifestyle sneaker. The upper is constructed with Footwear White leather for the underlays and quarter, heel, and lace panel overlays. The tip continues the monochrome aesthetic while differentiating the texture in Footwear White suede. The Gum rubber mid- and outsole unit displays adidas Trefoil branding, which balances the monochrome Footwear White laces and tongue branding.

Founded in 1924, Germany-based adidas is one of the world’s most prolific sneaker brands. With the ability to mine their century-plus worth of archives, adidas excels at reintroducing historic styles, such as the BW Army. It was originally called the German Army Trainer, and the shoe's classic styling complements adidas' modern reinterpretation well.

Our experts feel that the best feature of the BW Army Lux is its classic Footwear White color palette, which is timeless and subtle. The adidas BW Army Lux White Gum was released on April 1, 2025, and retailed at $120.

title: adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny Cabo Rojo
description:
The adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny Cabo Rojo (style JS5052) reimagines a terrace classic with bold color and street-ready flair. Dressed in the Wonder Clay/Wonder Quartz/Ash Pink palette, this pair pairs plush suede with tonal overlays and soft pastel hits for a look that’s both expressive and easy to style. The signature T-toe, serrated 3-Stripes, and low-profile silhouette honor the celebrated Gazelle lineage, while co-branded touches nod to the Bad Bunny collaboration in a way that feels confident and modern. Underfoot, a translucent gum sole delivers timeless indoor-court traction with a smooth, grippy ride, and a cushioned insole keeps every step comfortable from first wear to last call.

Thoughtful details elevate the overall experience. The semi-translucent outsole showcases classic Gazelle Indoor DNA, complementing the supple upper and giving the shoe a distinctive glow in natural light. Included Pink Laces and a White Dustbag add versatile styling options and a premium unboxing moment. Whether you’re pairing them with relaxed denim, track pants, or tailored shorts, the neutral-leaning Wonder Clay base and Ash Pink accents slot seamlessly into rotations year-round. With its balanced mix of heritage sport design and contemporary color execution, this Bad Bunny Cabo Rojo edition lands as a standout choice for collectors and everyday wearers alike.

Our team loves this product because it blends iconic Gazelle Indoor craftsmanship with eye-catching color and day-long comfort, making it a go-to for elevating daily outfits without sacrificing versatility.

title: Jordan 9 Retro Flint Grey French Blue (2026) (GS)
description:
The Air Jordan 9 Retro French Blue 2026 GS refreshes a beloved colorway through crisp contrast and youthful scale. White leather anchors the upper, while french blue accents bring clarity and brightness across the midsole and detailing. Flint grey elements add depth and balance, giving the silhouette a layered and cohesive finish that stays true to its heritage roots.

Fans appreciate this release because French Blue remains one of the most recognizable palettes within the Jordan 9 lineup. Translating it into grade school sizing keeps the design accessible while preserving its authentic proportions and structure. Collectors value how the clean white base enhances the blue and grey contrast, making it stand out without feeling overstated. It stands as a modern continuation of a classic formula, blending nostalgia with refreshed execution for a new generation.

The Air Jordan 9 Retro French Blue 2026 GS was released on January 24, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

title: New Balance 1906R White Metallic Gold
description:
The New Balance 1906R White Metallic Gold comes in a metallic silver and metallic gold color scheme.

The New Balance 1906R White Metallic Gold adopts a classic silhouette with white leather and gold embellishments. The upper is breathable and lightweight, with a cushioned collar and tongue for comfort. The midsole is constructed from lightweight EVA foam for cushioning and support. Durable rubber is used to construct the outsole, which provides grip and steadiness. The shoe also features "N" branding in a contrasting gold and black colorway on both lateral sides.

The New Balance 1906R White Metallic Gold was made available on August 12th, 2022, for a retail price of $155.

title: New Balance 992 MiUSA Grey Silver Metallic
description:
The New Balance 992 MiUSA Grey Silver Metallic is a premium sneaker that combines classic style with modern comfort. Crafted in the USA, this shoe features a sleek grey upper with silver metallic accents, creating a sophisticated and versatile look. The iconic 992 silhouette is enhanced with New Balance's signature ABZORB midsole technology, providing superior cushioning and support for all-day wear.

Designed for both style and performance, the 992 MiUSA boasts a durable pigskin suede and mesh upper, offering breathability and durability. The shoe's chunky sole unit not only adds to its distinctive aesthetic but also provides excellent traction and stability. With its timeless design and high-quality construction, this New Balance 992 is perfect for sneaker enthusiasts and casual wearers alike.

We at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a blend of comfort, style, and American craftsmanship in their footwear. The 992 MiUSA Grey Silver Metallic offers exceptional versatility, making it an ideal choice for various occasions and outfits.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy Pink Foam
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy Pink Foam is a basketball style athletic shoe with a low top. The leather upper in Pink Foam coordinates with a matching Pink Foam midsole, accented by Love You Forever branding. The rear heel tabs sport Nike Air and NOCTA branding on the right and left, respectively, and NOCTA branding appears on the insole. Additional details include a Metallic Silver dubrae, alternate laces, and included block letter beads for personalization.

In collaboration with Canadian artist Drake, American athletic wear brand Nike produces NOCTA, an outlet for Drake’s clothing and footwear expression. NOCTA is known for its symbolism, and for the first time ever, Nike modified the Air Force 1’s midsole branding to say Love You Forever in script, referencing Drake’s favorite book as a child.

Our experts feel that the best feature of the AF1 Low Lover Boy is its monochrome Pink Foam colorway, which stands out from other Air Force 1s. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy Pink Foam released on March 7, 2025, and retailed for $160.
secondary_title: Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy Pink Foam

title: New Balance 1906A Tech Explosion
description:
The New Balance 1906A Tech Explosion gives the 1906A an exaggerated technical makeover with overlapping, deconstructed overlays in a variety of metallic and matte hues.

As New Balance digs into its retro catalog, the 1906A Tech Explosion joins the ranks of reimagined technical running shoes with early 2000s roots. It features a classic, white mesh base with exaggerated synthetic and genuine leather overlays in Silver Metallic, Gold Metallic, and Castlerock. Each overlay stands out against the base, highlighting the individual design details. Nylon ribbons in Castlerock thread through the New Balance "N" and hang over the midsole, giving the sneaker an unfinished look.

Our StockX experts like the yellow-orange stains on the white midsole. They elevate the sneaker beyond models with an entirely off-white midsole, and pay homage to the shoe’s retro design elements. The New Balance 1906A Tech Explosion was released on July 24, 2024, and sold for $170.

title: Nike Dunk Low Photon Dust (Women's)
description:
The women's Nike Dunk Low Photon Dust (W) is made of white leather with Photon Dust leather overlays and Swooshes. A woven Nike label on the tongue and embroidered Nike branding completes the design.

The women's Nike Dunk Low Photon Dust (W) released in May of 2021 and retailed for $100.

title: adidas Yeezy Slide Salt
description:
Enter the realm of sleek minimalism with the adidas Yeezy Slide Salt, a silhouette that redefines casual footwear. Embracing a monochromatic salt hue, this slide is a testament to the idea that true sophistication lies in simplicity. Designed with a smooth, seamless construction, the Yeezy Slide Salt offers an uncluttered, organic aesthetic that's as tranquil as its namesake.

The Yeezy Slide in Salt is crafted from a unique foam compound that blends lightweight comfort with durability, these slides are tailored for the trendsetters who seek to merge their laid-back lifestyles with high-fashion sensibilities. The soft, cushioned footbed conforms to your foot, making every step feel like a cloud—a testament to adidas and Yeezy's pursuit of innovation in comfort and design.

Having graced the market on March 15, 2024, and with a price tag of $70, the adidas Yeezy Slide Salt swiftly became the go-to choice for those who covet a fusion of luxe and leisure. Its release is celebrated as the moment when adidas and Yeezy once again elevated the everyday to the extraordinary. For the aficionados of minimalist chic, the adidas Yeezy Slide Salt has set a new benchmark in effortless style.

title: Nike Air Diamond Turf Emerald
description:
Nike Air Diamond Turf Emerald revives a cross training classic through a colorway that celebrates power and versatility. The emerald tone adds richness to the Diamond Turf’s muscular shape, reinforcing its identity as a shoe built for athletes who do everything. It carries old school energy that feels authentic rather than nostalgic for nostalgia’s sake.

Collectors appreciate this release because the Diamond Turf represents an era when athletes crossed sports and silhouettes reflected that mindset. The emerald finish gives the model fresh life while keeping its bold structure intact. It appeals to fans who value heritage designs that still feel strong and relevant decades later.

The Nike Air Diamond Turf Emerald was released on 08/29/2025 with a retail price of $150.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Fast Pass
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Fast Pass rides straight out of San Francisco skate culture with a color palette inspired by the city transit system. Safety Orange pops against Wolf Grey and Iron Grey panels, while Baroque Brown and Black anchor the layered upper. The classic SB Dunk shape stays intact, complete with padded tongue and responsive cushioning built for real sessions.

Transit themed SB releases always carry extra storytelling depth, and the Fast Pass concept feels authentic to the local skate scene. The mix of orange and grey mirrors that everyday city grind, turning a familiar commute reference into something collectible. For SB loyalists who appreciate region specific narratives, this pair blends skate function with cultural nods seamlessly.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Fast Pass was released on February 7, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

title: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Pink Purple
description:
The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Pink Purple revives early performance running aesthetics through bold color and layered structure. Pink and purple tones energize the ProGrid Omni 9’s technical build, giving the shoe a vibrant and expressive feel that still respects its stability focused roots. Mesh and synthetic overlays create depth, allowing color to flow naturally across the silhouette.

Fans gravitate toward this pair because it feels nostalgic and fresh at the same time. The ProGrid Omni 9 has become a favorite for those who appreciate classic running shapes with modern styling, and this colorway amplifies that appeal. Collectors appreciate Saucony’s ability to reintroduce archive models with confidence, making this release feel intentional, wearable, and visually exciting without losing authenticity.

The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Pink Purple was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

title: Jordan 40 Chicago
description:
Air Jordan 40 Chicago celebrates Jordan Brand’s legacy by bringing the Chicago story into a milestone silhouette that feels ceremonial and forward looking. Chicago color blocking has always symbolized excellence and history, and applying it to the Air Jordan 40 gives the shoe emotional gravity. It feels like a tribute to everything the brand has built while still looking ahead.

Collectors are drawn to this release because it represents continuity. The Air Jordan 40 stands at the intersection of heritage and evolution, and the Chicago theme reinforces why the brand remains culturally dominant. It feels meaningful rather than routine, designed for fans who understand the weight carried by both the number and the colors.

The Air Jordan 40 Chicago was released on 11/01/2025 with a retail price of $205.

title: Jordan 3 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére Diffused Blue Diffused Blue
description:
The new Jordan 3 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére Diffused Blue brings a fresh and sophisticated take on a classic silhouette, continuing the legacy of A Ma Maniére’s refined collaborations with Jordan Brand. This iteration swaps out the traditional elephant print for soft suede paneling, while the quilted satin interior lining adds a luxurious touch. The crisp white tumbled leather upper is complemented by diffused blue accents on the eyelets, heel tabs, and midsole, this colorway strikes a balance between vintage aesthetics and contemporary style.

Adding to its exclusivity, the sneaker features A Ma Maniére’s signature branding on the tongue, reinforcing the boutique’s commitment to craftsmanship and storytelling. A muslin midsole lends a nostalgic appeal, while the heel tabs include inspirational messaging—"All We Have is Each Other" and "You Need to Get Comfortable Walking Alone"—further solidifying its deeper narrative.

Released on March 29, 2025, the Jordan 3 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére Diffused Blue retailed for $225. With its premium materials and a design ethos rooted in timeless elegance, this sneaker continues A Ma Maniére’s streak of highly sought-after Jordan collaborations.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Mid Supreme White
description:
Sneaker giants Nike and Supreme join forces for the city-slicking shoe drop that is the Nike Air Force 1 Mid Supreme White. Bold yet simple, this sneaker collaboration has taken four years to hit the streets.

Pure white full-grain leather on the toebox keeps it breezy while velcro straps support the ankles. With a lace enclosure that includes a steel dubrae, the shoe is branded appropriately with the two labels’ logos. Find the Nike swoosh on the medial and lateral walls and the Supreme red box logo on the back heel. 

We love the Nike X Supreme Air Force 1 sneakers for their classic white freshness that comes with this style. With the red Supreme logo popping out against the monochrome background, the clever collaboration between these two masters of streetwear makes the anticipation of this release all that sweeter. Perfect for energized fans of freedom and movement. The Nike Air Force 1 Mid Supreme White sneakers were released on 29 August 2024 and retailed at $133.

title: adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Teal
description:
Making a splash on May 31, 2023, the adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Teal are the epitome of innovation and style. These unique sneakers are drenched in the Stone Teal colorway, a hypnotic blend of earthy hues that make the shoe a standout in any setting.

With a design that challenges conventional sneaker architecture, the 450's offer an avant-garde aesthetic highlighted by an intricately woven upper nestled in an eccentric, claw-like sole. The shoes embrace comfort, with the sock-like construction ensuring an effortlessly snug fit. The adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Teal isn't just a shoe; it's a statement piece, guaranteed to turn heads and garner compliments. Let these sneakers elevate your style game, providing a distinctive edge that's unmatched in the sneaker world.

The adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Teal hit the streets on May 31, 2023, carrying a retail price of $210.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High Shadow 2.0
description:
The upper of the Air Jordan 1 Shadow 2.0 is made of a black leather base with Light Smoke Grey overlays. A classic Wings logo appears on the lateral ankle wrap while a woven Nike Air label is stitched atop the tongue to complete the look.

The Air Jordan 1 Shadow 2.0 released in May of 2021 and retailed for $170.

title: Nike Air Max 95 Essential Triple Black
description:
The Nike Air Max 95 Essential Triple Black 2020/2023 was originally unveiled as one of Nike’s Nike Air Max 95 model sneakers in January 2020.

The Nike Air Max 95 Essential Triple Black 2020/2023 is dressed in a black-on-black colorway. The sneaker features a black mesh-constructed upper on top of a black leather base. The black tongue’s top features an "air max" labeling detail. Completing the design is the black rubber sole with Air Max units fitted within the heel and forefoot for extra comfort. The black rubber outsole is patterned for maximum traction.

During its initial unveiling in January 2020, Nike Air Max 95 Triple Black 2020 retailed at $170.

title: Jordan 3 Retro SP SoleFly Miami
description:
Air Jordan 3 Retro SP SoleFly Miami feels like a love letter to Miami culture wrapped in one of Jordan Brand’s most important silhouettes. SoleFly’s influence comes through in a way that feels authentic and rooted, pulling inspiration from South Florida’s warmth, movement, and layered identity. The Air Jordan 3’s iconic shape anchors the design, while the color story adds regional personality that longtime collectors immediately recognize as more than surface level branding.

What makes this release special is how naturally the story integrates into the silhouette. The Jordan 3 has always been about balance, and the SoleFly Miami execution respects that by letting materials, tones, and subtle details do the talking. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it represents a genuine collaboration, one that reflects place and culture without overpowering the shoe’s heritage or timeless appeal.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro SP SoleFly Miami was released on 12/05/2025 with a retail price of $230.

title: Puma Speedcat OG Red White
description:
The Puma Speedcat OG Red White is a bold performance shoe made for speed whose design was inspired by the racetrack.
  
The Red White Puma Speedcat OG has a lightweight paneled leather upper in Puma's bold For All Time Red color. A red leather overlay forms the toe cap, which also bears a white Puma logo on the outer side. White suede Puma Formstrip racing stripes appear on each side of the shoe above the red heel panel, while the Puma brand name and logo appear in metallic-gold letters on the outer side right above it. The tongue and heel also feature metallic-gold Puma branding. The rubber outsole is black and patterned for traction. 
 
What we like best about this sneaker is the slim design that truly supports the speed-enhancing features. The Puma Speedcat OG Red White was first released on June 29, 2024, for an original price of $120.

title: Jordan 6 Retro UNC White
description:
Jordan Brand drew inspiration from Michael Jordan's alma mater, the University of North Carolina, for the Air Jordan 6 Retro UNC White.

Constructed with University Blue Durabuck and white leather, the Air Jordan 6 Retro UNC White utilizes color blocking reminiscent of the renowned Jordan 6 Carmine. Hits of navy blue on the tongue and midsole integrate UNC's lesser known school color. At the heel, a Jordan Team patch nod to the jock tags that are stitched to the bottom of UNC's uniforms. From there, an icy semi-translucent Air sole completes the design.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro UNC White released in March of 2022 and retailed for $210.

title: Jordan 12 Retro Playoffs (2022)
description:
In celebration of its 25th Anniversary, Jordan Brand brought back the shoe that Michael Jordan wore while winning his 5th NBA Title, the Air Jordan 12 Retro Playoffs.

Debuted in 1997, the Air Jordan 12 Playoff captures Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls' dominance in the 1990s era of NBA basketball. This 2022 model sticks to the original design, featuring a black tumbled leather upper with a white textural mudguard and red Jumpman embroidery on the tongue. At the heel, a woven Jordan label and "23" text add subtle branding. At the base, a white sole with carbon fiber detailing completes the design.

The Air Jordan 12 Playoffs released in March of 2022 and retailed for $210.

title: Jordan 1 Mid Panda (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 1 Mid Panda (Women's) was released as part of the Jordan 1 Mid collection and was specifically made in women's sizes.

The Air Jordan 1 Mid Panda for women is designed with a black-and-white color scheme that mimics the appearance of a panda. The Nike Swoosh is also black and can be seen on the side, while the Air Jordan Wings logo appears in white. The shoe also features a rubber outsole that provides traction and grip, even on slippery surfaces. In addition, the shoe is lined with a padded collar and tongue, which provide extra cushioning and support.

Our experts believe that one of the most notable features of the Jordan 1 Mid Panda (Women's) is the mid-top silhouette. This design provides additional support and protection to the ankle, which makes the shoe ideal for sporty activities. The sneaker debuted on June 20th, 2023, and retailed for $125.

title: New Balance 9060 Sea Salt Castlerock
description:
The New Balance 9060 Sea Salt Castlerock brings a refined, modern twist to a fan-favorite silhouette with a palette that’s effortlessly wearable. A layered upper combines airy mesh with plush suede overlays in Sea Salt and Castlerock tones, creating depth and texture that elevate everyday style. Reflective details add subtle pop, while the sculpted lines and exaggerated proportions nod to Y2K design language through a contemporary lens. The signature 9060 platform features a chunky, diamond-patterned outsole and a sweeping midsole that delivers visual impact without sacrificing balance, making these men’s lifestyle sneakers a standout choice from street to studio.

Comfort takes center stage thanks to a stacked midsole that blends ABZORB cushioning with SBS heel support for a soft-yet-stable ride. The wide base enhances traction and confidence, while the padded collar and tongue secure a snug, supportive fit. Whether you’re clocking city miles or dressing up a casual rotation, the U9060AGA’s thoughtful materials and neutral colorway pair seamlessly with denim, tech pants, or tailored joggers. Finished with crisp New Balance branding and the model’s distinctive podded outsole, the 9060 Sea Salt Castlerock strikes the perfect balance of retro DNA and forward-thinking performance for all-day wear.

title: adidas Samba Messi Light Pink Black
description:
The adidas Samba Messi Light Pink Black blends football greatness with streetwear culture by tying Lionel Messi’s legacy to one of adidas’ most iconic silhouettes. The light pink and black colorway gives the Samba a modern and expressive look, reflecting Messi’s calm confidence and global influence. It feels refined and understated, allowing color and proportion to communicate the story rather than heavy branding.

Collectors love this pair because it feels personal and symbolic. The Samba’s simplicity pairs naturally with Messi’s playing style, grounded, precise, and effective. Fans appreciate how the shoe honors Messi without overpowering the silhouette, creating a sneaker that feels meaningful, wearable, and connected to football history in a subtle but powerful way.

The adidas Samba Messi Light Pink Black was released on January 6, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

title: Jordan 13 Retro Playoffs (2023)
description:
The Jordan 13 Retro Playoffs are making another return in 2023, its first appearance since its last retro in 2011. Michael Jordan debuted the Air Jordan 13 Playoffs in the 1998 NBA All-Star game, and continued to wear the sneakers throughout the season en route to his record breaking sixth NBA championship.
​
​Tinker Hatfield's original design for the Jordan 13 was inspired by Jordan’s aggressive play style, which was referred to as a Black Cat. The retro sneaker features black leather uppers, suede mudguards, and holographic eyes that sit below each collar.
​
​The Air Jordan 13 Retro Playoffs (2023) released February 18, 2023, with a retail price of $210.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Red Thunder
description:
Following similar color blocking as the Air Jordan 4 Thunder, the Air Jordan 4 Red Thunder features an all-black Durabuck upper with red netted underlays and eyelets. On the tongue, a signature Air Jordan Flight patch is stitched. A vibrant red midsole and Jumpman heel tab complete the retro design.

The Air Jordan 4 Red Thunder releases in January of 2022 and retails for $190.

title: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 TGRS Black Cream (Women's)
description:
The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 TGRS Black/Cream (Women’s) blends retro sport heritage with refined, everyday wearability. Rooted in the iconic 1966 silhouette, this pair showcases the brand’s hallmark crossed stripes in a soft cream against a sleek black upper for an effortlessly polished look. The low-profile shape flatters the foot, while subtle textural contrasts and a neatly stitched toe cap elevate the minimalist design. A flexible rubber outsole delivers reliable traction, and the lightly cushioned footbed keeps each step comfortable, ideal for everything from coffee runs to weekend exploring. Style code 1182A678-001 and the timeless Black/Cream colorway make this an easy, wardrobe-building staple.

Thoughtful details underscore its quality: a supportive heel flap with embossed branding, a padded collar for a secure feel, and a lace-up closure that lets you fine-tune the fit. The Mexico 66 TGRS moves seamlessly from denim and a trench to flowy skirts and a tee, adding a sleek finish without overpowering your look. Whether you’re drawn to vintage runners or simply want a versatile lifestyle sneaker, this ASICS classic offers a clean, balanced profile that stands up to daily wear. Released in March 2025, it’s a fresh take on a legend, modern comfort with unmistakable Onitsuka Tiger DNA.

Our team loves this product because it delivers classic styling, easy all-day comfort, and a goes-with-everything palette that instantly sharpens any outfit.

title: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Home
description:
The Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Home brings the energy of the Staples Center straight to your feet. This crisp white colorway is the perfect homage to the Lakers’ home uniforms, featuring a white engineered mesh upper, white midsole, and matching outsole. The purple embroidered Nike swoosh and Kobe’s signature in gold on the heel clip provide striking contrasts, while the gold Kobe logos on the tongue and heel tie the entire design together in true Lakers fashion.

As part of the Protro line, the Kobe 8 Lakers Home brings modern performance technology to one of the most iconic basketball sneakers ever. With its lightweight construction, responsive cushioning, and durable materials, this sneaker is built for both the court and the streets. The Lakers Home colorway blends performance and style, making it a must-have for any fan of Kobe Bryant and the Lakers dynasty.

Released on September 6, 2024, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Home retailed at $190. The white, court purple, and university gold colorway celebrates the Lakers’ rich history and Kobe’s incredible legacy. Whether you’re rocking these on the court or adding them to your collection, the Lakers Home edition of the Kobe 8 Protro is a timeless tribute to basketball greatness.

title: New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey
description:
The New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey blends urban looks with technical capabilities that offer a smart, quieted sneaker for versatile use. This edition leverages New Balance’s expertise in ergonomic design and long-lasting construction with refined, contemporary fashion.

The Black Dark Grey 2002R by New Balance features a suede and mesh upper in dark tones for breathability and structure. The ABZORB midsole technology offers shock absorption and comfort, while the N-ergy outsole gives you extra stability. Released as part of New Balance’s 2000 series, which originally debuted in 2010, this model maintains classic running-shoe elements with modern updates to give you a shoe that highlights the brand’s renowned craftsmanship and futuristic design.

What we love about the New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey are its ABZORB cushioning for lasting comfort and the sturdy N-ergy outsole for added stability. Released at $145 on July 3, 2024, these features combine seamlessly for an everyday sneaker.

title: Nike Dunk SB Low Krampus
description:
Nike Dunk SB Low Krampus dives into dark folklore and seasonal storytelling, transforming the SB Dunk into something eerie and atmospheric. Inspired by the mythical Krampus figure, the design leans into shadowy tones and unsettling details that feel purpose built for late night sessions and winter drops. It embraces the darker side of skate culture, where personality and narrative matter just as much as function.

This pair stands out to collectors because it feels bold and unapologetic. The SB Dunk Low already carries deep counterculture roots, and the Krampus theme amplifies that identity with a design that rewards fans who appreciate concept driven sneakers. It feels like a release meant to be remembered, capturing mood and attitude rather than chasing broad appeal.

The Nike Dunk SB Low Krampus was released on12/02/2025 with a retail price of $130.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 White Black Pebbled Leather
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 White Black Pebbled Leather features a white pebbled leather upper with black Swooshes and heel panels. Woven Nike labels on the tongue offer a retro feel. At the base, a white Air sole adds the finishing touch.

The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 White Black Pebbled Leather released in January of 2021 and retailed for $90.

title: Nike Vomero Premium Barely Volt
description:
The Nike Vomero Premium Barely Volt elevates Nike’s running heritage through a layered and experimental color palette that feels futuristic and bold. Barely volt and green tones flow across the upper, creating visual depth that highlights the shoe’s premium construction. It feels expressive and intentional, designed to showcase cushioning and structure as part of the aesthetic rather than hiding it.

Fans love this release because it pushes comfort into statement territory. The Vomero Premium is built for plush ride and long wear, and this colorway reinforces that through energetic and modern styling. Collectors appreciate it as a forward looking runner that reflects Nike’s willingness to experiment at the top end of its lineup, offering a shoe that feels luxurious, bold, and unmistakably contemporary.

The Nike Vomero Premium Barely Volt was released on October 16, 2025 with a retail price of $230.

title: Nike A'ja Wilson A'One Pink A'ura (Women's)
description:
The Nike A'ja Wilson A'One Pink A'ura (Women's) is A'ja Wilson's first signature shoe, dressed in pink hues, a nod to the WNBA's star leadership, confidence, and Leo energy.

The Pink A'ura (Women's) Nike A'ja Wilson A'One is built for performance and style, riding on a Cushion ST2 foam and firm base for smooth, cushioned landings and explosive responsiveness. Across the upper, the shoe showcases a breathable mesh that features gradient shades of pink, nodding to Wilson's confidence, leadership, and Leo energy. Pearl details honor her grandmother, while Celtic symbols celebrate her parents, with the right shoe dedicated to her mom and the left to her dad. Wilson's logo appears on the tongue, her signature on the heels, and a pearlized Swoosh with reflective details rounds off the design.

What our StockX experts love about the Nike A'ja Wilson A'One Pink A'ura (Women's) is the sneaker's deeply personal design, featuring symbols that pay tribute to Wilson's family and their influence on her journey. The women's sneaker sold for $110 on May 6, 2025.

title: Nike Zoom Field Jaxx Travis Scott Light Chocolate
description:
The Nike Zoom Field Jaxx Travis Scott Light Chocolate is a performance shoe designed in collaboration with American rapper Travis Scott.

The Travis Scott Light Chocolate Nike Zoom Field Jaxx features an off-white mesh base thickly woven for extra visual texture. This mesh makes up the toe box and sides. White leather overlays form the toe cap, mudguard, eyestays, ankle strap, and heel area, while the mudguard is separated from the rest by a thin cream strip. A forefoot strap also appears over the laces in white leather, while Shark branding is seen underneath it on the inner side. The Nike swoosh crosses the sides in a Light Chocolate brown color, while the tongue also bears Cactus Jack branding in Light Chocolate. The Nike swoosh appears as the mouth inside a drawn face on the heel, and the shoe sits on a branded brown midsole complete with Air technology.

What we like best about this sneaker is the unique branding, including the face on the heel. The Nike Zoom Field Jaxx Travis Scott Light Chocolate will be released in January 2025 for $170.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Royal Reimagined
description:
Old meets the new with the Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Royal Reimagined'. This sneaker reignites the iconic Jordan 1 colorway with a fresh material makeover, showcasing a premium Royal Blue and Black suede. The nostalgic Black/Royal Blue/White colorway carries the torch of the Jordan legacy, making a bold statement of evolution without losing an ounce of its original charisma.

The genius lies in the details. The full suede treatment of the OG colorway, coupled with sleek suede Swoosh overlays, dances along the fine line between reverence for the past and the audacity of the present​. The Wings logos on the padded ankle collars and Nike Air tags on the tongues are a nod to its illustrious lineage, while the cushioned ankle collar promises a comfy stride into the future.

The Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Royal Reimagined' is a step into a narrative crafted meticulously by Jordan Brand. Available on November 4, 2023, at a retail price of $180, it's a statement of how the legendary can be reimagined without losing its essence​​. Grab a pair, and be a part of a legacy that's as fearless and unyielding as the Jordan Brand.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Mojave
description:
The Air Jordan 11 Retro "Mojave" (2025) brings the 11 silhouette into a new terrain. Dressed in canyon purple, off noir, violet dust, and medium soft pink, the suede-rich upper pulls inspiration from dusk-lit desert rock walls and Las Vegas night skies. Reflective piping, a tonal Jumpman, and gold carbon-fiber accents nod to the city lights and luxury of the Strip.

Showcased as part of the AJ11’s 30th-anniversary collection, this release isn’t just another re-run, it’s a themed reinterpretation rooted in place and mood. The choice of nubuck and texture over the usual patent leather gives it an unexpected edge, making the silhouette feel fresh and intentional rather than simply nostalgic.

When the Air Jordan 11 Retro "Mojave" (2025) released, it retailed for $250 and dropped on November 22, 2025 at ComplexCon. With striking purple tones and desert-inspired design, it’s one of those limited-region pieces that speaks to collectors and style-seekers alike.

title: Supreme Hanes Bones Thermal Crew FW25 (1 Pack) White
description:
The Supreme Hanes Bones Thermal Crew FW25 White offers the same everyday comfort with a lighter and more graphic forward presentation. The white base creates strong contrast against the bones artwork, making the design feel sharper and more visible. It keeps the familiar thermal fit and feel, designed for layering while adding visual interest through print rather than construction.

Fans love this version because it feels clean but expressive. The white colorway brings a different energy to the bones graphic, making it stand out while remaining easy to wear. Collectors appreciate Supreme’s continued focus on essentials, seeing pieces like this as proof that even the most basic garments can carry personality and cultural relevance when executed with intent.

title: Jordan 1 Low Panda (Women's)
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Panda (2023) (W) arrives in a white, black, and white color palette.

The Low Panda Jordan 1 (2023) (W) has an upper that is constructed from durable materials, including a combination of supple leather and suede. The shoe's cushioned midsole and supportive collar ensure a comfortable fit. The outsole is made of a durable rubber material with a traditional tread pattern, providing traction and stability. The shoe's toe box is perforated for ventilation. The sneaker features black Swoosh branding on either lateral side, the Jumpman logo on the tongue, and the Air Jordan Wings logo on the heel.

The women’s rendition of the Air Jordan 1 Low Panda (2023) (W) was released on March 10, 2023, and sold for a retail price of $110.

title: Jordan 14 Retro Black Toe (2024)
description:
The Jordan 14 Retro Black Toe (2024) is a triumphant return for the iconic AJ14 trainer. This updated design features premium materials, which gives it a stunning visual effect of sleek luxury. Its low-to-the-ground style was inspired by sports car ground effect aerodynamics.

This Air Jordan 14 has been remodeled for the present day, with a mottled leather ice-white upper punctuated by wavy panels of midnight black. The sole has white claws reaching across the distinctive black toe to create a dramatic effect. The shoe also has the latest Nike Air Zoom cushioning unit.

This shoe has always been special, being the model that Michael Jordan wore when he made his last basket in the NBA. Our reviewers not only appreciate the upgrade; they also find it irresistible collectible. It's a milestone trainer to have in one's collection. The Jordan 14 Retro Black Toe (2024) was released on 2 November 2024, priced at $210.

title: adidas ZX 8000 Consortium Yellow Blue Glow
description:
The adidas ZX 8000 Consortium Yellow Blue Glow revives one of adidas’ most celebrated technical runners through expressive color and collaborative framing. While chalk white tones create a clean base, the yellow and blue glow accents inject energy that highlights the layered construction. The ZX 8000 silhouette remains unmistakably technical, built around structure and movement rather than minimalism.

Fans appreciate Consortium releases because they emphasize creativity within adidas’ archive. The ZX 8000 has long been a canvas for bold color stories, and this version continues that tradition with clarity and contrast. It stands as a vibrant interpretation of a classic runner, reaffirming the ZX line’s place in sneaker history through confident design choices and collaborative intent.

The adidas ZX 8000 Consortium Yellow Blue Glow was released on January 27, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Jubilee 25th Anniversary
description:
In 2020, Jordan Brand celebrated 25 years of one of their most popular models, the Jordan 11. To commemorate the famed silhouette, Michael Jordan and Nike released the Jordan 11 Jubilee. The sneaker’s distinct colorway was inspired by original sketches from the designer of the 1995 sneaker, Tinker Hatfield.

The Jordan 11 Jubilee showcases everything Hatfield envisioned for the sneaker 25 years ago; a performance product that can be worn easily both on and off the court. Features such as the two types of leather on the upper with hits of metallic lettering and Jumpman emblem add luxe elements to the athletic sneaker. A white midsole and foggy translucent outsole deliver contrast to the black sneaker. Carbon fiber plating on the sole provides stability and power to the wearer’s feet on the court.

The Jordan 11 Jubilee 25th Anniversary released in December of 2020 for $220.

title: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Black Toe (2023)
description:
The Jordan 1 Retro Low Black Toe, dropped on July 29, 2023, and presents a blend of classic and contemporary, It’s a style that carries the proud legacy of its predecessors.

The upper of the Jordan 1 Retro Low showcases a striking blend of premium black and white leathers, accented by a vibrant red heel counter. Classic elements, such as the iconic Swoosh and the timeless 'Wings' logo, are in black, tying the whole look together. All this sits atop a clean, white midsole, proving that simplicity can still make a statement.

The Jordan 1 Retro Low Black Toe landed on the market on July 29, 2023, at a retail price of $140.

title: Nike Book 1 Valley
description:
The Nike Book 1 Valley captures Devin Booker’s connection to Phoenix through a colorway that feels warm, grounded, and personal. The Book 1 silhouette is sleek and controlled, and the Valley theme leans into desert inspired tones that reflect the identity of the city and the calm confidence Booker brings to the court. The mix of sail, clay orange, and court purple feels intentional, giving the shoe a sense of place rather than just another performance look.

Fans love this pair because it feels authentic to Booker’s story. The Book 1 is designed around balance, precision, and rhythm, and this colorway reinforces that mindset visually. Collectors appreciate how the Valley execution turns a signature sneaker into a narrative piece, one that celebrates environment and identity while still delivering a clean and wearable design that fits naturally into both on court and off court rotation.

The Nike Book 1 Valley was released on May 15, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Verdy Visty
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Verdy Visty is a fresh and playful take on the iconic SB Dunk model, brought to life through a collaboration with Japanese artist Verdy. This eye-catching sneaker takes inspiration from Verdy’s character, "VISTY," blending creativity and street style in a standout design. The color palette is a pastel dream, with blue gaze, light arctic pink, and bicycle yellow tones adding a whimsical touch to the classic silhouette.

One of the most unique aspects of the Verdy Visty Dunk is its mix of materials. The fuzzy, hairy texture on the toe box, mid panel, tongue, and heel collar adds dimension and personality to the sneaker, while the pink leather Nike swoosh adds a smooth contrast. The pastel blue corduroy upper rounds out the design, giving the shoe a vintage, yet modern aesthetic. The yellow midsole and matching laces bring an extra pop of color, making this Dunk an instant standout whether you're skating or styling.

Released on September 19, 2024, the Nike SB Dunk Low Verdy Visty retailed at $135. The VISTY character makes a fun appearance on the inside tag and even comes with a special keychain, adding a personal touch to each pair. For those looking to combine fashion, art, and skate culture, this sneaker is the perfect way to express your individuality.

title: New Balance 1906L Metallic Silver
description:
The New Balance 1906L Metallic Silver reimagines the 1906 as a slip-on loafer. This hybrid sneaker showcases a futuristic color palette of metallic silver and grey.

Seamlessly blending New Balance’s technical specs with the design requirements of a loafer, the Metallic Silver New Balance 1906L is lace-free. With N-ergy cushioning underfoot for shock absorption, the sneaker offers long-lasting comfort. The upper is crafted from a loose weave mesh that ensures durability, while the metallic silver accents draw attention to the supportive overlays. Although the sneaker doesn’t need laces, a traditional loafer apron crosses the tongue. It features a silver metallic sheen that matches the collar.

While many loafers include a tassel hanging over the vamp, this version doesn’t include a tassel. Our experts appreciate this exclusion because it maintains the sneaker’s sporty aesthetic. The New Balance 1906L Metallic Silver was released on September 19, 2024, and sold for $150.

title: ASICS Gel-1130 White Black Silver
description:
The ASICS Gel 1130 White Black Silver delivers a clean and balanced take on one of ASICS’ most quietly influential retro runners. The white base paired with black and silver accents highlights the Gel 1130’s layered early 2000s design language, giving it a technical look that feels timeless rather than trend driven. It sits comfortably in that space where performance heritage meets everyday wear, making it instantly familiar to longtime ASICS fans.

Collectors appreciate this pair because it represents the Gel 1130 at its purest. The color blocking lets the structure and cushioning inspired design do the work, offering versatility without losing character. It’s a shoe people love for its reliability and understated style, one that fits effortlessly into rotation while reflecting the growing appreciation for functional aesthetics and retro running silhouettes in modern sneaker culture.

The ASICS Gel 1130 White Black Silver was released on June 9, 2023 with a retail price of $95.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 White Metallic Silver
description:
Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 White Metallic Silver delivers a crisp and confident take on the Supreme SB legacy by pairing clean white tones with metallic silver accents. The colorway feels sharp and deliberate, highlighting the SB Dunk’s classic proportions while giving it a polished edge. It reflects Supreme’s ability to elevate simple ideas through precision rather than excess.

What makes this pair special is its versatility within the Supreme SB lineage. The restrained palette allows the shoe to move easily between skate heritage and lifestyle wear, making it appealing to collectors who value longevity. It feels like a release designed to stand the test of time, rewarding fans who appreciate subtlety and cultural continuity over trend driven design.

title: Polo Ralph Lauren Double-Knit Full-Zip Hoodie and Double-Knit Jogger Pant Set Polo Black
description:
The Polo Ralph Lauren Double-Knit Full-Zip Hoodie and Double-Knit Jogger Pant Set Polo Black is a two-piece set featuring a Black zip front hoodie with drawstring hood and black tapered leg cuffed jogger pants. The Polo embroidered logo appears on the upper left of the chest and pant leg in white, and additional branding appears inside the collar and waistband.

American designer Ralph Lauren started his Polo imprint in 1968 while he was still working for a men’s tie manufacturer. In 1971, the embroidered Polo emblem was introduced, going on to become an iconic branding element that is still in use today. Over the years, Polo Ralph Lauren and its various offshoots have become known for their expressive boutiques around the world and classic American style.

Our experts feel that the best feature of the Double Knit Hoodie and Jogger Set is the color palette, which is chic and versatile. The Polo Ralph Lauren Double-Knit Full-Zip Hoodie and Double-Knit Jogger Pant Set Polo Black retailed at $263 upon release.

title: Nike Air DT Max '96 Falcons
description:
The Nike Air DT Max '96 Falcons is a premium sneaker that pays homage to coach and former NFL player Deion Sanders’s early career with the Atlanta Falcons.

The Falcons Nike Air DT Max '96 upper is crafted from ultra-soft, black nubuck with accents in Team Anthracite, Fire Red, and white. This color scheme represents the Falcons’ team colors and celebrates one of Georgia’s top NFL teams. Embroidered in Fire Red and white thread, "21" appears on the heel—a nod to Sanders’s Falcons jersey number. Other Fire Red details include the collar lining, the heel pull tabs, the miniature Swoosh logos near the ankle, and the tongue pull tab. In terms of technology, visible Air Max cushioning provides comfort underfoot.

Our experts at StockX like that this sneaker is the first DT Max to display Sanders’s jersey number. The Nike Air DT Max '96 Falcons was released on November 15, 2024, and sold for $170.

title: Nike Vomero Plus Doernbecher Molly Bell (Women's)
description:
The Nike Vomero Plus Doernbecher Molly Bell Womens turns performance footwear into a canvas for personal storytelling. The Multi Color upper reflects Molly Bell creative vision, blending bold tones and layered graphics into a vibrant composition. The sculpted midsole maintains the cushioning and support the Vomero line is known for.

Doernbecher collaborations hold a special place within Nike history, giving young designers the opportunity to share their stories through design. Each pair carries emotional weight, and this edition stands out through its expressive palette and thoughtful details. For collectors who value purpose driven releases, this shoe represents creativity and resilience woven into a performance silhouette.

title: Jordan 6 Retro Olympic (2024)
description:
Originally released in 2000, then retro'd again in 2012, the Jordan 6 Retro Olympic (2024) is a classic colorway of a fan-favorite silhouette. Released during the Paris Olympics, the sneaker's colorway pays homage to the red, white, and blue of the United States.

Debuting in 1991, the Jordan 6 has donned many iconic colorways, but the Olympic color is perhaps once of the most desired and recognizable. This 2024 release marks the 3rd time this sneaker has released, which has come only once every 12 years (2000, 2012, and 2024). The white upper with midnight navy accepts and varsity red touches bring this classic style to life.

The Jordan 6 Retro Olympic (2024) released on August 3rd, 2024, for a retail price of $200. Lock in this OG classic today on StockX.

title: New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Black

The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Black leans fully into deconstructed aesthetics, highlighting raw edges and layered textures that have defined the Protection Pack identity. The Protection Pack reframed how people viewed unfinished design, and this black version amplifies that philosophy through restraint and depth. title: New Balance 9060 Moonbeam Sea Salt

The outer sole is made from a grey rubber sole, with the midsole uses Abzorb and SBS cushioning. The heel has a translucent CR fitting, while the tongue logo uses jewels inspired by the 991 sneaker. The shoe’s look is complemented with grey insole and lining, rain cloud laces, and punched eyelets at the throat.

title: Jordan 8 Retro Playoffs (2023)
description:
Introducing a legend reborn: the Jordan 8 Retro Playoffs. Cloaked in a sophisticated Black, True Red, and White colorway, this iconic shoe is a trip down memory lane for any sneakerhead. If you're looking for legendary, this is it. Donned by the GOAT himself during his epic 1993 playoff run with the Chicago Bulls, this pair is as iconic as it gets.

Crafted with premium materials, the upper showcases a blend of textures. Rewind back to '93, and envision MJ's killer moves during his monumental playoff journey with the Chicago Bulls.
