First released in 1999, the original Wu-Tang Dunk High was one of the earliest examples of a sneaker partnership with a music group, setting the stage for the future of sneaker culture. Finished in the Wu-Tang Clan's signature black and goldenrod color scheme, this 2024 retro release stays true to the original with its bold, eye-catching design. The custom Wu-Tang logo on the heel and tongue label remains an iconic detail, paying tribute to the group's legacy.

The Wu-Tang Dunk High features a premium leather upper in striking black and yellow, giving the sneaker a high-quality look and feel. Its classic high-top design offers support and comfort, making it perfect for both casual wear and street style. The sneaker’s retro roots, combined with the Wu-Tang Clan’s influence on music and culture, make this an essential addition for fans of both hip-hop and sneaker culture. Nike’s return of this historic design is sure to draw significant attention from collectors and enthusiasts alike.

Released on September 28, 2024, the Nike Dunk High Wu-Tang retailed for $150. This limited-edition sneaker is not just a piece of footwear—it’s a cultural artifact that celebrates the intersection of music and fashion, making it one of the year’s most highly anticipated releases.

title: New Balance 990v4 MiUSA Grey Silver
description:
The New Balance 990v4 Made in USA Grey Silver is a part of the 990 series, which is well-known for its quality, comfort, and timeless aesthetic.

The New Balance 990v4 Grey Silver comes with an upper in different tones of Grey. With an upper crafted from a combination of premium pigskin suede and breathable mesh, it is durable, ventilated, and flexible, allowing for a wide range of movement. The mesh and suede parts come in a light grey colorway, and details of darker grey outline the mesh parts. The iconic " N" logo on the side of the shoe follows the same grey colorway. And ENCAP midsole technology provides a superior level of support and cushioning with its dual-density foam system.

But what our experts love most about the New Balance 990v4 Made in USA Grey Silver is the ABZORB technology set in the midsole to absorb shocks and reduce the impact of your steps. These shoes have been keeping feet stylish and comfortable since their release on June 2, 2023, for a price of $185.

title: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Silver University Red

This men's sneaker showcases a sleek design that combines style and performance. The upper features a metallic silver base, accented with bold university red details, creating a visually appealing contrast. The shoe's construction incorporates a mix of materials, including breathable mesh and supportive overlays, ensuring both comfort and durability for everyday wear. Designed with the runner in mind, the Zoom Vomero 5 boasts Nike's innovative Zoom Air technology in the midsole. This responsive cushioning system provides excellent energy return and impact protection, making it ideal for long-distance runs or casual outings. The shoe's outsole features a strategic traction pattern, offering reliable grip on various surfaces. With its eye-catching colorway and performance-driven features, this Nike Zoom Vomero 5 is a versatile option for both athletic pursuits and street-style fashion. Our team thinks this product is great for runners seeking a balance of style and functionality. The combination of responsive cushioning and trendy design makes it an excellent choice for both performance and casual wear.

title: adidas Harden Vol. 9 Flamingo Pink
description:

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Midnight Navy

The Midnight Navy Jordan 1 Retro High OG features a base of calf leather in white, which makes up the perforated toebox and the side panels. title: Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Medium Olive

model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi
description:
Japanese designer Rei Kawakubo is one of the most prolific fashion designers of all time. Aside from her Comme des Garçons collections, she has had numerous sneaker collaborations over the years. One of the most outstanding of these collaborations involves her different iterations of work modifying and styling up the Converse Chuck Taylor with her sub-label Comme des Garçons PLAY. Kawakubo’s first iteration of his Converse Chuck Taylors came about in 2009 when she modified the original by stripping back its contrast stitching. Six years later, in 2015, she took the All Star Chuck 70s as her template and created a shoe so beloved that it has been re-released every year since.

The most immediately recognizable thing in shoes from the Comme des Garçons PLAY line is their heart and eyes logo, originally conceived and created by Filip Pagowski. Unlike the original 2009 version, however, the 2015 version and every version thereafter has moved away from the original minimalist philosophy that inspired Kawakubo to start this line of collaborations. The Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70s Hi Comme des Garçons PLAY harks back to the classic 70s Chuck Taylor style but with a high-top collar that snugly hugs the ankles and a black upper, white laces and a white sole and toe cap.

The Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70s Hi Comme des Garçons PLAY Black was released in March of 2019 and retailed for $125.

The ventilation holes ensure breathability, while the slip-on fit and lightweight construction make it an easy go-to sneaker. The simple yet refined colorway ensures versatility, pairing well with a variety of outfits.

Releasing on January 29, 2025, the Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Light Orewood Brown retailed for $70. Blending comfort, performance, and aesthetics, this sneaker is a must-have for those who prioritize both function and style.

title: Nike Dunk Low Harris Tweed White Black Multi (Women's)
description:
Nike Dunk Low Harris Tweed White Black Multi Womens transforms the classic Dunk Low silhouette with a textured twist, layering traditional Harris Tweed fabric over the clean lines that made the shoe a staple. The white and black base keeps the look grounded, while the multi color tweed introduces subtle complexity that feels refined and elevated. It feels like a thoughtful blend of heritage material and streetwear energy rather than a rushed trend piece.

Collectors appreciate this release because it highlights how sneakers can carry tactile narrative as well as visual style. The Dunk Low has always been a canvas for experimentation, and pairing it with Harris Tweed gives the shoe the feeling of purpose and context. It’s the kind of design that invites closer inspection and rewards fans who value craft and texture in addition to silhouette history.

The Nike Dunk Low Harris Tweed White Black Multi Womens was released on 09/03/2025 with a retail price of $135.

title: Nike KD 4 Aunt Pearl (2024)
description:
The Nike KD 4 Aunt Pearl (2024) is a re-release of one of the most beloved colorways in the KD 4 series. Paying tribute to Kevin Durant’s late Aunt Pearl, this sneaker features a striking pinkfire 2 colorway with black and metallic silver accents. Beyond its eye-catching design, the Aunt Pearl edition holds deep sentimental value, honoring Durant's aunt who passed away from cancer. The pink hue symbolizes strength and hope, making this sneaker a tribute to those fighting the battle against cancer.

The Aunt Pearl originally debuted as part of Nike’s efforts to raise cancer awareness, and its re-release brings back all the emotional and cultural impact it had on the sneaker world. The pink colorway stands out, while the details like the metallic silver swoosh and unique KD branding remind fans why this is one of the most sought-after KD sneakers ever released.

Released on October 3, 2024, the Nike KD 4 Aunt Pearl (2024) retailed for $130. This re-release brings back all the emotional weight and iconic design that made the original Aunt Pearl KD 4 so special, making it a must-cop for sneakerheads.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Yellow Ochre
description:
The Jordan 1 Retro High OG in Yellow Ochre/Black/Sail is a vibrant celebration of the Air Jordan legacy. This edition's Yellow Ochre colorway brings an electrifying twist to the classic silhouette, making it a standout piece in any sneaker collection.

Accented with Black and Sail, the sneaker's bold Yellow Ochre hue ensures that it's not just another pair of Jordans; it's a fashion statement. Crafted with excellence, this sneaker combines high-quality materials and comfort, embodying the spirit of Michael Jordan's legendary performance.

Released on January 13, 2024, with a retail tag of $180, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Yellow Ochre is a piece of sneaker history, a canvas of artistry, and a symbol of enduring style. It's a must-have for those who value both legacy and contemporary fashion.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Futura Laboratories Bleached Aqua
description:
Step into a world of art and innovation with the Nike SB Dunk Low Futura Laboratories Bleached Aqua. This sneaker is a masterpiece, blending iconic street art with top-tier skateboarding functionality. The canvas upper features a vibrant mix of Bleached Aqua, Geode Teal, and White, adorned with the dynamic strokes and splashes reminiscent of Futura's signature street art. The design reflects a seamless fusion of creativity and urban edge, with Futura's distinctive signature and the "FL" emblem proudly displayed on the heel

Designed for both visual appeal and performance, this collaboration with Futura Laboratories enhances the SB Dunk Low with a lightweight, durable canvas that supports both casual wear and skateboarding demands. The responsive cushioning and stable, low-profile outsole ensure comfort and functionality without compromising the sneaker's artistic flair. It's a tribute to both Futura’s revolutionary artistry and Nike’s commitment to quality.

Released on May 18, 2024, the Nike SB Dunk Low Futura Laboratories Bleached Aqua retailed for $135. This release captivated both art aficionados and sneakerheads alike, offering a unique piece of wearable art that stands out in any collection. Each step in these sneakers is a step in a modern art gallery, showcasing the enduring legacy of Futura and the innovative spirit of Nike SB.

title: Jordan 13 Retro Gym Red Flint Grey
description:
Jordan flipped one of the most popular Jordan 13 colorways of all time to create a new colorway with the Air Jordan 13 Red Flint. The Red Flint draws its inspiration from the often re-issued Air Jordan 13 Flint, remixing to the iconic colorway.

The Air Jordan 13 Red Flint features an upper made of red reflective mesh, white leather, and Flint Durabuck. In line with Jordan 13s of the past, a holographic Jumpman emblem is displayed on the lateral ankle. An embroidered Jumpman insignia on the tongue, and a Flint and white sole complete this Jordan 13.

The Jordan 13 Red Flint released in April of 2021 and retailed for $190.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Wizards
description:
Jordan Brand is paying homage to the final stages of Michael Jordan's NBA playing career with the Washington Wizards, with the release of the Jordan 3 Retro Wizards.

The Jordan 3 Retro Wizards features a similar design compared to the Air Jordan 3 Retro True Blue, but with a few twists. Jordan Brand used orange across the lace eyelets and Jumpman logo on the tongue compared to the red color scheme on the Air Jordan 3 True Blue.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Wizards released April 29, 2023, with a retail price of $210.

title: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Away
description:
The Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Away is a bold new release that combines legendary performance with iconic Lakers flair. Featuring a sleek black engineered knit upper, this colorway brings the energy of a Lakers away game to the court. Gold embroidered Nike swooshes and Kobe Bryant’s signature in gold on the black heel clip add a touch of luxury, while the white outsole provides contrast against the black midsole. This Lakers-inspired colorway brings the competitive intensity of Kobe's road performances to life.

As part of the Kobe Protro line, the Kobe 8 continues to offer cutting-edge technology while paying homage to one of the most beloved basketball sneakers ever made. The Protro updates include advanced cushioning and materials, making this sneaker a top choice for athletes and sneakerheads alike. The performance-driven design, combined with the sleek look of the Lakers Away colorway, makes this a standout addition to any Kobe collection.

Released on September 6, 2024, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Away retailed at $190. The black, university gold, white, and court purple colorway pays tribute to the Lakers’ iconic uniforms. Whether on the court or in your rotation, this Kobe 8 Protro is a must-have for fans of the Black Mamba and basketball culture.

title: New Balance 9060 Pink Overdye
description:
The New Balance 9060 Pink Overdye is an athletic shoe featuring an upper in Pink. A Pink mesh fabric base is overlaid with curved and geometric overlays in multiple textures of Pink suede. The New Balance N logo is smooth and shiny on the exterior, countered by striped N branding on the interior. The ABZORB branded midsole in Pink juts throughout a white base, finished by a Pink outsole. 

American athletic shoe brand New Balance was founded in 1906, and the company is known for their running-focused sneakers. The 9060 style debuted post-2020, and its design references the understated 990 and blends it with early 2000s styling. The New Balance 9060 Pink Overdye released on July 24, 2024, and retailed for $150.

title: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Pink Foam (Women's)
description:
The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Pink Foam (Women's) adds metallic-silver accents to the upper and splashes of Pink Foam across the sole unit.

The layered sneaker, Photon Dust Pink Foam (Women's) Nike Zoom Vomero 5, finds inspiration in running shoes from the early 2000s, which can be seen in the synthetic leather overlays and the plastic caging on the side panels. The synthetic leather allows the metallic silver to shine, while reflective accents provide visibility in low lighting. The combination of loose weave mesh in Pure Platinum and ventilation ports on the heel allows the foot to breathe and stay cool. In terms of technology, snappy Zoom Air cushioning adds a responsive feel, and the rubber outsole grips the ground.

Our experts at StockX like the straightforward logo tag, which displays "NIKE VOMERO 5" lettering and matches the black accents across the shoe. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Pink Foam (Women's) was originally released on August 1, 2024, and sold for $160.

title: adidas Campus Light Bad Bunny Chalky Brown
description:
The adidas Campus Light Bad Bunny Chalky Brown is a notable collaboration between adidas and the Latin music superstar – Bad Bunny. The sneaker adopts a classic low-top silhouette with clean lines in a blend of and beige, brown, and Cream White hues.

The Bad Bunny Chalky Brown adidas Campus Light incorporates a brown suede upper with a textured finish, complemented by matching 3-Stripe branding. It also features a unique double-tongue construction. The shoe boasts an updated cream-colored rubber mudguard that transitions seamlessly from a wavy pattern into a sturdy rubber cup sole. Underneath, the outsole showcases a herringbone traction pattern for reliable grip. The branding is minimalistic, with the iconic adidas 3-Stripes on the sides and Bad Bunny's recognizable logo on the tongue.

What our experts find most impressive about the adidas Campus Light Bad Bunny Chalky Brown is the collaboration between the giant sportswear brand and the Latin music superstar Bad Bunny. This sneaker represents a fusion of Bad Bunny's distinctive style and the classic adidas Campus silhouette, making it ideal for fans of both fashion and music. The adidas sneaker debuted for $160 on July 29th, 2023.

title: adidas Handball Spezial Valentine's Day (2026) (Women's)
Birkenstock Arizona Birkibuc Mocha
description:
The Birkenstock Arizona Birkibuc Mocha offers a laid-back look and dependable comfort in a silhouette that has been defining style since its debut in 1973.

The Mocha colorway of the Birkenstock Arizona Birkibuc features a dual-strap upper crafted from warm brown synthetic Birkibuc leather. Each strap that closes across the foot is adjustable with metal pin buckles for a secure and comfortable fit. The mocha suede foot bed with black Birkenstock branding adds a slice of additional comfort underfoot, while the lightweight dark brown EVA outsole is grooved to provide grip with every step. Birkenstock branding also appears debossed in black on the medial side of the upper near the heel, adding a note of distinction.

The aspect of this comfortable and stylish sandal that we appreciate most is the contoured cork-latex footbed that has been designed to conform to your foot and offer custom support as you wear the sandal. The Birkenstock Arizona Birkibuc Mocha was released on September 6, 2022, for $110 retail.

title: Bravest Studios Bear Claw Mule Red
Jordan 2 Retro OG Chicago (2022)
description:
2022 was unofficially dubbed the Year of the Jordan 2, as Jordan Brand brought back the classic Air Jordan 2 Chicago in its true OG form. The Air Jordan 2 Chicago reps the same historic colorway worn by Michael Jordan during his 1986-1987 season with the Bulls. The sneaker features white reptile-embossed leather uppers, Varsity Red reptile spine design on the heel, and Varsity Red signature Wings logo on the tongue. A black midsole and "NIKE" debossed branding on the heel tab ties up this signature silhouette.

The Air Jordan 2 Chicago retro released in December of 2022 for $200.

title: Bravest Studios Bear Claw Mule Chief Keef x Glo Gang Glorange
description:
The Bravest Studios Bear Claw Mule Chief Keef x Glo Gang Glorange turns footwear into pure statement by leaning fully into bold personality and cultural energy. The exaggerated bear claw design is intentionally wild, and the Glorange colorway amplifies that attitude with unmistakable presence. This collaboration feels rooted in Chief Keef’s unapologetic style, where individuality and shock value are part of the point rather than something to soften.

Collectors love this mule because it breaks every traditional rule of sneaker design. It is not about subtlety or versatility, it is about expression. Fans of Bravest Studios appreciate how the brand consistently leans into absurdity and culture crossover, making pieces that feel more like wearable art than footwear. This pair resonates with people who want their shoes to spark conversation and reflect fearless self expression.

The Bravest Studios Bear Claw Mule Chief Keef x Glo Gang Glorange was released on April 18, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

title: Nike Air Max 90 Black Sport Red
description:
Since its release, the Nike Air Max 90 Black Sport Red has become a recognizable model in the Nike Air Max collection.

The Nike Air Max 90 Black Sport Red is under the DC9388-002 style and is made of synthetic leather, rubber, and suede. It features white shoelaces with a red "Air Max" branded at the quarter below the swoosh. The tongue is branded with 'Air Max,' a white swoosh written on 'Nike.' The toe box is made of a black mesh with a black suede toe.

The Nike Air Max 90 Black Sport Red was released on October 26th, 2021 at a retail price of $120.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Mid SP Off-White Varsity Maize
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Mid SP Off White Varsity Maize represents a collaboration between Nike and Virgil Abloh’s fashion house Off-White. This sneaker takes an iconic silhouette and a retro colorway and infuses it with hallmark Off-White creativity.​
​​
​The Off White X Nike Air Force 1 Mid-Top Varsity Maize SP sports an upper with a base of tumbled white leather and perforations in the toe box. The overlays and ankle strap are maize-colored tumbled leather, while the side-panel Nike swoosh is white tumbled leather. The laces are maize and an extra pair of white laces threads through fly cables on the upper. The white foam midsole houses visible Air and sits atop a maize rubber outsole where the classic AF1 traction pattern has been enhanced with track spikes.​
​​
​What we love most about this creative shoe is the Off-White branding. Characteristic Off-White text appears on the medial upper while a white grim reaper graphic is embroidered on the lateral heel. The Nike Air Force 1 Mid SP Off White Varsity Maze was released on November 9, 2023, for a retail price of $205.

title: Nike Kobe 1 Protro City of Champions
Jordan 4 Retro Lightning (2021)
description:
Originally released in 2006, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Lightning (2021) is one of the most renowned retro Jordan 4 colorways in Jordan Brand's catalog. It features a Tour Yellow Durabuck upper with black netted panels and dark grey eyelets. On the tongue, a black Jordan Flight logo patch with white and yellow accents complements the upper. From there, a Jumpman logo on the heel tab and white midsole with a visible Air unit completes the design.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro Lightning (2021) released in August of 2021 and retailed for $220.

title: Vans Premium Authentic La Habana Green Blue
adidas Harden Vol. 9 Cyber Metallic
description:
Fresh and futuristic, the adidas Harden Vol 9 Cyber Metallic sneaker is one slick-looking basketball shoe. Designed for the NBA star James Harden’s line, this cutting-edge sneaker not only looks the part but is backed by high-performance features to optimize every second on the court.

This champagne-colored metallic model of sneaker is one of adidas’ edgiest-looking designs to date. Modern and sleek, it has upper colorways combining metallic with black, ventilated cut-outs forming a snug boot fit that wraps around your foot. With minimal branding, the 3-Stripes sit subtly on the back heel, while a small embossed adidas logo sits on the front midsole. The side of the shoe has rising waves of midsoles that are cushioned with LIGHTBOOST. High-traction outsoles provide great courtside stability.

These adidas basketball trainers are so futuristic in both look and technique, and if that’s not enough, we also just love the cut-aways in the uppers, giving it a truly unique appearance. The adidas Harden Vol 9 Cyber Metallic is a responsive and explosive shoe that was released on 25 January 2025, priced at $160.

title: Sprayground 3AM Riptide DLXSV Backpack Pink
Nike Ja 3 King of the Court (GS)
description:
The Nike Ja 3 King of the Court GS leans into dominance and confidence, using a darker and more aggressive color palette to emphasize Ja Morant’s on court presence. Black and white tones anchor the design, while bright crimson and cobalt bliss accents inject intensity that feels competitive and sharp. The Ja 3’s low profile and quick look reinforce the idea of control and authority in motion.

Fans love this release because it feels powerful. The King of the Court theme aligns perfectly with Ja’s fearless mentality, turning the shoe into a statement about leadership and confidence. Collectors appreciate how this colorway gives the Ja 3 a more serious tone, making it a favorite for players who want their footwear to reflect edge, focus, and competitive drive rather than flash alone.

The Nike Ja 3 King of the Court GS was released on October 16, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

title: Jordan 8 Retro Aqua (2025) (GS)
description:
The Jordan 8 Retro Aqua (2025) (GS) revives a fan-favorite color story with bold, court-born details made for everyday wear. Dressed in Black/True Red/Iron Grey with vivid Bright Concord and Aquatone hits, this grade school take channels the unmistakable "Aqua" energy through painted midsole accents and the plush, chenille Jumpman on the tongue. Premium leather and nubuck overlays pair with the model’s signature crisscross midfoot straps for a locked-in feel, while the inner bootie delivers a snug, sock-like fit that’s easy to slip on and off. Sculpted padding around the collar supports growing feet, and the heel pull tab streamlines on-the-go moments from school days to weekend activities.

Underfoot, encapsulated Air cushioning helps soften landings and keep steps light, backed by a durable rubber outsole with multi-surface traction for confident movement indoors and out. Heritage touches, like the 1993-inspired brushstroke midsole graphics and the Style code 305368-006, signal the legacy of the Air Jordan 8, now refreshed for 2025 with proportions tuned to GS sizing. Whether styled with athletic gear or casual fits, the Aqua palette pops in any setting, making this pair a standout choice for young sneaker fans and collectors alike. With its mix of support, comfort, and eye-catching color blocking, the Jordan 8 Retro Aqua (2025) (GS) bridges iconic hoops DNA with everyday versatility.

Our team loves this product because it blends all-day comfort with classic Jordan heritage and statement-making color, making it an easy go-to for kids who want style that stands out and support that keeps up.

title: Converse SHAI 001 Winter Red
description:
The Converse SHAI 001 Winter Red brings a festive twist to Shai Gilgeous-Alexander’s first signature silhouette with a vibrant holiday palette perfect for December styling. Draped in bold red with contrasting green accents on the zipper, tongue logo, outsole, and heel, this iteration celebrates winterberries that stay bright through cold months. The sleek neoprene-like upper and sculpted sidewalls continue the SHAI 001’s modern design language while adding a seasonal twist that feels intentional and fresh.

This Winter Red colorway stands apart from earlier all-monochrome releases by weaving in festive tones without resorting to clichés. The red body and green details evoke classic holiday colors, but the overall look remains clean and wearable beyond just the season. Shai’s logo gracing the tongue and Converse branding on the heel tie the shoe to his growing legacy as a player with both on-court impact and off-court style influence.

When the Converse SHAI 001 Winter Red released, it retailed for $130 and dropped on December 11, 2025. With its bold color and thoughtful seasonal design, this edition is a standout way to celebrate style and spirit all winter long.

title: adidas AE 2 With Love
description:
The adidas AE 2 With Love brings emotion and personality into Anthony Edwards’ signature line, using color and energy to tell a more expressive story. Bright tones and bold contrast give the shoe a sense of joy and confidence, reflecting Edwards’ charisma and connection with fans. It feels playful but still serious, balancing creativity with the performance driven foundation of the AE 2 silhouette.

This pair resonates with collectors because it feels personal rather than generic. The design carries warmth and individuality, making it stand out among more traditional basketball colorways. Fans love it because it captures Edwards’ ability to compete fiercely while still bringing personality and heart to the game, turning the sneaker into an extension of his on court presence.

The adidas AE 2 With Love was released on October 4, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

title: New Balance 9060 X Black Cement
description:
The New Balance 9060 X Black Cement leans into darker tones while maintaining the bold structure of the silhouette. Finished in Black Cement and Black, the upper layers textured materials that highlight the model’s chunky and sculpted profile. The wavy midsole and dual density cushioning reinforce its performance inspired foundation.

This colorway feels grounded and confident, using subtle cement detailing to add depth without overwhelming the design. The black base keeps it easy to style, while the distinctive shape ensures it stands out. It reflects New Balance’s ongoing ability to reinterpret retro influences through modern design language.

The New Balance 9060 X Black Cement was released on August 19, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

title: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Photon Dust Purple Dynasty
description:
The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Photon Dust Purple Dynasty blends soft neutrals with rich jewel tones across its layered upper. Photon Dust and Light Smoke Grey form a smooth gradient base, while Sapphire, Dark Raisin, and Purple Dynasty accents inject vibrant depth. The enlarged Air unit reinforces the OG inspired build, giving the silhouette added presence.

Color storytelling has always been central to the Air Max 95 identity, and this mix of muted greys and bold purples feels dynamic without losing balance. The Big Bubble update makes the shoe feel closer to its roots, a detail enthusiasts immediately recognize. For fans who appreciate both heritage accuracy and expressive palettes, this version delivers on both fronts.

The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Photon Dust Purple Dynasty was released on January 6, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

title: Nike Vomero Premium Sail Coconut Milk
description:
Nike Vomero Premium Sail Coconut Milk leans into comfort focused design with a refined aesthetic that feels calm and intentional. The sail and coconut milk tones soften the Vomero’s performance roots, giving it a lifestyle friendly presence that still honors its running heritage. It feels clean, airy, and designed for long wear rather than visual noise.

Collectors appreciate this release because it represents a shift toward premium everyday footwear. The Vomero silhouette is known for cushioning and support, and this colorway makes it feel at home in casual rotations as much as athletic settings. It appeals to fans who value feel and longevity, reinforcing Nike’s ability to evolve performance models into versatile lifestyle staples.

The Nike Vomero Premium Sail Coconut Milk was released on10/02/2025 with a retail price of $230.

title: Jordan 9 Retro Boot NRG Black Light Gum
description:
First appearing in 2017, the Jordan 9 Boot Gum made its return as part of the Jordan Brand Holiday 2021 collection.

The Jordan 9 Boot Black Gum features a thick suede and mesh upper with metal loop eyelets drawing inspiration from traditional work boots. Finally, a rugged gum outsole with deep grooves enhances traction and support.

The Jordan 9 Boot Black Gum released in November of 2021 and retailed for $225.

title: Jordan 9 Retro Olive (2024)
description:
The Jordan 9 Retro Olive (2024) marks the return of a beloved, off-court colorway that has steadily grown in popularity since its debut in 1993. First introduced during Michael Jordan’s first retirement from the NBA, the Jordan 9 captured his global influence with its sleek design, despite Jordan not wearing it on the basketball court. The Olive colorway, featuring a mix of black, true red, and light olive, was an experimental shift from the usual Bulls-inspired colors, and while it initially underperformed, it has since gained a cult following.

This 2024 release aims to stay true to the original design, with premium materials and a shape that captures the sneaker’s iconic status. The black upper is paired with olive overlays, creating a rugged yet stylish look that works both on and off the court. The true red accents on the branding add a pop of color to the otherwise understated palette, making this one of the most anticipated Jordan releases of the year.

Released on November 16, 2024, the Jordan 9 Retro Olive (2024) retailed for $210. With its rich history and bold color scheme, this sneaker is perfect for Jordan fans and sneaker enthusiasts looking to add a timeless piece to their collection.

title: Jordan 11 Retro Black Barely Volt (GS)
description:
The Air Jordan 11 Retro Black Barely Volt GS injects modern energy into one of Jordan Brand’s most elegant silhouettes by pairing deep black with sharp barely volt accents. The contrast adds a futuristic edge to the Jordan 11’s flowing lines, making the shoe feel bold and contemporary while preserving its premium identity. Even in grade school sizing, the patent inspired shine and sleek structure feel impactful and confident.

Fans appreciate this release because it brings freshness to a silhouette known for refinement. The Jordan 11 has always balanced performance and style, and this colorway leans into that duality with a look that feels both aggressive and clean. Collectors love it as a modern interpretation of a classic, proving the Jordan 11 can evolve visually without losing the grace that defines it.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro Black Barely Volt GS was released on October 4, 2025 with a retail price of $185.

title: Supreme Box Logo Hooded Sweatshirt (FW25) Black
description:
The Supreme Box Logo Hooded Sweatshirt FW25 Black represents Supreme through a silhouette and graphic that have become legendary. The black colorway keeps the focus squarely on the iconic box logo, letting contrast and simplicity define the piece. It feels heavy, deliberate, and instantly recognizable, reinforcing why this hoodie remains one of the most coveted staples in streetwear history.

Fans love this release because it never tries to reinvent itself. The box logo hoodie is about consistency, scarcity, and cultural weight, and the FW25 black version delivers exactly that. Collectors value it as a cornerstone piece, one that represents Supreme’s influence across decades and continues to carry meaning through restraint rather than excess.

The Supreme Box Logo Hooded Sweatshirt FW25 Black was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $168.

title: Nike Air Max 270 Triple Black (Women's)
description:
The Nike Air Max 270 Triple Black (W) is another sleek addition to the Air Max collection. It is a sneaker made with a rubber sole and aerated top that makes sure your feet are able to breathe.

The Nike Air Max 270 release for women is displayed in black color. It features a web-like top material rubber outsole and lace-up closure. The shoe has a netted and fabricated top, a fluff midsole, and an elastic inner sole.  

The Nike Air Max 270 Triple Black (W) sneaker sold at a retail price of $150 and was out in the market on August 2, 2018.

title: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Mutant
description:
The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Mutant leans into futuristic energy with a metallic execution that highlights the silhouette’s technical complexity. Silver tones dominate the upper, giving the shoe a sharp and almost mechanical look that emphasizes structure and movement. The layered design feels dynamic, showcasing Saucony’s performance heritage through material and form.

Fans love this release because it stands out through texture and shine rather than color saturation. The ProGrid Omni 9 feels confident and modern here, appealing to collectors who enjoy running silhouettes as lifestyle statements. It reflects Saucony’s growing presence in fashion forward spaces, offering a sneaker that feels bold, experimental, and rooted in real performance history.

The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Mutant was released on July 12, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

title: Nike KD 4 Easter (2025)
description:
The Nike KD 4 Easter (2025) is a highly anticipated revival of a classic silhouette, reimagined for the modern sneaker enthusiast. This men's performance basketball shoe showcases a refreshing Mint Candy, White, and New Green colorway that perfectly captures the essence of spring. The sleek design combines style and functionality, featuring Nike's innovative technologies to enhance on-court performance while maintaining a striking aesthetic appeal.

Crafted with premium materials, the KD 4 Easter boasts a breathable upper that provides optimal ventilation during intense gameplay. The shoe's responsive cushioning system offers excellent impact protection and energy return, ensuring comfort throughout your performance. With its eye-catching pastel hues and distinctive KD branding, this sneaker is sure to turn heads both on and off the court. Our experts state this product is great for basketball players seeking a blend of retro charm and modern performance, as well as sneaker collectors looking to add a unique piece to their collection.

title: Nike Air Max 95 SB Cactus Flower
description:
The Nike Air Max 95 SB Cactus Flower reimagines the iconic wavy panels of the 95 through a skate‑influenced lens, delivering bold color blocking and everyday versatility. A crisp Summit White and Photon Dust base lets rich Cactus Flower accents pop across the eyestays and Swoosh, while Cool Grey gradients nod to the original runner’s DNA. Visible Air units in the heel and forefoot keep the ride cushioned and responsive, and the layered mesh-and-suede upper enhances breathability with structured support. Finished with a Gum Yellow outsole that adds timeless style and dependable grip, this pair bridges sport heritage with street-ready attitude in a way that feels fresh yet familiar.

Attention to detail elevates the HF7545-100 colorway from standout to must-have. The sculpted sidewalls emphasize the silhouette’s muscular lines, reflective hits catch the light after dark, and the streamlined lacing system secures a locked-in feel without bulk. Whether you’re navigating city blocks or dressing up a casual rotation, the Air Max 95 SB delivers comfort and presence in equal measure. Released on August 22, 2025, it’s a statement piece for fans of Nike SB and Air Max alike, pair it with dark denim or technical cargoes to highlight the purple and gum contrasts and let the classic cushioning do the rest.

Our team loves this product because it blends head-turning color with dependable Air Max comfort and a gum finish that wears beautifully day after day.

title: Nike Vomero Premium SP Black Mini Chrome Swoosh
description:
The Nike Vomero Premium SP Black Mini Chrome Swoosh strips the silhouette down to a sharp and minimalist execution. Black wraps the upper from heel to toe, creating a sleek base that highlights the sculpted lines. A subtle Mini Chrome Swoosh adds contrast and shine, giving the design a refined focal point against the monochrome build.

Monochrome runners often emphasize form over flash, and this SP edition leans fully into that philosophy. The small chrome detail elevates the shoe without overpowering the clean aesthetic. For collectors who favor understated footwear with subtle premium touches, this release offers a confident and polished take on the Vomero platform.

The Nike Vomero Premium SP Black Mini Chrome Swoosh was released on February 25, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Hayley Wilson
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Hayley Wilson brings bold energy to a celebrated silhouette with a palette that commands attention. Court Purple overlays play against crisp White panels and inky Black accents, while flashes of Lagoon Pulse and Doll add a striking pop that mirrors Hayley’s fearless style on the board. Crafted for daily wear and tough sessions alike, this SB Dunk Low pairs a supportive, padded tongue with a grippy rubber outsole for dependable traction. The low-profile shape keeps movement natural, and the classic Dunk lines deliver that timeless look fans crave, updated with colors that feel fresh from the first lace-up.

Skate-informed comfort is front and center, thanks to plush cushioning and a responsive feel that helps soften hard landings without sacrificing board feel. The mix of textures gives depth to the design, and the included Blue and Purple laces invite easy customization to match your vibe or highlight different tones in the colorway. Whether you’re stacking clips or elevating your everyday rotation, the Nike SB Dunk Low Hayley Wilson balances performance and style, making it a standout choice for both collectors and skaters who want their shoes to speak as loud as they ride.

Our team loves this product because it blends skate-ready comfort, eye-catching color blocking, and versatile lace options into a standout SB Dunk that’s equally at home at the park or on the street.

title: Nike Air Max 90 Valentine's Day University Red (2026)
description:
The Nike Air Max 90 Valentines Day University Red 2026 embraces bold monochrome energy in celebration of the seasonal theme. University Red covers nearly every panel of the upper, creating a vibrant and unified look that feels confident and expressive. Black accents break up the red saturation, sharpening the silhouette and highlighting key details.

Valentines themed releases often lean playful, and this all red execution captures that spirit without losing the structure of the Air Max 90. The strong color presence makes it an instant standout in any rotation. Fans who appreciate seasonal drops that remain wearable beyond a single holiday will find this version bold yet versatile enough to carry year round.

The Nike Air Max 90 Valentines Day University Red 2026 was released on January 30, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

title: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Pure Silver Slate Grey Sage
description:
The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Pure Silver Slate Grey is a running shoe that is part of ASICS' Gel-Kayano series, known for its stability and support features.

The shoes have a predominantly grey color scheme with silver overlays. The upper is crafted using mesh and synthetic materials for their breathability and lightweight properties. It also uses FluidFit technology, which is designed to adapt to the runner's foot for a personalized fit. The midsole of the shoe is white with green gel units and the outsole fully black with a pattern to improve grip and traction when running on different surfaces.

One thing we like about the shoes is the midsole, which uses a combination of Gel cushioning and ASICS' FlyteFoam technology, a lightweight and responsive foam, to provide cushioning without adding extra weight to the shoe. The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Pure Silver Slate Grey was released for retail on the 26th of January, 2023, priced at $150.
secondary_title: White Pure Silver Slate Grey Sage

title: Jordan 5 Retro Grape (2025) (GS)
description:
The Jordan 5 Retro Grape (2025) (GS) refreshes an icon with vibrant energy sized perfectly for young sneaker fans. Dressed in the White/Grape Ice–New Emerald palette, this Air Jordan 5 channels the famed "Grape" lineage with crisp white leather, a reflective tongue, and the signature lace lock for a secure, customizable fit. Translucent side netting boosts airflow, while the padded collar and plush interior cradle growing feet. Classic shark-tooth accents bite along the midsole in New Emerald, echoing the model’s fighter-jet inspiration, and the icy, translucent outsole adds a cool finish that grips with confidence from school halls to weekend adventures. 

Designed by Tinker Hatfield and revered since 1990, the Jordan 5 Retro delivers heritage style paired with modern comfort in a GS-specific build. A visible Air unit cushions every step, and durable rubber traction stands up to daily wear. The sculpted foam midsole softens landings, and the sleek profile pairs easily with uniforms, athletic gear, and casual fits alike. Marked with style code HQ7980-100 and slated for a June 21, 2025 release, this pair balances standout color with timeless design, making it a smart pick for any young rotation. 

Our team loves this product because it blends classic Air Jordan 5 details with playful Grape Ice and New Emerald pops, delivering comfort, durability, and unmistakable style for everyday wear.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentine's Day (2026) (Women's)
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentines Day 2026 Womens celebrates romance through layered pastel and deep red tones. Finished in Sail with Silt Red, Light Armory Blue, Peony, and Burgundy Crush accents, the upper plays with contrast while maintaining the AF1’s signature structure. Subtle detailing enhances the seasonal theme without overwhelming the silhouette.

Valentine themed releases often lean into expressive color, and this edition balances softness with bold touches. The mix of reds and lighter hues creates a playful yet refined aesthetic. It feels festive and wearable, carrying the spirit of the holiday into one of Nike’s most iconic designs.

The Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentines Day 2026 Womens was released on January 30, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

title: Nike Giannis Freak 7 LX All-Star Warning Label
Jordan 11 Retro Rare Air (GS)
description:
Air Jordan 11 Retro Rare Air GS brings a fresh layer of storytelling to one of Jordan Brand’s most elegant silhouettes, using subtle variation to create something that feels special rather than loud. The Rare Air concept has always been about celebrating imperfection and uniqueness, and this grade school release carries that spirit through thoughtful detailing and refined contrast. The Air Jordan 11’s sleek profile and flowing lines remain front and center, giving the shoe a premium feel that still connects to its performance roots.

Collectors are drawn to this pair because it highlights the Jordan 11’s versatility as both a court icon and a design canvas. The Rare Air approach adds depth without disrupting the silhouette’s balance, making it feel intentional and story driven. It appeals to fans who appreciate Jordan releases that reward closer inspection, proving that even subtle shifts can give a legendary model new energy and relevance.

The Air Jordan 11 Retro Rare Air GS was released on 11/05/2025 with a retail price of $190.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low White Black
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low White Black is a leather upper low-top sneaker featuring an optic White and Black color palette. The upper’s overlays and underlays are both White, connecting to a white midsole. The Nike Swoosh in Black accents the sides and coordinates with the tongue label logo, heel tab, and outsole, all done in Black.

While American sneaker brand Nike originally developed the Dunk Low as part of a university sports team outfitting initiative, it gained a new audience of skateboarders in the 1990s for its grippy sole and comfortable performance. Nike’s skateboarding division, Nike SB, began releasing a skateboarding-engineered Dunk in the early 2000s, and the White Black’s aesthetic harks to its origins as a style designed to feature team colors.

Our experts feel that the best feature of the SB Dunk Low is its perfectly balanced, high-contrast colorway. The Nike SB Dunk Low White Black was released on March 1, 2025, and retailed for $115.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Rodeo Tourmaline
description: Introducing a stylish and versatile addition to your wardrobe. This product combines contemporary design with superior craftsmanship, offering both comfort and durability for everyday wear. Crafted from high-quality materials, it features attention to detail in every aspect, from the stitching to the finish, ensuring a premium look and feel. The product's sleek silhouette and thoughtful design elements make it suitable for various occasions, whether you're dressing up for a night out or keeping it casual for a day around town. Its versatility is matched by its practicality, with functional features that enhance its usability without compromising on style. Our team of experts particularly loves this product for its ability to elevate any outfit while providing lasting comfort and quality that stands the test of time.

title: Jordan 6 Retro Infrared Salesman (TD)
Nike Vomero Plus Orange Pulse
description:
The Nike Vomero Plus Orange Pulse delivers the same comfort focused foundation in a colorway that feels fiery and dynamic. Orange pulse and hot lava tones dominate the upper, creating a sense of motion and heat that matches the Vomero Plus name. The layered construction and smooth lines keep the silhouette balanced, ensuring the bold colors feel intentional rather than chaotic.

Fans gravitate toward this pair because it feels alive. The Vomero Plus is built for long wear and support, and this colorway gives it personality that stands out in rotation. Collectors appreciate how Nike uses color to transform performance models into expressive lifestyle pieces, making this a sneaker that feels energetic, wearable, and aligned with modern design trends without sacrificing comfort.

The Nike Vomero Plus Orange Pulse was released on August 7, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

title: Nike Vomero Plus Hyper Pink Bright Crimson (Women's)
description:
The Nike Vomero Plus Hyper Pink Bright Crimson Womens brings bold energy to a silhouette built around comfort and endurance. The Vomero Plus design prioritizes cushioning and smooth transitions, and the hyper pink and bright crimson palette amplifies that experience visually. It feels fast, expressive, and modern, turning a performance rooted runner into something that confidently crosses into lifestyle wear.

Fans love this release because it blends softness and intensity so well. The cushioning focused build makes it ideal for long wear, while the vivid colorway gives it standout personality. Collectors appreciate how Nike continues to push running silhouettes into expressive territory, offering shoes that feel just as relevant on the street as they do in motion. It is a confident and energetic take on comfort driven design.

The Nike Vomero Plus Hyper Pink Bright Crimson Womens was released on August 7, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

title: Nike Kobe 3 Protro Halo
description:
The Nike Kobe 3 Protro Halo revives a pivotal chapter of Kobe Bryant’s footwear legacy with modern performance tuned for today’s game. Cloaked in an all‑white White/White/White palette, this "Halo" edition highlights the model’s signature sculpted upper and molded cage, delivering a sleek, futuristic look that stands out on court and off. A snug inner bootie teams with a padded collar to lock in your foot without sacrificing mobility, while the refined Protro approach streamlines the build for a lighter, quicker feel. Underfoot, responsive cushioning works with a stable midsole platform to provide smooth transitions from baseline to rim, and a supportive shank helps keep movements sharp when you cut, plant, and elevate. A durable, grippy outsole with a multi‑directional traction pattern bites hard on hardwood for confident footwork in every direction.

Style codes HM4351-100 / HQ9153-100 and a targeted release date of August 23, 2025, make this pair a standout for collectors and players alike. The clean monochrome finish spotlights the shoe’s intricate textures, from the raised, protective cage to the subtle layering around the toe and heel, giving the Kobe 3 Protro Halo a striking presence that pairs effortlessly with team kits or everyday fits. Thoughtful details nod to the Black Mamba’s relentless pursuit of perfection, while the updated ride balances court feel with impact protection to keep you fresh into the fourth quarter. Whether you’re chasing buckets under bright lights or styling a crisp, minimal rotation, this colorway brings refined energy and game‑ready confidence.

Our team loves this product because it blends the Kobe 3’s distinctive design language with Protro performance upgrades, delivering responsive cushioning, lockdown support, and a clean Halo finish that looks as sharp as it plays.

title: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Black Bright Crimson
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Black Bright Crimson channels pure on court aggression through a colorway that feels fast, focused, and unapologetic. The GT Cut silhouette was built for sharp guards and constant movement, and the black base paired with bright crimson accents gives it a serious competitive edge. Every curve and panel feels intentional, reinforcing the shoe’s identity as a tool for players who rely on speed, control, and split second reactions rather than flash.

Fans love this pair because it feels locked in. The color contrast highlights the shoe’s low profile shape and responsive design, making it feel aggressive without being chaotic. Collectors appreciate how the GT Cut represents a modern era of basketball footwear, where performance drives design first. This version stands out as a no nonsense option that still carries visual punch, appealing to hoopers who want their footwear to look as sharp as it performs.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Black Bright Crimson was released on December 3, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

adidas Campus 00s Bape World Cup Pack Black White

title: Jordan Spizike Low Black Cement
adidas Yeezy Foam RNR Carbon
description:
The adidas Yeezy Foam RNR Carbon, released on August 8, 2023, continues to push the boundaries of sneaker design.

adidas utilized a robust blend of foam and rubber to construct the Yeezy Foam RNR, exhibiting a slick aesthetic in a striking Carbon colorway. The shoe's innovative one-piece design delivers unparalleled comfort, while strategic perforations ensure superior breathability. This isn't just footwear, it's a nod to the relentless innovation that defines the Yeezy brand.

Bold, and supremely comfortable, the adidas Yeezy Foam RNR Carbon was introduced on August 8, 2023, at a retail price of $80.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High Court Purple White
description:
Jordan Brand added a new colorway to the silhouette that started it all with the Jordan 1 Retro High Court Purple White, now available on StockX. This release follows similar design elements as the Chicago 1, only this time replacing red with Court Purple.

This Jordan 1 consists of a white leather upper with Court Purple overlays and black detailing. A black Swoosh and Wings logo, white midsole, and Court Purple outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in April of 2020 and retailed for $170.

title: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro Halo
description:
The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro Halo honors the late basketball legend Kobe Bryant with performance-driven features and an angelic, white colorway.

Released on the athlete’s birthday and Mamba Day, the Halo Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro boasts an all-white color scheme that immortalizes Kobe. The Flyknit upper creates a locked-in feel without sacrificing breathability or flexibility, while React Foam provides responsive cushioning in the midsole.  Another performance upgrade is the exterior grip on the rubber outsole, which supports the foot’s natural movements. Like other sneakers decked out in the Halo colorway, splashes of black add contrast on both sides of the extended midsole.

Our experts at StockX like the iridescent detailing on the Swoosh logos. This inclusion brings cohesion to the low-top sneaker and the feeling of being touched by angels. The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro Halo was originally released on August 23, 2024, and retailed at $240.

title: Yeezy Gap Logo Shrunken Hoodie Dark Grey
description: Please Note: This garment is custom dyed. Each piece has a slight variation in color, tone, and pattern.

title: Nike Air Max 90 Rare Air Pale Ivory Thunder Blue
description:
The Nike Air Max 90 Rare Air Pale Ivory Thunder Blue brings subtle storytelling into the Air Max lineup by applying the Rare Air concept to a familiar runner. The pale ivory base softens the silhouette, while thunder blue accents add clarity and contrast that highlight the model’s layered panels. It feels refined and slightly experimental, designed for fans who appreciate deeper narratives within classic Nike designs.

Fans love this pair because it rewards attention without demanding it. The Rare Air treatment adds uniqueness through detail rather than loud graphics, making it feel special while remaining versatile. Collectors appreciate how this colorway feels thoughtful and balanced, offering something distinct within the Air Max 90 family that still stays true to the model’s roots and everyday wearability.

The Nike Air Max 90 Rare Air Pale Ivory Thunder Blue was released on June 30, 2025 with a retail price of $140.
secondary_title: Rare Air Pale Ivory Thunder Blue

title: New Balance 992 MiUSA Action Bronson Tiger Eye
description:
The New Balance 992 MiUSA Action Bronson Tiger Eye delivers another emotionally charged take on the iconic 992, using warm tan and red tones to create a look that feels energetic and grounded. The color story evokes movement and passion, while the classic 992 shape keeps everything balanced and wearable. It feels bold without being chaotic, driven by intention rather than excess.

Fans love this pair because it captures Action Bronson’s ability to translate feeling into design. The shoe feels alive, combining expressive color with the comfort and stability the 992 is known for. Collectors appreciate it as a statement release that still fits into rotation, blending personality, heritage, and craftsmanship into a sneaker that feels meaningful and memorable.

The New Balance 992 MiUSA Action Bronson Tiger Eye was released on September 26, 2025 with a retail price of $240.

title: Jordan 4 Retro SP A Ma Maniére Violet Ore
description:
James Whitner’s A Ma Maniére and Jordan Brand partner up for this luxury AJ 4 silhouette. The new Air Jordan 4 A Ma Maniére features a deeply rich Violet Ore and vintage cream tones. Sleek metallic pins, tonal mesh detailing and a quilted interior add luxe detailing throughout the silhouette.

The Air Jordan 4 A Ma Maniére released in November of 2022 and retailed for $225.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Champagne and Oysters (Women's)
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Champagne and Oysters Womens delivers understated luxury to one of Jordan Brand’s most iconic silhouettes, using soft tones and metallic accents to create a refined and elegant mood. The champagne inspired palette paired with subtle gold details gives the Jordan 3 a sophisticated presence, highlighting its classic shape through warmth and texture rather than contrast. It feels celebratory without being flashy, designed to be appreciated slowly.

Collectors love this release because it elevates the Jordan 3 through emotion and storytelling. The silhouette’s familiar proportions anchor the design, while the colorway adds a sense of occasion that feels personal and expressive. Fans appreciate how this pair blends heritage and elegance, offering a Jordan that feels both timeless and special for women who value meaning and refinement in their collections.

The Air Jordan 3 Retro Champagne and Oysters Womens was released on November 22, 2025 with a retail price of $205.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Satin Shadow (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Satin Shadow (Women's) celebrates Michael Jordan's love of satin. It has serious athletic credentials in a hi-top basketball shoe while sporting a designer touch, thanks to the soft satiny upper. It carries all the heritage of the iconic Air Jordan line.

This is a luxe version of the Nike Air Jordan 1. The colorway alternates slightly metallic panels with black ones, both with a distinctive satin finish that make this shoe instantly catch the eye. It's further elevated by an embroidered Wings logo on the ankle. The black rubber outsole provides excellent traction and high comfort levels with Nike's trademark Air technology.

Our reviewers argued over who got to review this great shoe – that's how much we love the styling. The satin finish makes this one unique, even in a crowded market. It's an ideal blend of sporty lines and elegant sophistication. This shoe is worthy of being kept in pristine condition in a collection. The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Satin Shadow (Women's) was released on 5 October 2024 for $180.

title: Jordan 1 Low Triple White
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Triple White 2022 is a silhouette that arrives in a monochromatic colorway.

The smooth white leather upper of this Low Air Jordan 1 has perforations in the toe box, white leather overlays, and a white leather Swoosh. This sneaker also features a white rubber cupsole and an Air-sole unit in the heel. A white debossed Jumpman appears on the white padded tongue, a black Jumpman boasts on the white insole, and an embroidered white Wings logo is displayed on the white heel.

The Air Jordan 1 Low Triple White 2022 was released on September 1st, 2022, at a price of $110.

title: Nike Jordan x Levi's Jersey Red
Jordan 6 Retro Reverse Oreo
description:
The Jordan 6 Retro Reverse Oreo reimagines the iconic "Oreo" colorway from 1999 and applies it to the Air Jordan 6 Retro silhouette.

As the name implies, in the "Reserve Oreo" colorway, the white and black tones are swapped. The upper is made from premium, tumbled leather in white and features overlays and reinforced stitching in the same color. Signature perforations along the quarter panels and ankle allow the foot to breathe and add design details that complement the heel tab and midsole speckles. This speckled pattern features a black background with white dots. They provide the other half of the "Reverse Oreo" colorway: black graces the Jumpman logo, the long tongue, and the collar lining.

Our StockX experts like the rubber outsole, which features semi-translucent and black details, as well as a white Jumpman logo. The Jordan 6 Retro reverse Oreo was released on June 8, 2024, and retailed at $200.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG All-Star Cool Grey (GS)
Nike Dunk Low Off Noir Summit White
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Off Noir Summit White strips the Dunk Low down to pure contrast, letting tone and balance define the silhouette rather than graphics or gimmicks. The off noir overlays soften the usual black treatment, giving the shoe a more refined and wearable feel against the crisp summit white base. It feels intentional and calm, highlighting the Dunk’s classic paneling and proportions in a way that feels timeless rather than trendy.

Fans love this release because it fits effortlessly into rotation. It carries the familiar panda energy people gravitate toward, but with a slightly elevated mood that feels more mature and versatile. Collectors appreciate how subtle color shifts can refresh a staple silhouette, making this pair feel dependable yet distinct. It is the kind of Dunk that proves simplicity, when done right, often has the longest staying power in sneaker culture.

The Nike Dunk Low Off Noir Summit White was released on November 14, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

title: New Balance 9060 Pink Granite Washed Burgundy (GS)
description:
The New Balance 9060 Pink Granite Washed Burgundy GS brings layered color into a youth exclusive take on the brand most forward leaning runner. Pink Granite lays a soft base across the upper, while Washed Burgundy accents add depth and contrast. The sculpted sole and dynamic proportions remain intact, preserving the 9060 bold identity.

Pink and burgundy create a rich pairing that feels expressive without becoming overpowering. In GS sizing, this colorway adds personality while maintaining the same comfort and structure as the adult version. For younger fans who appreciate standout tones and modern shapes, this release delivers both confidence and everyday wearability.

The New Balance 9060 Pink Granite Washed Burgundy GS was released on September 12, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

title: Anta Kai 1 Jelly
description:
The Anta Kai 1 Jelly is a premium basketball shoe that’s part of a collaboration between Chinese sportswear company Anta and NBA player Kyrie Irving. It dresses the Anta Kai 1’s sporty silhouette in an all-over hot-pink colorway with a shiny finish and subtle gradient shifts.

The "Jelly" moniker is a reference to Irving’s acrobatic, jelly-like layups, while the sleek silhouette represents the athlete’s style of play. Released as an exclusive in China, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia, the Jelly Anta Kai 1 is made from high-quality synthetic material, contributing to its lightweight design. The heel boasts a TPU counter for stability, while the carbon-fiber plate in the midsole increases energy return and forward momentum.

Our StockX experts appreciate the Irving-specific branding details, including the shield of protection logo on the tongue. The Anta Kai 1 Jelly was released on October 1, 2024, and sold for $125.

title: Nike Air Max Plus Black Noble Red
description:
The Nike Air Max Plus Black Noble Red keeps the Tuned Air classic rooted in its bold late 1990s DNA. Black sets the stage across the wavy upper, while Light Crimson and Noble Red accents ignite the gradient with fiery contrast. The visible Tuned Air units reinforce the silhouette performance heritage beneath its aggressive lines.

The Air Max Plus has always thrived on dramatic color fades and striking overlays, and this red accented version feels true to that identity. Black and red combinations naturally amplify the model intensity, giving it strong presence on foot. For longtime Plus loyalists, this pair captures the attitude and energy that made the silhouette a street icon.

The Nike Air Max Plus Black Noble Red was released on April 30, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

title: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Olive (Women's)
description:
Travis Scott is back in 2023, following up his previous release of the Air Jordan 1 Retro Low Phantom in 2022, with another Air Jordan 1 Retro Low collaboration. The Jordan 1 Retro low OG SP Travis Scott Olive released exclusively in womens sizing.

The Air Jordan 1 Low OG SP Travis Scott Olive is constructed with white leather and black nubuck uppers. Travis continued to use his signautre reverse style Nike Swoosh, in an olive green colorway. The limited edition sneakers have an aged midsole that sits on top of an olive green outsole.

The women's-exclusive Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Olive released April 26, 2023, with a retail price of $150.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Mid '07 White
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Mid White '07 features a smooth white leather upper with matching overlays and Swooshes. From there, a velcro strap with Nike Swoosh embroidery and a matching Air sole completes the design.

The Nike Air Force 1 Mid White '07 was re-released in December of 2015 and retailed for $95.

title: adidas Vento XLG Deluxe Sail Grey
description:
The adidas Vento XLG Deluxe Sail Grey Womens embraces exaggerated proportions and modern styling while staying grounded through a soft and neutral palette. The Vento XLG silhouette is intentionally bold, built around scale and presence, and the sail grey tones calm that energy with balance and restraint. It feels fashion forward without being aggressive, designed for people who enjoy expressive footwear that still feels thoughtful and wearable.

Fans appreciate this pair because it plays with shape in a confident but approachable way. The oversized form gives it personality, while the muted colors make it easy to integrate into everyday outfits. Collectors love how it represents adidas experimenting with volume and proportion, offering something that feels current and distinctive while still maintaining a sense of ease and versatility in rotation.

The adidas Vento XLG Deluxe Sail Grey Womens was released on October 4, 2024 with a retail price of $160.

title: adidas Samba OG Black Wonder White (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Black Wonder White (Women's) is an iconic adidas silhouette inspired by indoor football from the 1950s. This updated version of the classic sports shoe is specifically sized for women and delivers adidas comfort, dependability, and cool, elegant style.

The Black Wonder White colorway of the Women's adidas Samba OG features a refined upper of nearly smooth black suede. Creamy white suede overlays the toe and forms the iconic adidas three stripes on the side panel. The heel is composed of matching creamy white leather with embossed horizontal stripes. The tongue is constructed of this same leather. Black adidas trefoil branding graces the tongue tag and Samba branding is printed along one of the three stripes.

The feature we enjoy most about this sneaker is its gum rubber sole unit. Gum rubber extends from the midsole onto the upper and forms the traction pattern on the outsole. The adidas Samba OG Black Wonder White (Women's) was released on December 7, 2023, for $100 retail.

title: adidas Handball Spezial Black Gum
description:
The adidas Handball Spezial Black Gum takes on an original 1979 silhouette.​
​​
​The upper of this Spezial sneaker is made of black suede with a white heel tab in smooth leather. Metallic gold Spezial branding appears next to the 3-Stripes on the lateral side and metallic gold adidas branding adorns the white tongue patch. The sockliner is also smooth black leather and the insole is black with white adidas branding. A gum rubber outsole is for traction on hard courts.​
​​
​The adidas Handball Spezial Black Gum was first released on August 26th, 2020 for a retail price of $100.

title: UGG Tazz Slipper Chestnut (Women's)
description:
The UGG Tazz Slipper Chestnut W for women features a heat-embossed UGG logo on its side.

This UGG model has the silhouette of UGG Slippers with a 1.5" platform sole for extra cushioning. It is made from the same suede upper as the original one in a chestnut color. It is also lined with the signature UGG plush wool blend for a slipper-like feel. Its textile binding is made from 100% recycled polyester fibers material.

The UGG Tazz Slipper Chestnut W was originally released on the 1st November 2021, with a retail price set at $120.

title: adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Black White (Women's)
description:
The adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Black White (Women's) is a ballet-inspired, flat silhouette that pulled design cues from the original Taekwondo Mei silhouette from adidas.

Crafted from soft leather, this black and white women's Taekwondo Mei Ballet combines heritage design and modern aesthetics. The front toe area pulls design inspiration from the adidas Y-3 model, with a cloud white Y-type overlay that sits on top of the core black upper. Three white stripes are on the side panels, while black adidas branding sits on the white heel.  A durable gum rubber outsole equates to comfortable traction. The shoes lace up directly on the forefoot without a tongue and can be tied around the ankle if desired to resemble ballet pointe shoes.

What do we think is this shoe’s standout feature? We’d have to say it’s that this silhouette draws inspiration from adidas' archival flats and the dynamic strength of martial arts, resulting in a minimalist style with an edge. The adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Black White (Women's) debuted on March 15, 2025, with a retail price of $90.

title: Nike Book 2 SP Spiridon Sport Red
description:
The Nike Book 2 SP Spiridon Sport Red fuses basketball performance with classic runner inspiration. Metallic Silver panels and Black accents echo the iconic Spiridon aesthetic, while Sport Red injects bold contrast across the upper. White detailing keeps the look balanced, highlighting the layered construction beneath the sleek profile.

Pulling cues from the Spiridon gives this SP edition a nostalgic edge that longtime Nike fans immediately recognize. The blend of running heritage and modern hoops design creates something unexpected yet cohesive. For collectors who appreciate cross era references, this pair stands out as a thoughtful fusion of two distinct Nike identities.

The Nike Book 2 SP Spiridon Sport Red was released on February 6, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

title: Nike Air Max 95 Olympic (2026)
Nike Dunk Low White Light Smoke Grey
description:
The Nike Dunk Low White Light Smoke Grey offers a fresh take on the classic silhouette, combining timeless design with contemporary colorways. This sleek sneaker features a pristine white leather base, complemented by light smoke grey overlays that add depth and dimension to the shoe. The iconic Nike Swoosh stands out in crisp white, creating a subtle yet striking contrast against the grey panels.

Crafted with premium materials, these Dunks boast a comfortable fit and durable construction, making them ideal for everyday wear. The low-top design provides flexibility and ease of movement, while the padded collar ensures enhanced comfort around the ankle. The rubber outsole features a classic traction pattern, offering reliable grip on various surfaces. Our team thinks this product is great for those seeking a versatile sneaker that effortlessly blends with both casual and semi-formal outfits, making it a must-have addition to any footwear collection.

title: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Night Maroon
description:
The Night Maroon Nike Air VaporMax Plus, a creation by designer Sean McDowell, is affectionately dubbed "Night Maroon," denoting its rich and vibrant color palette. The Air VaporMax Plus Night Maroon seamlessly blends a touch of the past with futuristic innovation.
​
​Retaining elements from the original Air Max Plus like the distinctive floating cage, cushioned upper, and iconic heel logo, this sneaker introduces the VaporMax Air technology for comfort and a contemporary look.In this iteration, the primary hue is a deep red, complemented by a white, black, and cedar accent. The upper is crafted from neoprene, providing a comfortable experience.
​
​What our experts love about the Nike Air VaporMax Plus Night Maroon is the fusion of style and technology that accentuates its bold presence. This shoe is a distinctive choice in the world of lifestyle sneakers. The sneaker released on 11th July 2023 for $210.

title: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Medium Olive (GS)
Nike Air Max Goadome PRM Black Off Noir
description:
The Nike Air Max Goadome PRM Black Off Noir is a premium iteration of the iconic boot-inspired sneaker. Featuring a sleek all-black upper crafted from high-quality materials, this shoe combines durability with style. The rugged outsole provides excellent traction, making it suitable for various terrains and weather conditions. The Air Max unit in the heel offers superior cushioning and comfort, ensuring all-day wearability.

This model showcases Nike's commitment to blending performance and fashion. The Off Noir colorway adds a subtle depth to the black silhouette, creating a sophisticated look that's versatile enough for both casual and more polished outfits. With its robust construction and timeless design, the Air Max Goadome PRM is built to last, offering both functionality and style in one package. We at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a durable, comfortable, and stylish boot-sneaker hybrid that can withstand the elements while maintaining a sleek urban aesthetic.

title: Alo Yoga Accolade Cotton-Blend Hoodie Black
description:
The Alo Yoga Accolade Cotton Blend Hoodie Black delivers a clean and elevated take on everyday comfort, built around a rich Black tone that feels endlessly wearable. The cotton blend construction gives it a structured yet soft hand feel, maintaining shape while still offering that relaxed lounge appeal. Its minimal branding keeps the focus on silhouette and fabric quality rather than loud graphics.

Alo has built a following by blending performance inspired basics with street ready polish, and the Accolade hoodie sits right at that intersection. The Black colorway makes it a foundational layering piece, whether paired with training gear or styled into a more refined off duty look. Fans appreciate when essentials feel intentional, and this hoodie achieves that through balance and simplicity.

The Alo Yoga Accolade Cotton Blend Hoodie Black was released with a retail price of $140.

title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Granite
description:
The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Granite boasts the iconic Yeezy silhouette, known for its low-top design and sleek, sock-like fit. The sneaker primarily takes on neutral tones in granite and Core Black for a neutral and versatile look.

The Granite adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 is constructed with a PRIMEKNIT upper, designed for lightweight flexibility and breathability. The minimalist sneaker is placed on top of a complete-length Boost midsole, which becomes visible through openings in the rubber outsole that offers traction. The sidewalls are enveloped in semi-transparent TPU to enhance durability and provide added support. The Yeezy sneaker takes on the classic lace closure, and for branding, the Granite PRIMEKNIT upper showcases 'SPLY-350' across its center in a contrasting Core Black stitching.

What we love about adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Granite is its minimalist design. This shoe embodies simplicity and understated elegance with its predominantly Granite colorway, subtle accents, and clean lines. The sneaker was released on August 28th, 2023, for $230.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Black Gum
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Black Gum dresses the classic silhouette with practical colors.

This Nike SB Dunk Low Black Gum color scheme consists of the classic combination of black, white, and Gum light brown. Its upper is composed of black nubuck material, complemented by a white leather Nike Swoosh. The heel tab is also adorned with an embroidered Nike wordmark in the same white color. The sneaker features a traditional cupsole design with white sidewalls and a tacky gum rubber outsole for traction. Additionally, a Zoom Air unit is incorporated into the insole to provide cushioning.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Black Gum was released on 1st March 2023 with its retail price set at $110.
