title: Nike Air Max Correlate Black White Grey
description:
The Nike Air Max Correlate Black White Grey is a comfortable yet flexible shoe that provides all of the best athletic qualities while still being stylish.

The Nike Air Max Correlate Black White Grey provides an ample amount of heel support and has a particularly cushioned sole. Splashes of pink and green appear in contrast to the black, white, and grey pattern that makes up a majority of the shoe. The upper part of the Nike Air Max Correlate Black White Grey molds to the foot, helping to provide support and protection while still remaining comfortable.

First released in May 2022 at a starting price of $155.

title: Nike Air Max 1 Monarch
description:
The Nike Air Max 1 Monarch updates the Air Max 1 with a vibrant colorway that mimics the black, white, and orange of a monarch butterfly’s wings.

The base is constructed from breathable, tight-knit white mesh, while leather overlays in gray form the lace cage and protective heel panel. The suede mudguard wraps around the shoe, complementing the Monarch orange of the collar lining and the NIKE AIR MAX embroidery on the heel tab. Black accents can be found on the signature Swoosh logo, the oversized eyelets, the outsole’s tread, and the visible Air Max units in the heel. The midsole comes in white, which offsets the deep black and bold Monarch tones.

Our experts at StockX like the woven NIKE AIR MAX logo tag on the tongue because it pays homage to the sneaker’s retro heritage. The Nike Air Max 1 Monarch was released on April 1, 2024, and retailed at $140.

title: Fear of God Essentials Hoodie Light Heather Grey
description:
Feel good while wearing the Fear of God Essentials Hoodie Light Heather Grey/Garden Yellow from the spring/summer 2024 season of Jerry Lorenzo’s designer lifestyle apparel brand.

This hooded sweatshirt boasts a neutral light heather grey colorway throughout the body, sleeves, and hood with a garden yellow accent seen around the outer edge of the hood itself. This adds just the right amount of color that is not overpowering. Other details include a tapered waistband, rib-knit cuffs on the sleeves, a mock neckline, and side seam pockets that seamlessly blend into the design. The side seam pockets compliment the overall round, cropped aesthetic. Holding true to minimalist branding, there is a sole rubberized logo on the front center of the hoodie.

StockX experts praise this hooded fleece’s timeless and neutral aesthetic, highlighting its versatility as both a statement piece and a cozy long-sleeved pullover for everyday use. The Fear of God Essentials Hoodie Light Heather Grey/Garden Yellow sold for $100 during its retail debut on February 14, 2024.

title: 2025 Pokémon Mega Evolution Phantasmal Flames Elite Trainer Box
description:
The 2025 Pokémon Mega Evolution Phantasmal Flames Elite Trainer Box is a powerful and visually striking release that brings the excitement of Mega Evolution back to the Pokémon TCG spotlight. Centered around the Phantasmal Flames theme, this Elite Trainer Box appeals to collectors and competitive players who value both presentation and gameplay depth.

Inside, fans will find a strong selection of Pokémon TCG booster packs from the Phantasmal Flames set, along with premium accessories designed to enhance play and organization. From deck building essentials to themed storage, every component is crafted to feel elevated and collectible worthy.

With Mega Evolution consistently driving demand and nostalgia within the hobby, the Phantasmal Flames Elite Trainer Box stands out as a desirable sealed product. Whether you are opening packs or holding for the future, this release delivers excitement, value, and classic Mega Evolution appeal. The Pokémon Mega Evolution Phantasmal Flames Elite Trainer Box was released in 2025 with an original retail price of $50.

title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 Pirate Black (2023)
description:
Introducing the return of the iconic adidas Yeezy Boost 350 in the Pirate Black colorway. Featuring an all-black primeknit upper, the Pirate Black Yeezy Boost 350 blends high-end streetwear with sleek minimalist design.

The sneakers boast a full-length Boost midsole, providing unparalleled comfort and performance.Black laces, inner lining, and heel tab complete the monochromatic look, capturing the essence of the original release. Whether you're hitting the streets or hitting the gym, the Yeezy Boost 350 Pirate Black is the ultimate pair of sneakers to express your personal style.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 Pirate Black made its triumphant return on June 1, 2023, with a retail price of $230.

title: Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott Sail
description:
The Air Jordan Cut The Check TR Travis Scott Sail was born from a collaboration between the Jordan brand and renowned rap artist Travis Scott and features unique design elements and personal touches that reflect his distinct style and creative vision.

This shoe’s upper is crafted from dark brown canvas and off-white leather overlays for a high-contrast aesthetic and lasting durability. It features a traditional lace closure and an adjustable midfoot strap for a secure fit, as well as a foam midsole for shock absorption and energy return. A gum rubber outsole rises from the shoe’s lower edge to its sidewalls and provides a strong grip on many surfaces.

What our experts especially enjoy about the Air Jordan Cut The Check TR Travis Scott Sail, however, is the contrasting red accents on the Jumpman icon and Cactus Jack face logo that can be found on the shoe’s tongue and heel, respectively. This shoe originally retailed for $200 on April 30, 2024.

title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Core Black Red
description: If anyone is discussing what's hotter than the earth's core, then the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Core Red must be a part of the discussion. Bringing hot lava vibes, these come with a core black upper and sole. There's also a core black "SPLY-350" branding across a scorching hot core red stripe on both sides. These dropped in November 2016 and retailed at $220. Add more sauce to your sneaker collection and buy now on StockX.

title: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Pink Foam (Women's)
description:
The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Pink Foam (Women’s) refreshes a beloved silhouette with a lively pop of color and modern comfort. Signature layered panels in Black and White create the model’s sculpted look, while Pink Foam accents energize the eyestays, Swoosh, and visible Air windows for an undeniably fresh finish. Breathable mesh and supportive overlays deliver a snug, ventilated fit, and reflective hits in Silver catch light after dark, nodding to the shoe’s street-born heritage. Underfoot, the enlarged visible Air units at the heel and forefoot soften every step, pairing with a resilient foam midsole to keep you moving comfortably from commute to cooldown.

Designed for daily rotation, the Air Max 95 OG blends sport DNA with lifestyle versatility. The speed-lacing system helps you dial in your fit quickly, and the durable rubber outsole with flex grooves offers multi-surface traction that’s ready for city pavement or weekend errands. Subtle branding and an iconic wavy sidewall maintain the model’s timeless appeal, while the Pink Foam palette adds a playful twist that pairs easily with athleisure, denim, or tailored basics. Identified by style code HJ5996-001 and finished in Black/Pink Foam/White/Reflective Silver, this women’s colorway brings bold energy to a classic you can wear year-round.

Our team loves this product because it couples the Air Max 95’s legendary cushioning and reflective detailing with a standout Pink Foam color story that elevates everyday outfits with effortless style.

title: Nike Ja 3 Light Show
description:
Light up every cut, burst, and fast break in the Nike Ja 3 Light Show, a high-energy take on Ja Morant’s third signature shoe. Wrapped in a crisp White base with electric hits of Dusty Cactus, Hyper Pink, and Star Blue, this colorway turns heads on court and off. A breathable, reinforced upper provides lightweight containment through hard plants and sudden changes of direction, while a padded collar and sculpted heel keep you centered over your foot. Underfoot, a lively midsole gives you a springy, close-to-the-court feel for quick first steps and confident landings, and the durable outsole pattern is engineered to bite on hardwood for stop-on-a-dime traction when the game speeds up.

Designed for players who thrive in the open floor, the Nike Ja 3 Light Show balances support and agility to help you stay explosive for four quarters. Dynamic lacing helps lock you in without pressure points, and strategic overlays add structure where you need it most. The bold palette pairs seamlessly with team uniforms and streetwear fits alike, and the included Blue Laces let you dial in your look with a custom touch. Finished with signature details and style code HF2794-100/HF2793-100, it’s a performance-first basketball sneaker that delivers the confidence to attack every angle and finish through contact.

Our team loves this product because it blends quick-response cushioning, trustworthy traction, and striking color pops to elevate both your game and your style.

title: Nike Sportswear Tech Fleece Full-Zip Hoodie & Joggers Set Black/Black
description:
The Nike Sportswear Tech Fleece Full-Zip Hoodie & Joggers Set Black/Black was released in an all-black color scheme with the Nike logo on both pieces.

The Sportswear Tech Fleece Full-Zip Hoodie & Joggers Set Black/Black hoodie features two pieces, a hoodie, and joggers. The hoodie boosts a full zip closure with a high collar and adjustable hood to provide extra protection from the elements. It also has zippered pockets that offer ample storage for your essentials. The joggers have a tapered design and ribbed ankle line. They have an elastic waistband with a drawstring to ensure a customizable fit. The joggers also feature a zippered pocket on one side and a normal pocket on the other.

We especially love the set for its material construction. The main material used is a lightweight and breathable poly-cotton blend fleece, with a small percentage of spandex added for flexibility. The Nike Sportswear Tech Fleece Full-Zip Hoodie & Joggers Set Black/Black was released on September 1st, 2023, at a retail price of $270.

title: On Running Cloud 6 All White
description:
The On Running Cloud 6 All White offers the same lightweight comfort in a crisp and minimalist presentation. The all white finish highlights the silhouette’s structure and cushioning system, giving the shoe a fresh and modern look. It feels clean and intentional, emphasizing balance and ease rather than visual complexity.

Fans gravitate toward this colorway because it feels effortless. The Cloud 6’s comfort makes it ideal for everyday wear, and the white palette enhances that versatility by pairing easily with nearly anything. Collectors appreciate it as a refined staple, representing On’s ability to merge Swiss design principles with practical performance in a way that feels calm, modern, and consistently wearable.

The On Running Cloud 6 All White was released on February 6, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

title: Jordan 1 Low Black Elephant Print
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Black Elephant Print adds textured heritage to a timeless low top silhouette. Dressed in Black and Anthracite with hints of Tour Yellow, the upper features elephant print detailing that nods to classic Jordan design language. The familiar low cut shape and stitched overlays keep it grounded in the original 1985 blueprint.

Elephant print has long been associated with iconic moments in Jordan history, and bringing it to the AJ1 Low creates a fresh yet nostalgic feel. The black base keeps the look sleek and versatile, while subtle yellow accents inject energy. It feels like a thoughtful remix that blends two legendary visual cues into one everyday rotation staple.

The Air Jordan 1 Low Black Elephant Print was released on October 20, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

title: adidas Adiracer GT Bad Bunny x Mercedes AMG Branch Sand
description:
The adidas Adiracer GT Bad Bunny Branch Sand blends motorsport heritage with Bad Bunny’s expressive design language in a colorway that feels earthy and intentional. Branch and sand tones give the upper a grounded and organic feel, while cinder accents add depth without breaking the flow. The streamlined Adiracer shape keeps the look sleek and low profile, creating a silhouette that feels fast even at rest.

Fans appreciate this collaboration because it highlights Bad Bunny’s ability to reinterpret adidas archives without losing authenticity. The muted palette feels mature and wearable, allowing the design details to shine quietly rather than loudly. Collectors see this pair as part of a larger creative arc between artist and brand, where heritage models are refreshed through thoughtful color and cultural relevance. It stands as a balanced crossover between racing roots and global music influence.

The adidas Adiracer GT Bad Bunny Branch Sand was released on November 17, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

title: Jordan 6 Retro Toro Bravo
description:
Stepping into 2023 with undeniable swagger, the Jordan 6 Retro made its fiery entrance with the Toro Bravo edition, released on May 24, 2023. This model features a bold blend of premium materials, proving once again why Jordan brand continues to lead the sneaker game.

The upper is adorned with Varsity Red premium suede, giving it that stand-out Jordan style. The eye-catching red is contrasted perfectly with black accents throughout, from the midsole to the iconic Jumpman logo, ensuring a strong visual impact on and off the court. A translucent outsole anchors this design, complementing the vibrant upper and maintaining the timeless silhouette of the Jordan 6 Retro. Inside, you'll find a sockliner designed for comfort, making these sneakers as wearable as they are stylish.

The Jordan 6 Retro Toro Bravo debuted on May 24, 2023, with a retail price of $200.

title: Jordan 12 Retro Pearl Pink (GS)
description:
Air Jordan 12 Retro Pearl Pink GS brings a soft and playful twist to one of Jordan Brand’s most celebrated silhouettes, wrapping the classic Air Jordan 12 in tones that feel both premium and youthful. The pearl pink palette floods the tumbled leather upper, giving it a warm, elegant presence that still carries the performance inspired shape created by Tinker Hatfield. Even in grade school sizing, this release feels luxurious and intentional, perfect for collectors who appreciate subtle color stories rooted in heritage design.

Collectors gravitate toward the Pearl Pink because it marries iconic structure with refined personality. The Air Jordan 12’s signature radiating stitch lines and supportive build remain front and center, while the gentle pink hues create a fresh narrative that feels timeless rather than trend driven. It’s the kind of release that feels at home in curated rotations and everyday rotation alike.

The Air Jordan 12 Retro Pearl Pink GS was released on 11/21/2025 with a retail price of $150.

title: Nike Dunk Low Pegasus Pack Linen Phantom
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Pegasus Pack Linen Phantom blends running inspired color cues into the familiar Dunk framework. Linen and Phantom tones set a soft and layered base, while Neutral Olive and Dark Hazel accents add subtle depth. The low cut shape remains true to the original, preserving the clean lines that made it iconic.

The Pegasus Pack concept brings performance heritage into lifestyle territory, and this Dunk interpretation feels cohesive rather than forced. The earthy palette keeps it understated and versatile, making it an easy everyday option. For collectors who enjoy thematic packs with wearable color blocking, this release offers a refined spin on a classic.

The Nike Dunk Low Pegasus Pack Linen Phantom was released on January 9, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

title: Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott University Red
description:
The release of the Air Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott University Red marks a momentous occasion: the first wide public launch of a brand-new, original colorway from the collaborative genius of Jordan Brand and Travis Scott. This sneaker is a homage to the past and a forward leap in design, drawing inspiration from classic basketball sneakers of the '80s and the rugged aesthetic of '90s skate shoes. It’s a perfect blend for enthusiasts who appreciate a retro vibe with a modern twist.

Travis Scott's first entirely original silhouette comes to life with the iconic, signature reversed Nike Swoosh in a bold university red, contrasting strikingly against the timeless sail & black upper. The carefully pre-yellowed midsole adds a touch of vintage appeal, invoking a sense of nostalgia while remaining at the pinnacle of style. Complete with a special co-branded shoe box and dust bag, the Jordan Jumpman Jack TR is as much a collector's piece as it is a testament to sneaker innovation.

Released on April 26, 2024, the Air Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott University Red retailed for $200. This sneaker is the inception of Travis Scott's original design legacy, offering a unique take on sneaker culture. With its rich 80s and 90s influences and the unmatched Travis Scott brand power, this sneaker is ready to conquer the streets and capture the essence of both basketball and skateboarding heritage.

title: Jordan 12 Retro Blueberry
description:
The Air Jordan 12 Retro Blueberry reimagines an iconic design with a fresh twist, fusing heritage and modernity in a bold new colorway. Inspired by the original Cherry Air Jordan 12, this version trades vibrant red for an eye-catching game royal blue, paired with a clean white upper and subtle black accents. The smooth white leather upper provides a crisp canvas, while textured overlays and silver metal eyelets bring the classic silhouette to life.

Every detail of the Blueberry speaks to Jordan Brand’s unmatched craftsmanship. Black hits on the tongue, inner lining, and heel tab add contrast, while game royal blue pops on branding elements and textured mudguards—giving the sneaker its "Blueberry" moniker. The result is a harmonious balance of style and functionality, perfect for fans looking to elevate their collection or turn heads on the streets.

Set to release on December 18, 2024, the Air Jordan 12 Retro Blueberry carries a retail price of $210. This fresh take on the classic Air Jordan 12 combines nostalgia and innovation, making it an essential pick for sneakerheads and collectors alike.

title: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (PS)
description:
The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (PS), in pre-school sizes, is an athletic shoe with a low-top silhouette. The leather upper is done in Medium Olive overlaid with Sail at the tip, lace panel, and heel, accented by a reversed Swoosh in black. Travis Scott and Jordan wings branding accents the heel, while the Nike branding appears on the tongue. The midsole and outsole combo in Muslin and Medium Olive completes the look.

Nike introduced the Air Jordan 1 to the public in 1985 after designing it for Michael Jordan in 1984, and from there, the shoe went on to have legendary status. Classic and iconic, the Jordan 1 retro has been reimagined in myriad variations. In 2024, Nike worked with Houston, Texas-based artist Travis Scott on his signature Jordan 1 Retro, which features his stitched mouth-face artwork.

In our opinion, the Retro Low OG SP's best feature is its unusual branding and stitching, which distinguish it from other models. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (PS) was released on September 28, 2024, and retailed for $60.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Reverse Laney (Women's)
description:
Jordan Brands popular Air Jordan 1 model is getting Michael Jordan's Emsley A. Laney High School treatment with the release of the Women’s Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Reverse Laney.

The Women’s Air Jordan 1 High OG Reverse Laney is the second iteration of the Air Jordan 1 to receive the Laney treatment, after Nike previously released the sneakers in men’s sizing in 2013. This version of the Laney features a leather upper, with blue and yellow color blocking, and a black and red Nike Air logo on the tongue.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro high OG Reverse Laney (W) released February 17, 2023, with a retail price of $180.

title: Nike Air Diamond Turf Ravens (2025)
description:
The Nike Air Diamond Turf Ravens (2025) is a low-top athletic shoe and a signature shoe for former NFL player and coach of the Colorado Buffaloes, Deion Sanders.

American athletic shoe brand Nike has long collaborated with professional athletes, utilizing their stellar design team to incorporate players’ inspiration with athletic functionality. The Ravens (2025) Nike Air Diamond Turf salutes the final team of Deion Sanders's playing career, the Baltimore Ravens. With a monochrome Black suede upper, accented by an arch strap that displays Metallic Gold mesh inserts on the sides and the Nike Swoosh logo over the lace panel in White. The curved midsole in Black displays Nike Air branding with visible pops of Club Purple on the outsole. Ravens' branding on the tongue and embroidered Nike Air branding on the rear heel in Metallic Gold complete the look.

In our opinion, the best feature of the Diamond Turf is its Black suede upper, which makes the Metallic Gold and Club Purple accents pop. The Nike Air Diamond Turf Ravens (2025) was released on May 30, 2025, and retailed at $150.

title: Jordan 9 Retro Low Golf White University Blue
description:
The Air Jordan 9 Retro Low Golf White University Blue translates Jordan Brand heritage onto the course through a silhouette that feels clean, confident, and purpose driven. The white and university blue palette gives the shoe a crisp and athletic look, while the low cut Jordan 9 shape keeps it grounded in performance roots. It feels refined without losing the bold identity that defines the model.

Collectors appreciate this release because it represents Jordan Brand expanding its legacy into new spaces without abandoning authenticity. The Jordan 9’s global inspiration and streamlined design make it a natural fit for golf, appealing to fans who appreciate versatility and crossover culture. It’s a shoe people love for its balance, honoring basketball heritage while embracing a different kind of competition and precision.

The Air Jordan 9 Retro Low Golf White University Blue was released on August 12, 2024 with a retail price of $230.

title: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (TD)
description:
The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (TD), in toddler sizes, is a low-top athletic shoe featuring a Medium Olive leather upper contrasted by Sail overlays and the Swoosh in black, placed in a reverse orientation. In red, the Nike, Travis Scott, and Jordan Wings logos accent the tongue and heel. The Muslin midsole and Medium Olive outsole complete the aesthetic.

The Air Jordan 1 is one of the American athletic shoe brand Nike’s crowning achievements for its unparalleled longevity and popularity. Travis Scott is a rapper, producer, and songwriter from Houston, Texas, whose records have topped charts since the 20-teens. Nike tapped Scott to apply his signature aesthetic to the Jordan 1 Retro, one of their iconic styles. The shoe comes with accessories, like pink and black laces.

Our experts feel that the best features of the Jordan 1 Retro Medium Olive are the rounded toe cap, sole pattern, and ventilation holes of this limited-edition shoe. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (TD) was released on September 28, 2024, and retailed at $50.

title: Nike Dunk Low Retro University Blue
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Retro University Blue highlights a timeless design with bold, inspired color blocking. This retro sneaker redefines the iconic Dunk silhouette with vibrant colors and a meticulous finish, showing off a lovely mixture of original designs with striking visuals.

The University Blue Dunk Low Retro by Nike comes with smooth leather panels in white and bright blue, giving you a two-tone design. Blue overlays extend across the toe box, eyestays, and heel, while Nike branding appears in matching blue and white on the tongue tag and heel tab. The foam midsole provides lightweight comfort, with a rubber outsole for traction. Introduced in 1985, the Dunk revolutionized basketball footwear, later gaining a cult following in casual wear.

Something we love about the Nike Dunk Low Retro University Blue is its low-profile silhouette that gives you added versatility, and its two-tone leather overlays for a dynamic visual contrast. This sneaker retailed at $115 when it was released on October 1, 2024.

title: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 OG Royal Silver
description:
The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 OG Royal Silver is an updated relaunch of the original ProGrid Omni 9 from 2010. This lifestyle sneaker returns with a sleek colorway of Royal and silver with black accents.

Featuring a technical silhouette, the upper is crafted from lightweight mesh, leather, and suede. The addition of metallic silver makes the leather overlays gleam like chrome, while the mesh allows the foot to breathe. The slightly chunky midsole houses Saucony’s Grid technology, which provides stable, responsive cushioning and distributes pressure. The rubber outsole boasts a defined traction pattern that is designed with durability in mind. In terms of branding, Saucony’s iconic creek logo graces the side panels, while ‘SAUCONY’ appears on the tongue, and ‘OMNI 9’ is printed near the heel.

Our experts at StockX appreciate the way the cage of supportive overlays contributes to the sneaker’s retro technical design. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 OG Royal Silver was released on February 15, 2024, and retailed for $140.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Arts-Rec
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Arts-Rec (style IH3211-200) blends skate-ready function with head-turning style, delivering a color story that stands out on and off the board. The Khaki, Amber Brown, Rough Green, Rust Pink, Black, and Sail palette is thoughtfully balanced across smooth panels and textured overlays, creating depth and contrast from every angle. A plush, padded tongue and supportive collar enhance lockdown and comfort, while the low-profile cupsole design promotes stable footing for technical sessions and everyday wear. Underfoot, a grippy rubber outsole with a classic pivot pattern offers confident traction, making these Dunk Lows as practical as they are striking.

Details matter on the Arts-Rec edition, from the crisp stitching that frames each panel to the clean Swoosh lines that anchor the sidewalls. Four lace options, White, Green, Orange, and Pink, let you personalize the look in seconds, whether you want to lean into earthy tones or highlight the Rust Pink accents. The balanced cushioning provides responsive impact protection without sacrificing board feel, and the streamlined silhouette pairs effortlessly with denim, cargos, or skate shorts. Whether you’re collecting the latest Nike SB releases or rotating a daily skate shoe, this Dunk Low delivers standout style with versatile performance.

Our team loves this product because it offers customizable style, dependable traction, and day-long comfort in a distinctive colorway that elevates any sneaker lineup.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low LE Triple White (GS)
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Low LE Triple White GS  features triple white leather upper perforations on the toebox as well as two perforations under each Swoosh. The Swoosh and overlays are also white leather. The outsole is white with a concentric-circles pattern and stars in the rubber. The midsole is white with a hidden Air compartment. The midsole says "AIR" in white. A silver tab saying "AF1" is on the top of the white laces.

This grade school-sized shoe, the Nike Air Force 1 Low LE Triple White GS, was released on April 13, 2021 at a retail price of $90.

title: Jordan 1 Low SE White Legend Blue
description:
The Jordan 1 Low SE White Legend Blue offers a new colorway in this iconic line of sneakers. All the premium materials remain embellished with subtle detail. Its crisp design complements the classic silhouette of one of the world's most beloved shoes.

All the dependable Air Jordan technology is here, including the Nike Air cushioning. The upper combines real and synthetic leather with toe perforations that provide breathability. The base color is white, with shiny, light blue panels and Swoosh. The latter matches the high-grip rubber undersole.

Our reviewers always welcome a new version of this classic trainer. The embroidered Wings logo on the heel gives it a special touch. This shoe has the familiar, solid yet lightweight feel we've come to expect from the AJ1 line. It's one to add to any collection and a perfect introduction to the range. The Jordan 1 Low SE White Legend Blue was released on October 1, 2024, for $125.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High Fir Pro Green (Women's)
description:
Air Jordan 1 Retro High Fir Pro Green Womens brings a rich, grounded color story to the most influential silhouette in sneaker history. Fir and pro green tones give the Air Jordan 1 High a calm but confident presence, emphasizing heritage and balance rather than loud contrast. Designed specifically with women in mind, the colorway feels intentional and refined while staying true to the model’s rebellious roots.

This release resonates with collectors because it highlights how timeless the Jordan 1 truly is. The familiar shape anchors the design, while the green palette offers versatility and longevity. It feels like a shoe meant to age gracefully, rewarding fans who appreciate subtle reinterpretations that respect history while fitting seamlessly into modern rotations.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro High Fir Pro Green Womens was released on 10/18/2025 with a retail price of $185.

title: Nike Air Max Plus Dark Obsidian
description:
The Nike Air Max Plus Dark Obsidian delivers a sleek and moody take on one of Nike’s most aggressive silhouettes. The dark obsidian base gives the Air Max Plus a stealthy presence, while subtle blue chill accents add depth without breaking the flow. The iconic cage lines and Tuned Air sole still command attention, but the darker palette makes the shoe feel more refined and controlled.

Collectors appreciate this pair because it shows restraint without sacrificing attitude. The Air Max Plus has always been about dominance and presence, and this colorway channels that energy through tone rather than contrast. Fans love it as a wearable option that still carries the rebellious spirit tied to the model’s legacy in street and rave culture, making it feel powerful, modern, and confident.

The Nike Air Max Plus Dark Obsidian was released on July 3, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

title: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Game Royal Metallic Silver
description:
The Nike Air VaporMax Plus Game Royal Metallic Silver merges bold aesthetics with cutting-edge innovation. Its dynamic color palette and distinct profile come together in a striking look that's designed to combine performance with fashion.

The Game Royal and Metallic Silver Air VaporMax Plus by Nike has a gradient mesh upper with transitions of blue all around, complemented by metallic blue TPU overlays that resemble the original Air Max Plus design. A reflective Swoosh is on the side of the heel, and the VaporMax sole unit offers up a futuristic look along with responsive cushioning. First introduced in 2018, the VaporMax line highlights Nike's air technology and design evolution.

Something we love about the Nike Air VaporMax Plus Game Royal Metallic Silver is its gradient upper, which gives you a bold visual impact, and the VaporMax sole, which offers a lightweight feel with superior responsiveness. This model retailed at $210 when it was released on the 24th of June 2024.

title: Nike Sabrina 3 Ice Cold (Women's)
description:
Nike Sabrina 3 Ice Cold Womens captures Sabrina Ionescu’s calm and calculated dominance through a colorway that feels sharp and composed. Ice Cold reflects her ability to control the game under pressure, pairing a clean visual identity with a silhouette built for precision and confidence. It feels modern and focused, mirroring Sabrina’s leadership and poise on the court.

Collectors appreciate this release because the Sabrina line has quickly become known for authenticity and intent. The Ice Cold execution reinforces that reputation, showing how performance footwear can carry personality without excess. It appeals to fans who value clarity, control, and a connection between athlete and design rather than loud expression.

The Nike Sabrina 3 Ice Cold Womens was released on 10/01/2025with a retail price of $135.

title: Sprayground Midnight Sip Backpack Backpack Black Blue
Nike Sportswear Tech Fleece Windrunner Full-Zip Hoodie Dark Grey Heather/Black
description:
The Nike Sportswear Tech Fleece Windrunner Full-Zip Hoodie Dark Grey Heather/Black is a jacket designed for running outdoors.

This Nike Sportswear Tech Fleece Windrunner Full-Zip Hoodie comes in a dark-gray heather color throughout with black accents. Unlike other iterations of this hoodie, the design of this one is not color blocked. However, slightly darker gray seams still form the geometric pattern typically visible on the front. A black Nike Swoosh logo is on the left front shoulder, while the full zipper and the two zippered pockets on the front are also black. The fleece material allows for heat retention, keeping you warm at the beginning of or after your run.

What we like best about this hoodie is the monochromatic look, which allows the hoodie to be a bit more versatile. The Nike Sportswear Tech Fleece Windrunner Full-Zip Hoodie Dark Grey Heather/Black was released on August 12, 2023, and retailed for $145.

title: Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 White Pure Platinum Obsidian Mist Gridiron
description:
The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 White Pure Platinum Obsidian Mist Gridiron represents the cutting edge of Nike performance design through a clean and technical presentation. White sets a crisp foundation, while pure platinum and obsidian mist accents highlight the engineered structure. Gridiron tones add depth, allowing the complex form to feel controlled and purposeful rather than chaotic.

Fans view the Alphafly as a symbol of innovation and competitive ambition. Even beyond racing, the design carries cultural weight for its bold proportions and unapologetic performance focus. Collectors appreciate how the restrained palette lets the technology driven shape speak for itself. It feels precise and uncompromising, reflecting Nike’s pursuit of speed and efficiency through form and engineering rather than aesthetic excess.

The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 White Pure Platinum Obsidian Mist Gridiron was released on March 20, 2025 with a retail price of $285.
secondary_title: White Pure Platinum Obsidian Mist Gridiron

title: adidas Samba XLG White Black Gum (GS)
Nike Ja 3 Max Volume (GS)
description:
Nike Ja 3 Max Volume GS captures the high energy spirit of Ja Morant’s game in a colorway designed to stand out. Max Volume leans into brightness and contrast, giving the Ja 3 a lively and expressive personality that reflects Ja’s fearless approach to basketball. Even in grade school sizing, the shoe feels bold and intentional, designed to move and be noticed.

What makes this pair appealing to collectors is how closely it aligns with Ja’s identity. The Ja 3 silhouette thrives on motion, and the Max Volume theme amplifies that feeling through color and attitude. It feels fun without being careless, making it a favorite for fans who enjoy performance shoes that carry personality alongside function.

The Nike Ja 3 Max Volume GS was released on 08/21/2025 with a retail price of $100.

title: Nike LeBron 21 Prime 93
description:
Command every possession in the Nike LeBron 21 Prime 93, a powerhouse men’s basketball shoe engineered for explosive play and refined with eye-catching polish. The sleek Black upper sets the stage for crisp White contrasts, bold Fire Red hits, and elevated Metallic Gold details that nod to championship pedigree. A supportive, breathable build helps you lock in without feeling weighed down, while a padded collar and secure lacing system keep the foot centered during hard plants, fast cuts, and above-the-rim finishes. Underfoot, a durable outsole with targeted traction zones bites the hardwood for confident stops and quick changes of direction, helping you stay balanced from tip-off to clutch time.

Designed to cushion impact and return energy, the Prime 93 blends responsive cushioning with a stable platform that feels smooth from heel strike to toe-off. A sturdy heel counter and midfoot support work together to keep your stride aligned, while the wide, sculpted base provides a steady foundation during lateral moves. Styled to turn heads off the court and built to perform on it, this Nike LeBron 21 colorway pairs effortlessly with game-day kits and streetwear alike. With its Black/White/Fire Red/Metallic Gold palette and signature LeBron detailing, the Prime 93 delivers the power, control, and style today’s players demand. Style: HQ3480-001/HQ3479-001.

Our team loves this product because it blends top-tier cushioning, lockdown support, and statement-making color blocking for players who want performance without compromising style.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High Black Metallic Gold (2020)
description:
Jordan Brand is no stranger to patent leather. Since the Air Jordan 11 debuted the material for the brand back in 1996, it’s found its way onto various models such as the Jordan 1, Jordan 4, and Jordan 7. 2020 marks the third issue of the patent-clad Air Jordan 1 Black Metallic Gold, with the first releasing back in 2001, and again in 2013.

The Air Jordan 1 Black Metallic Gold’s 2020 retro delivers slight cosmetic changes from its 2013 predecessor. The upper black and metallic gold patent leather upper. From there, a full translucent black sole with gold speckles completes the Jordan 1 classic.

The Air Jordan 1 Black Metallic Gold released in November of 2020 and retailed for $170.

title: adidas AE 2 Black White Red
description:
The adidas AE 2 Black White Red builds on Anthony Edwards’ growing signature legacy with a colorway that leans into classic basketball contrast and attitude. Black and white form a strong foundation, while red accents inject urgency and edge, giving the shoe a look that feels competitive and fearless. The AE 2 silhouette feels more mature and intentional, signaling growth while staying true to Edwards’ relentless style of play.

Fans appreciate this release because it feels rooted in tradition while still looking forward. The color blocking recalls timeless basketball footwear, but the shape and execution keep it modern. Collectors love how the AE 2 continues to carve out its own identity, making this pair appealing to those who enjoy signature lines that evolve naturally rather than reinventing themselves every season.

The adidas AE 2 Black White Red was released on October 4, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

title: Jordan 3 Retro J Balvin Rio
description:
The Jordan 3 Retro J Balvin Rio perfectly blends the classic Jordan 3 design with J Balvin's signature flair. Featuring a predominantly black upper, this sneaker is brought to life with solar flare and total crimson abyss accents that capture the vibrant energy of J Balvin’s music. The iconic elephant print on the heel and toe areas pays homage to the original Jordan 3 design, while the gradient midsole transitioning from bright orange to deep abyss adds a unique and colorful twist.

As part of his ongoing collaboration with Jordan brand, J Balvin's "Rio" edition, named after his son, infuses a personal and artistic touch into the Jordan 3 model. The sneaker's construction maintains the high standards of comfort and durability that the Jordan 3 is known for. The bold colorway reflects J Balvin’s dynamic personality, making this model a standout piece. The thoughtful design elements, from the premium leather to the eye-catching gradient midsole, highlight the meticulous attention to detail in this collaboration.

Retailing at $250, the Jordan 3 Retro J Balvin Rio was released on May 22, 2024. This sneaker is a tribute to J Balvin's influence and the enduring legacy of the Jordan brand. Don’t miss out on this unique and stylish collaboration that perfectly captures the essence of both the music and sneaker worlds.

title: Nike x NOCTA Sunset Puffer Jacket Baroque Brown
description:
The Nike x NOCTA Sunset Puffer Jacket Baroque Brown merges Drake’s refined aesthetic with Nike’s performance outerwear expertise. Rendered in Baroque Brown, the puffer silhouette features structured quilting and a streamlined fit designed for cold weather layering. The minimalist approach keeps branding subtle while emphasizing premium construction.

NOCTA releases often lean into rich earth tones and clean silhouettes, and this sunset puffer follows that formula. The deep brown shade adds warmth and versatility, making it easy to integrate into winter rotations. It stands as a sophisticated outerwear piece that blends sport functionality with elevated street presence.

The Nike x NOCTA Sunset Puffer Jacket Baroque Brown was released on November 14, 2025 with a retail price of $400.
primary_title: Nike x NOCTA Sunset Puffer Jacket

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Cool Grey
Jordan 5 Retro PSG Paris Saint-Germain Off Noir
description:
The Air Jordan 5 Retro PSG Paris Saint Germain Off Noir blends football culture and basketball heritage through a collaboration that feels global and refined. The off noir base sets a sophisticated tone, while subtle color accents reflect Paris Saint Germain’s identity without overwhelming the design. It feels sleek and intentional, offering a darker and more lifestyle driven take on the Jordan 5 silhouette.

Fans love this pair because it represents a true crossover moment. The Jordan 5’s bold structure remains intact, but the PSG influence adds a layer of cultural depth tied to international sport and fashion. Collectors appreciate how the collaboration feels mature and cohesive, making it a standout release for those who value storytelling, brand alignment, and understated confidence in their sneakers.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro PSG Paris Saint Germain Off Noir was released on December 3, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Green Glow
description:
Immerse yourself in the fusion of heritage and modern style with the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Green Glow. This bold reinterpretation of the classic Jordan 1 silhouette comes alive with striking Green Glow fused into the timeless black toe color blocking giving the classic sneaker a fresh, vivid twist. ​
​​
​The vibrant Green Glow set against the stark contrast of black and white, turns this shoe into a contemporary classic. Launched on April 20, 2024, with an accessible price point of $180, this sneaker instantly stands out as an icon reimagined. The sneaker’s high-quality leather uppers, married with the comfortable cushioning of an Air-Sole unit, uphold the Jordan 1's off-court style. ​
​​
​Honoring the past while propelling into the present, this iteration is a narrative, intertwining Michael Jordan's legacy with the vibrant beats of today’s fashion trends. It’s a testament to a design that has dominated both the basketball court and the streets, an embodiment of the culture that the Jordan brand has nurtured over decades. For those looking to make a statement, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Green Glow is the perfect choice.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Canyon Purple (Women's)
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro Canyon Purple W was inspired by Tinker Hatfield’s 1989 design. This shoe replaces the traditional leather or nubuck build.

This Air Jordan 4 for women has an upper that is crafted from shaggy suede in a vibrant purple color finish. Lime green accents land on the speckled eyelets and midsole, while the signature Jumpman logo graces the woven tongue tag in Safety Orange. The bright hues are offset by contrasting hits of black on the molded wings, Jumpman-embossed heel tab, and herringbone-traction rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro Canyon Purple W was released on the 15th of October 2022, and originally retailed for $200.

title: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Venice Beach (2024)
description:
The Nike Kobe 8 Protro Venice Beach (2024) is a vivid canvas of Los Angeles’s iconic coastal neighborhood, embodying the spirit and vibrancy of Venice Beach. The sneaker’s colorway, featuring stadium grey, metallic silver, and tour yellow, is as dynamic and eclectic as the bustling boardwalks and vibrant street art that define the area. It’s a design that pays homage to Kobe Bryant's connection to the city, capturing the essence of its sun-drenched days and the creativity of its residents.

This re-release Protro of the Kobe 8 maintains the same look of the beloved original on the outside, but updates the tech found on the inside for the modern basketball player. This colorway taps into the heartbeat of Venice Beach, where athletes, artists, and dreamers converge. The sneaker's design showcases a blend of textures and hues that mirror the beach's energy, from the sunlit sands to the azure sky. The artistic strokes of red, yellow, and blue across the upper reflect the eclectic tapestry of the neighborhood, while the signature Nike Swoosh in a striking yellow captures the attention just like the gleaming California sun.

Snag your pair of the Nike Kobe 8 Protro Venice Beach 2024 which released on April 13, 2024, for $190, and step into a blend of style, comfort, and performance. As a staple piece in any Kobe fan's collection, or as the perfect sneaker for those inspired by the rich culture of Los Angeles, the Venice Beach 2024 edition is a celebration of history, art, and the spirit of one of basketball's greatest players. Make sure to add this iconic sneaker to your collection and carry forward the legacy of Kobe Bryant with every step.

title: adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Copper Fade
description:
The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Copper Fade is composed of a copper Primeknit upper with a signature translucent TPU lace cage unit. At the base, a black and copper adiPRENE sole provides cushioning and stability.

The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Copper Fade released in December of 2021 and retailed for $200.

title: Jordan 1 Mid Triple Black
description:
Inspired by the original Air Jordan 1 from 1985, the Jordan 1 Mid Triple Black is a mid-cut Air Jordan 1 sneaker in a "Triple Black" colorway.

This sneaker features traditional detailing on the monochromatic upper section, including a matching retro "Wings" emblem etched on the collar flap, Swooshes on the lateral and medial, perforated detailing on the toebox, nylon tongue, laces, and a tonal Jumpman logo on a matching tongue tag. Rounding out the design of this shoe is the traditional Air Jordan 1 sole unit in a Triple Black tone matching the upper. 

What our experts love about this sneaker is its design and colorway. The design, inspired by the OG 1985 release, and the Triple Black colorway throughout the genuine leather upper and sole unit make this offering sleek and versatile. The Jordan 1 Mid Triple Black was originally made available on September 27th, 2022, retailing at $115.

title: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Granite
Nike KD 17 B.A.D.
description:
The Nike KD 17 B.A.D. puts a personal spin on Kevin Durant’s seventeenth signature shoe, honoring his late grandmother, Barbara A. Davis. Like the Aunt Pearl line, which predominantly features pink details, the B.A.D. line leans into lavender hues, and the KD 17 B.A.D. is no exception.

The sneaker showcases a gradient lavender hue on the breathable mesh upper with synthetic leather accents at the heel and a wavy TPU cage at the midfoot, providing structure. The tongue gets an iridescent KD patch, and Kevin Durant’s signature is etched at the heel. Underfoot, a large forefoot Zoom Air unit partners a springy Nike Air foam for shock absorption and cushioning, while a rubber outsole resembling a topographical map provides traction.

Something we love about the Nike KD 17 B.A.D. is its balance of performance and tribute. The sneaker offers a breathable mesh upper, supportive overlays, and responsive cushioning, all wrapped in a design that honors Barbara A. Davis in elegant lavender hues. The sneaker debuted on the 1st of January 2025 for $150.

title: Miniso Top Toy Jujutsu Kaisen Cat Ear Plushie Series Keychains Sealed Case (6 Blind Box)
description:
The Miniso Top Toy Jujutsu Kaisen Cat Ear Plushie Series Keychains bring a cute and playful twist to the popular anime franchise. This sealed case includes six blind boxes, each featuring a fan favorite Jujutsu Kaisen character reimagined with adorable cat ear styling and soft plush construction.

Designed as compact keychains, these plushies are perfect for backpacks, keys, or everyday accessories, while still offering strong display appeal for anime collectors. The combination of recognizable characters, cozy plush materials, and charming expressions makes each piece highly giftable and fun to collect.

Ideal for Jujutsu Kaisen fans, anime collectors, or blind box enthusiasts, this sealed case offers variety, value, and a full unboxing experience with six chances to pull unique character designs. The Miniso Top Toy Jujutsu Kaisen Cat Ear Plushie Series Keychains were released as a sealed blind box collection, with an original retail price of approximately $30 USD per sealed case of six blind boxes at Miniso stores.
primary_title: Miniso Top Toy Jujutsu Kaisen Cat Ear Plushie Series Keychains Sealed Case (6 Blind Box)

title: Nike Air Max 1 Essential White Pure Platinum Black
description:
The Nike Air Max 1 Essential White Pure Platinum Black delivers the Air Max 1 in one of its cleanest and most dependable forms, emphasizing balance and timeless design. The white base keeps the look crisp, while pure platinum and black accents add contrast that highlights the silhouette’s iconic lines. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it represents the Air Max 1 at its core. There is nothing trendy or fleeting here, just thoughtful color placement on a silhouette that has proven its relevance for decades. Fans love it as a daily staple, appreciating how it works across styles and seasons while still carrying the cultural importance that makes the Air Max 1 such a cornerstone of sneaker history.

The Nike Air Max 1 Essential White Pure Platinum Black was released on July 1, 2024 with a retail price of $140.

title: Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple White
description:
The Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple White 2020 takes on a 1990 original design, and is covered in an all-white finish.
​

Further, it displays Air Max units on both medial sides with a padded tongue panel printed with a Nike Swoosh emblem. Additionally, this Air Max Triple version has printed Nike branding on its heel.
​
​The Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple White 2020 debuted on July 28th, 2020, and retailed at $130.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Heritage
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Heritage flips the original Chicago colorway for a bold, unique look. It features a white and University Red smooth leather upper with black leather collars and red Swooshes. From there, a black and red woven Nike tongue label and an Air sole at the base completes the design.

title: Nike Dunk High Panda Black White (2021/2024)
description:
The Nike Dunk High Panda Black White 2021 features a smooth white leather upper with perforations on the toe box. Black leather overlays, eyestays and Swooshes match the black laces. The rubber outsole is black with a concentric-circles pattern for traction. The midsole is white with visible threading around the shoe. Black Nike branding appears on the white tongue and the heel features a black loop with arcs of white-on-white horizontal threading below it.
​
​ The Nike Dunk High Panda Black White 2021 was released on January 27, 2022 at a retail price of $115. The Nike Dunk High Panda also re-released in 2024.

title: Jordan 1 Low Sail College Grey Rattan
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low Sail College Grey Rattan brings an earthy and balanced palette to one of Jordan Brand’s most versatile silhouettes, leaning into natural tones that feel calm and intentional. The sail base softens the Jordan 1 Low’s familiar lines, while college grey and rattan inspired accents add depth and texture that feel understated rather than flashy. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it highlights the Jordan 1 Low at its most wearable. The muted color story lets the silhouette’s proportions and history shine without distraction, making it easy to pair with a wide range of looks. Fans appreciate how this release feels timeless and grounded, a sneaker that doesn’t chase trends but instead reinforces why subtle, well executed Jordan colorways tend to age the best and stay relevant year after year.

title: Nike Air Max 90 Victor Solomon Downtown Diamond District
Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 International Running Pack The Sting
description:
The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 International Running Pack The Sting embodies race day innovation through a vibrant and performance driven color story. Multi Colour tones blend with Starfish and Aloe Verde accents across the engineered upper, creating a look that feels fast even at rest. The sculpted midsole and visible Air pods highlight the advanced cushioning system that defines the Alphafly series.

The Alphafly has become synonymous with elite marathon performance, often seen on podiums during major international races. The Sting edition captures that global competitive spirit through bold color blocking and unmistakable speed focused design. For runners and collectors who follow cutting edge footwear, this release represents the forefront of Nike distance innovation.

The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 International Running Pack The Sting was released on September 5, 2025 with a retail price of $305.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Persian Violet
description:
Nike SB Dunk Low Persian Violet brings rich color to the skate driven silhouette, pairing a deep violet palette with the Dunk Low’s timeless shape. The result feels grounded and expressive, capturing a mood that feels both regal and rooted in counterculture attitude. It is a straightforward yet striking colorway that highlights how color alone can transform a familiar silhouette.

This release resonates with collectors because the SB Dunk Low continues to be a core canvas for mood and personality. Persian violet doesn’t need graphics or flash to stand out; it carries presence through hue and simplicity, appealing to fans who appreciate subtle impact and everyday wearability. It fits naturally into skate and lifestyle rotations alike.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Persian Violet was released on 10/07/2025 with a retail price of $120.

title: Jordan 1 Mid New Love (2025)
description:
The Jordan 1 Mid New Love (2025) revives a beloved color story with striking contrast and everyday wearability. Dressed in a Black/Varsity Maize-White palette (style HJ6654-071), this pair balances bold courtside heritage with clean street style. Smooth leather overlays frame a bright Varsity Maize toe box, collar, and heel, while a crisp white midsole lightens the look for a sharp, modern finish. Classic details, Wings logo at the collar, signature Swoosh sidewalls, and a padded, mid-cut silhouette, anchor the design in the DNA of the Air Jordan 1, making it a standout option for both collectors and daily rotation. The result is a timeless profile that turns heads without trying too hard.

Performance meets comfort with responsive Air cushioning underfoot and a durable rubber cupsole for confident traction. Thoughtful touches like a breathable perforated toe, plush collar foam, and secure lace closure offer a locked-in feel that lasts from first wear to long after break-in. Whether you’re pairing the Jordan 1 Mid with tapered denim or athletic staples, the New Love (2025) colorway adds energy to any outfit and nods to the silhouette’s hoops lineage. Arriving May 20, 2025, this release blends retro inspiration with contemporary polish, ideal for anyone seeking a versatile, high-impact sneaker that elevates the everyday.

Our team loves this product because the bold Varsity Maize accents, classic Air cushioning, and durable leather build make it great for all-day comfort, distinctive style, and collecting a modern take on an iconic Jordan 1 Mid colorway.

title: adidas Yeezy 500 Utility Black
description:
The hiking-inspired adidas Yeezy 500 Utility Black features a durable black mesh and suede upper that is prime for daily wear. From there, a sculptural adiPRENE sole offers responsiveness and support.

The adidas Yeezy 500 Utility Black originally released in July of 2018 for $200, and then restocked in November of 2020 and November of 2021.

title: New Balance 204L Pastel Pink
description:
The New Balance 204L Pastel Pink softens the bold 204L silhouette with a colorway that feels calm, playful, and surprisingly refined. The pastel pink finish transforms the shoe into something approachable and expressive, letting shape and texture shine without visual noise. It feels modern and fashion aware, designed for people who appreciate sneakers as part of personal style rather than just performance or heritage cues.

Fans love this release because it shows how color can completely shift the mood of a design. The 204L keeps its strong proportions, but the gentle pink tone makes it feel lighter and more versatile. Collectors appreciate how New Balance continues to explore color and form in a way that feels natural rather than forced, creating sneakers that feel current and emotionally resonant. This pair stands out as a lifestyle piece that feels confident, creative, and easy to wear.

The New Balance 204L Pastel Pink was released on November 18, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

title: Nike Sabrina 3 LX All-Star Warning Label (Women's)
Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Blue Spark
description:
The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Blue Spark brings a fresh jolt of energy to a legend. Inspired by the original Sergio Lozano design, this pair layers breathable mesh with smooth synthetic and leather overlays to create the signature gradient look, here shaded from Neutral Grey to Medium Grey and punctuated by vibrant Blue Spark hits. The sculpted lines mirror the contours of the human body, while the speed-lacing system locks in a personalized fit. Reflective accents catch the light at night, and the bold Swoosh and tongue branding sharpen the White/Blue Spark/Black/Neutral Grey/Medium Grey palette for a clean, modern finish that still feels unmistakably 95.

Underfoot, the "Big Bubble" profile spotlights amplified visible Air windows in the heel and forefoot, delivering that plush, springy ride the Air Max 95 is known for. A cushioned foam midsole softens every step, and the durable rubber outsole with flex grooves provides reliable traction for daily wear. Whether you’re pairing the IM7410-100 with denim or training gear, its retro-runner DNA and forward styling make it an easy standout. If you’re building a rotation around versatile colorways with punchy accents, this release offers all-day comfort and eye-catching appeal in one essential silhouette.

Our team loves this product because it blends timeless Air Max 95 heritage with a striking Blue Spark color pop and noticeably smooth cushioning that elevates both style and comfort.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Fear (2024) (GS)
description:
The Jordan 4 Retro Fear (2024) (GS) relaunches the recognizable silhouette from 2013, this time in a grade school size. It boasts a grayscale colorway with white, black, Anthracite, and Pure Platinum hues.

The sneaker is part of Jordan Brand’s Fear Pack, which promotes fearlessness and overcoming obstacles. The upper is crafted from open-weave mesh in black with layered nubuck overlays in Anthracite and light gray. Signature Air Jordan 4 elements include the nubuck lace cage, TPU eyelets, and visible Air-Sole units in the heel. The 2024 grade-school Jordan 4 Retro Fear showcases a speckled pattern across the midsole that complements the gray tones. The branding details are oversized, including a white Jumpman logo on the heel and a premium tongue tag with Michael Jordan’s signature.

Our experts at StockX like the subtle pop of color provided by the red hue on the Air-Sole units. The grade school-sized Jordan 4 Retro Fear (2024) (GS) was released on November 16, 2024, and sold for $160.

title: Bravest Studios Kross Kountry Runner Triple Black
description:
The Bravest Studios Kross Kountry Runner Triple Black delivers a sleek and understated take on the brand growing footwear presence. Wrapped entirely in Triple Black, the runner emphasizes shape and proportion over loud color blocking. The layered upper and sculpted sole give it a performance inspired stance that feels equally ready for the street.

Bravest Studios has never shied away from bold concepts, but an all black execution shows restraint in the best way. The monochrome look allows textures and panel work to stand out, making it a versatile option in any rotation. For supporters of the label, this pair reflects the brand ability to evolve while maintaining its confident identity.

title: UGG Lowmel Chestnut (Women's)
description:
The UGG Lowmel Chestnut (Women's) is a hybrid sneaker made for women that features some elements of the classic UGG boot.
   
This iteration of the UGG Lowmel comes in a Chestnut brown color that is dominant throughout. True to its hybrid nature, the upper is made of suede, recycled canvas, and recycled polyester. The toe box and ankle area are Chestnut polyester, while layered suede overlays round out the toe and form the sides, eyestays, mudguard, and heel counter. Recycled canvas in a tan color outlines the heel counter. UGG branding is debossed into the lateral heel, and another UGG patch is seen on the tongue. The heel has a pull tab, and the inside is lined with recycled wool. The shoe sits on a thick foam outsole. 

What we like best about this shoe is that it provides all the comfort of a boot or slipper but can be worn outside. The UGG Lowmel Chestnut (Women's) was initially released on June 24, 2024, for $150.

description:

The Seafoam Air Jordan 4 features a smooth white leather upper, with a black midsole and heel tab. Seafoam green eyelets, mudguard, sock lining, and tongue and heel logos, add a layer of contrast to the sneaker.

title: Vans OTW Old Skool 36 Parra
New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Workwear Grey
description:
The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Workwear Grey updates the running shoe technology introduced in the 990 and designs a high-performance running shoe that is as stylish as it is dependable.

The Made in USA New Balance 990 v6 in a Workwear/Grey colorway begins with an upper base of tannish-orange mesh that offers lightweight breathability. Perforated dark-gray leather forms overlays that course across the upper, tannish-orange suede forms the overlays at the eyestays and mud guard, and silvery leather hits the upper at the collar. The gray and white ENCAP midsole is made with propulsive FuelCell foam that offers cushioning and energy return and a polyurethane rim that provides durability. This sneaker rides on a black and gray rubber outsole.

Our favorite feature of this sneaker is the design of the side panel N, which features horizontally corrugated silvery-gray synthetic that is also used in the upper eyestays. The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Workwear Grey was released on March 4, 2024, for $200 retail.

title: Supreme Box Logo Hooded Sweatshirt (FW25) Magenta
description:
The Supreme Box Logo Hooded Sweatshirt FW25 Pink injects bold personality into a silhouette defined by restraint. The vibrant pink tone contrasts sharply with the minimal box logo design, creating a look that feels playful, confident, and unmistakably Supreme. The heavyweight fleece and familiar cut keep the hoodie rooted in tradition, even as the color pushes it into more expressive territory.

Fans love this colorway because it challenges expectations. It keeps everything that makes a box logo hoodie iconic, but the pink forces attention in a way that feels intentional and self assured. Collectors appreciate these louder color releases as moments where Supreme shows its range, offering pieces that feel just as legitimate as the classics while carrying a different kind of cultural energy.

The Gum outsole roots the design in its heritage, contrasting the contemporary textile update. Our experts commend the unique, high-texture finish created by the intricate crocheted Sand Strata upper, offering a stylish, artisanal twist on the classic Samba.

title: Yeezy Gap Cordura Cargo Pant Black
description:
The Yeezy Gap Cordura Cargo Pant in Black is a stylish and functional addition to any wardrobe. Crafted from durable Cordura fabric, these pants offer exceptional strength and resistance to wear and tear, making them ideal for everyday use or outdoor activities. The cargo-style design features multiple pockets, providing ample storage space for your essentials while maintaining a sleek, modern silhouette.

These pants showcase the distinctive Yeezy aesthetic, blending utilitarian elements with contemporary fashion. The black colorway offers versatility, allowing for easy pairing with a wide range of tops and footwear. With their comfortable fit and practical design, these cargo pants are perfect for those who appreciate both style and functionality in their clothing.

title: Jordan 5 Retro Reverse Metallic
description:
If you're looking for a striking-looking trainer with top-class credentials, the Jordan 5 Retro Reverse Metallic is right up there. It's an almost surrealistic take on the traditional high-top basketball shoe, with ultra-modern contours and high-tech accents.

This is a fascinating update on the Air Jordan 5. It has an ice white upper punctuated with black panels on the sole and collar. The leather upper has a synthetic mesh cut-out panel for breathability. The collar has a high front, crested by a long tongue, and an ultra-low back. The midsole has jagged white highlighting that creates a dramatic effect.

Our experts are very taken by this design. It's aggressive but also very familiar at the same time. It screams aggressive hoop action and makes one want to get out and play. description:
The Nike Vapor Edge 360 Untouchable Mid Black White (W) sneaker combines a sleek black body with contrasting white lace features and the iconic white Swoosh logo on both the side and toe. The black undertread features a third white Swoosh.

Launched as part of Nike’s Vapor Edge line, originally released ahead of Super Bowl LIV to bring soccer‑inspired speed tech to football. The mid-height profile silhouette, complete with sock ankle support, features internal bracing. Underfoot, the signature Vapor Edge 360 plate delivers 360-degree traction.

description:

Designed for everyday wear, this FW24 release pairs a refined, neutral tone with plush fleece for warmth and comfort you can feel from the first pull-on. A soft, brushed interior, elastic waistband with adjustable drawcord, and practical pockets round out the details, making these joggers an easy reach whether you’re commuting, training lightly, or unwinding at home.

True to Fear of God’s minimalist ethos, this Sweatpant keeps branding understated and the focus on premium feel and fit. The Light Heather Gray colorway lends effortless versatility, layering seamlessly with monochrome tees, heavyweight hoodies, and technical outerwear. title: Nike Book 1 Sedona
description:
The Nike Book 1 Sedona is a striking addition to the world of performance basketball sneakers. Designed in collaboration with NBA star Devin Booker, this shoe combines style and functionality in a package that's sure to turn heads on and off the court. The Magic Ember/White Onyx colorway offers a bold aesthetic, with the fiery orange hue reminiscent of the iconic red rocks of Sedona, Arizona – a nod to Booker's home state.

Engineered for optimal performance, the Nike Book 1 Sedona features cutting-edge technology to enhance a player's game. The shoe's construction likely includes Nike's renowned cushioning systems for responsive comfort and energy return, while the upper is designed to provide both breathability and support during intense play. The collar contains the Air Jordan logo in black, while a Nike Air logo patch adorns the tongue. A Summit White midsole gives way to a patterned Royal Blue outsole.

What we think stands out about this shoe are the Royal Blue accents, which allow the dark build of the shoe to stand out. The Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Royal was released on February 22, 2025, for a retail price of $160.

title: Puma Speedcat Ballet Silver (Women's)
description:
The Puma Speedcat Ballet Silver (Women's) presents a low‑profile metallic silver upper with signature Formstrip, elastic instep bands, and embroidered PUMA cat logo, white accents, seated on a lightweight rubber outsole for traction.

description:
Slip into effortless comfort with the Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide Black, a sleek, slip-on essential built to help you wind down and gear up with ease. Designed around Nike’s ReactX cushioning, the footbed delivers a plush, responsive feel that softens every step, ideal for post-workout recovery, travel days, or everyday errands. A wide, supportive strap secures the foot without pressure points, while the contoured bed cradles your arch and heel for stable, all-day wear. The all-Black/Black palette pairs seamlessly with athleisure or streetwear, and the streamlined silhouette keeps your look clean from poolside to pavement. Practical details elevate the experience: a textured footbed helps reduce slippage when feet are damp, and a durable outsole with a subtle traction pattern holds its own on wet or dry surfaces. Lightweight materials make these slides easy to pack and even easier to live in, while the soft, flexible construction minimizes break-in time. Released on April 23, 2025, the Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide merges recovery-ready comfort with a minimalist aesthetic, creating a versatile staple that feels as good as it looks, whether you’re cooling down after a training session or stepping out for a casual coffee run.

description:
Unveiling the epitome of timeless design with the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Satin Bred (Women's) in the ever-classic Black/University Red/White colorway. The sophisticated satin finish adorns the iconic silhouette, exuding a blend of vintage charm and modern-day chic.

Seize the essence of cool encapsulated in every stitch of the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Satin Bred, and step into a story that continues to redefine sneaker culture.

title: Nike 22" Air Force One Hardshell Luggage Black/Black/Black
description:
The Nike 22 Air Force One Hardshell Luggage Black Black Black translates one of the most iconic sneakers ever made into travel ready form. title: ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Mineral Beige Pink
description:
The ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Mineral Beige Pink is a technical running shoe that finds inspiration in heritage and contemporary ASICS models, including the Gel-Nimbus 3 from the 2000s and the Gel-MC Plus V.

Although the upper takes elements from the Gel-Nimbus 3, the midsole combines advanced underfoot technology from the Gel-Cumulus 16. The use of gel inserts in the rear and forefoot as well as a combination of foams creates a responsive feel and protects against impact stress.

Something our experts at StockX love is the pink suede panels that form the mudguard and adorn the toecap area. They complement the pink detailing on the midsole and add a contemporary touch to the sneaker’s retro construction. The adidas Superstar SpongeBob SquarePants Patrick Star brings playful energy to the legendary Superstar by spotlighting one of animation’s most lovable characters. The Nike Free midsole allows for natural foot movement, while the Metcon-inspired heel delivers the stability needed for weightlifting and other strength training exercises. title: Nike Air Max 1 '87 Photon Dust Wolf Grey
description:
The Nike Air Max 1 '87 Photon Dust Wolf Grey brings a sophisticated update to Nike's age-old classic. It blends soft grey hues with premium textures and pays homage to the original 1987 design, offering modern touches for a refreshed appeal.

The Photon Dust Wolf Grey Air Max 1 '87 by Nike combines a mesh base with suede overlays to create a layered look in Photon Dust, Wolf Grey, and Smoke Grey tones. title: Nike Book 1 Flagstaff
description:
The Nike Book 1 Flagstaff is a performance shoe designed as part of a partnership with American basketball star Devin Booker. 
       
This iteration of the Nike Book 1 has a smooth, durable upper in a Fir green color that represents the mountain paths and forests of Flagstaff, where Devin Booker goes to escape the desert heat. Decorative stitching crosses the upper for visual interest. A white outline of the Swoosh appears on each side. The tongue contains a Book branding patch and pays homage to Humphrey’s Peak, the highest point in Flagstaff. The heels are adorned with gold lettering reading "Flagstaff" on one heel and "no service" on the other. An Air Zoom unit under the heel allows for responsiveness and quick movements. 

What we like best about this shoe is the woven tongue tag, paying homage to Humphrey’s Peak, which provides a nice contrast to the green color of the rest of the shoe. The Nike Book 1 Flagstaff was released on February 1, 2025, for $140.

title: Nike Sabrina 2 Activate (Women's)

The streamlined silhouette pairs a breathable mesh upper with supportive overlays to keep you light on your feet while reinforcing high-wear zones. A secure lacing system and sculpted collar provide locked-in stability without restricting motion, delivering confidence on fast breaks and late-game matchups. Underfoot, a responsive foam midsole teams with a low-profile ride for smooth transitions and excellent court feel, while a grippy rubber outsole with a multi-directional traction pattern helps you stop on a dime, change direction, and explode to the rim.

Styled in Apricot Agate, Light Bone, Washed Coral, and Washed Teal, this colorway blends soft, sun-washed hues with crisp detailing for a look that stands out on hardwood and street alike. Signature Sabrina accents nod to elite playmaking, and the iconic Swoosh adds a refined finish to a shoe that seamlessly merges style and substance. From intense training sessions to weekend runs at the gym, the Nike Sabrina 2’s balanced cushioning and stable platform are tuned for comfort over four quarters, while the durable build is ready for season-after-season mileage. Pair it with your go-to on-court kit or casual fits, the versatile design complements both performance needs and everyday rotation.

Our team loves this product because it delivers agile traction, supportive lockdown, and versatile style, making it a standout choice for players who demand speed, stability, and a polished look.

title: Nike Air Zoom Victory Hyper Pink Laser Orange
description:
The Nike Air Zoom Victory Hyper Pink Laser Orange is a cutting-edge running spike designed for elite performance on the track. Featuring a vibrant Hyper Pink upper with striking Laser Orange accents, this shoe combines style with functionality. The innovative Air Zoom technology in the midsole provides responsive cushioning, while the lightweight construction ensures maximum speed and agility during races.

Built for middle-distance runners, the Air Zoom Victory boasts a full-length carbon fiber plate that delivers exceptional energy return with each stride. The breathable mesh upper offers a snug, sock-like fit, enhancing comfort and reducing distractions during intense competition. The strategically placed spike plate provides optimal traction on various track surfaces, allowing athletes to maintain their pace and form throughout their events.

Us at StockX believe this product is great for competitive runners seeking a high-performance spike that combines speed, comfort, and durability in one eye-catching package.

title: Nike Ja 3 Snowed In (GS)
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Christmas GS brings festive energy to Ja Morant’s signature line in grade school sizing. Featuring White with Bright Crimson, Volt, and Black accents, the upper blends bold holiday inspired contrast with a performance focused silhouette. The low cut profile and responsive cushioning maintain the explosive identity of the Ja series.

Christmas editions often stand out for their vibrant palettes, and this release embraces that tradition with confidence. Volt hits add electric brightness, while crimson details nod to seasonal themes. It feels lively and expressive, designed for young athletes who want statement energy on the court.

title: Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black Panda (PS)
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black PS features an entirely white leather upper with black overlays. The touches of black continue to the Swoosh branding, and the vintage basketball shoe is finished off with a padded collar and nylon mesh tongue, a white midsole, and a black outsole and treading.
