title: Jordan 12 Retro Melo (GS)
description:
The Jordan 12 Retro Melo (GS) is a stylish and comfortable sneaker designed for young athletes and fashion-forward kids. Featuring a crisp white leather upper with university blue accents, these shoes pay homage to NBA star Carmelo Anthony's signature colorway. The iconic Jordan 12 silhouette is enhanced with metallic silver detailing, creating a sleek and eye-catching look that's sure to turn heads on and off the court.

These sneakers aren't just about looks - they're built for performance too. The full-length Zoom Air unit provides responsive cushioning, while the durable rubber outsole offers excellent traction for quick cuts and sudden stops. The padded collar and tongue ensure a snug, comfortable fit, making these shoes perfect for all-day wear. Our team thinks this product is great for young basketball enthusiasts looking to emulate their favorite players while enjoying superior comfort and style.

title: Nike Kobe 6 Total Orange (GS)
description:
Light up the court in the Nike Kobe 6 Total Orange (GS), a kids’ take on the iconic low-top built for speed, control, and all-day comfort. The striking Total Orange/Metallic Silver/Cosmic Clay palette pops from warm-up to buzzer, while the Mamba-inspired, scaled texture adds depth and dimension to the streamlined profile. A padded collar and secure lacing offer a locked-in feel, and the sculpted heel provides extra stability through quick cuts and step-backs. Underfoot, plush, responsive cushioning softens landings and keeps young athletes fresh through drills, games, and after-school play.

Designed for agile movement, the Kobe 6’s flexible forefoot and durable rubber outsole deliver confident traction on hardwood or blacktop. Breathable materials help manage heat during high-intensity runs, and the lightweight build makes it easy for developing players to find their rhythm without extra bulk. Finished with crisp Metallic Silver Swooshes and detailed with the FV9676-800 style code, this colorway captures the relentless energy that defines the Kobe lineage, perfect for kids who play hard and want standout style to match.

We're seeing major traction on this drop since it pairs bold, high-visibility color with dependable cushioning and grip, making it a standout choice for young hoopers who demand performance and style.

title: Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple Black
description:
The Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple Black 2020 was released as an addition to the Nike Air Max 90 collection. 

The Leather Triple Nike Air Max 90 Black 2020 has a midsole that is equipped with Nike's patented Air Max technology, providing maximum comfort and cushioning with each step. The air unit is visible through the outsole of the shoe. The outsole of the sneaker features a waffle pattern that provides excellent traction and grip on various surfaces. 

We think that one outstanding feature of the Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple Black 2020 is its colorway. The upper of the Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple Black 2020 sneaker is made with multiple leather panels, which are all black. The panels are textured, giving the shoe a unique design that stands out from other sneakers. The Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple Black 2020 was released on July 28th, 2020 at a retail price of $130.

title: Burberry Slides Archive Beige (Women's)
description:
The Burberry Slides Archive Beige (Women's) feature the classic Vintage Check print on a pair of slides made from premium materials.

These women's-sized slides boast a contoured insole that supports the arch and provides comfort during extended wear. The slip-on style allows the wearer to put on and remove the shoes easily. The placement of the strap prevents them from falling off the foot. The Black and Beige Colorway can be seen on the Vintage Check print, displaying black and red lines crossing the Beige background. Although the branding details are minimal, "BURBERRY" is embossed along the lateral side of the outsole.

What our experts like about the women's slides is the simplistic design. Specifically, the choice of Black for the outsole allows the Vintage Check print to take center stage. The Burberry Slides Archive Beige (Women's) were released on March 1st, 2023, and retailed at $370.

title: adidas Yeezy Slide Flax
description:
The adidas Yeezy Slide Flax is a slip on that takes on a minimalist design and is available in a monochromatic finish in dark beige or Flax color.

The Slide Flax by Yeezy for adidas is made from injected EVA material, and the sandal takes the shape of a one-piece mold. The construction is lightweight with foam compounds for cushioning. The same material extends underfoot, where the slide has a series of horizontal grooves for traction.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Flax was first released on the 22nd of August 2022, with an initial retail price set at $70. The adidas Yeezy Slide Flax was released again on the 20th of March 2024, with a retail price set at $70.

title: Jordan 12 Retro Barons
description:
The Jordan 12 Retro Barons brings a fresh new colorway to the iconic Jordan 12 silhouette, drawing inspiration from an often overlooked chapter in Michael Jordan’s legendary career—his time with the Birmingham Barons, a minor league baseball team. During his brief departure from basketball in 1994, MJ pursued a childhood dream of playing professional baseball, a decision that stunned fans worldwide. The "Barons" colorway pays tribute to this unique period, offering a sleek black, wolf grey, and white design that echoes the colors of the Barons' uniforms.

First introduced in 1996, the Jordan 12 has remained a staple in the Jordan Brand lineup thanks to its premium materials and timeless design. Known for its durable leather upper, the Jordan 12 was also the first Air Jordan to feature Nike’s Zoom Air cushioning technology. This new Barons colorway showcases a sleek and minimalistic look that makes this model a versatile option for both casual wear and on-court performance.

Released on September 28, 2024, the Jordan 12 Retro Barons retailed at $200. This sneaker honors a unique moment in Michael Jordan’s career while maintaining the classic style and performance features that have made the Jordan 12 a fan favorite for nearly three decades.

title: adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Crystal White Silver (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Crystal White Silver Womens reimagines the iconic Samba through a glamorous and fashion forward lens. Crystal white leather forms a clean and minimal base, elevated by rhinestone detailing that catches light with every step. Silver metallic accents add refinement, while the gum sole maintains the shoe’s connection to its athletic origins. The contrast between sparkle and simplicity defines the look.

This version appeals to fans who enjoy pushing classic silhouettes into new spaces. It feels expressive and confident, designed for those who see sneakers as an extension of personal style rather than purely function. Collectors value how the rhinestone treatment transforms a familiar shape into something celebratory and bold without compromising its recognizability. It is a statement piece that still carries the cultural weight of the Samba name.

The adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Crystal White Silver Womens was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Concepts Orange Lobster
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Concepts Orange Lobster comes toned in a mixture of three main colors: electro orange, orange frost, and white.

This Low Nike SB Dunk features a nubuck upper with varying orange tones, softly speckled overlays, and a tonal Swoosh accented in white. The interior lining is embellished with a bib-inspired pattern, and the white mesh tongue is embellished with a woven Nike SB tag. The shoe boasts an orange rubber outsole and a cupsole with black sidewalls.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Concepts Orange Lobster was set to retail at $120 at its market launch on December 20th, 2022.

title: adidas Samba OG Maroon Gold Metallic (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Maroon Gold Metallic (Women's) takes the classic Samba silhouette design and applies a rich colorway of maroon with Metallic Gold details.

The upper construction boasts smooth leather in maroon, while the toecap is made of soft suede in tonal maroon. The difference in textures creates subtle contrast and a luxury feel. The signature serrated 3-Stripes logo on the side panels is made of white leather. ‘SAMBA’ in Metallic Gold lettering runs along the 3-Stripes logo on the lateral side panel and complements the gold adidas logo printed on the tongue tag. Both the tongue and heel collar come in Cream White, which adds to the sneaker’s vintage appeal.

Our experts at StockX like the use of gum rubber on the durable outsole. The women’s size adidas Samba OG Maroon Gold Metallic (Women's) was released on February 9th, 2024, and retailed at $100.

title: adidas Adizero Evo SL Bob Marley Bold Gold
Nike Kobe 4 Protro Gold Medal (2024)
description:
The Nike Kobe 4 Protro Gold Medal 2024 is a re-release of an iconic colorway that pays tribute to Kobe Bryant's legendary performance at the 2008 Olympics. This sneaker, featuring a striking white, dark obsidian, varsity red, and metallic gold colorway, celebrates Kobe’s pivotal role in the Redeem Team, where he led Team USA to victory and secured his place in Olympic history. The Protro line brings modern performance upgrades to this classic silhouette, combining heritage with innovation.

Designed with advanced tech, the Kobe 4 Protro features enhanced cushioning for superior comfort and support, making it perfect for both on-court performance and off-court style. The shoe’s low-cut design allows for maximum agility, while the Flywire technology offers a secure fit. The heel features the number 10 to honor the number Kobe wore in the Olympics. The colorway’s gold accents symbolize the triumph and excellence of Kobe’s Olympic journey, making this sneaker a meaningful addition to any collection.

Released on August 6, 2024, the Nike Kobe 4 Protro Gold Medal retailed at $190. This sneaker’s blend of white, dark obsidian, varsity red, and metallic gold captures the essence of a significant moment in basketball history. With its blend of historical significance and modern enhancements, the Kobe 4 Protro Gold Medal continues to resonate with fans and athletes alike.

title: Jordan 3 Retro TEX Starfish (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 3 Retro TEX Starfish (Women’s) reimagines the 1988 icon with rugged, modern polish. A mixed-material upper pairs durable textiles with premium overlays, set in a refined Fossil and Sail base that lets the vivid Starfish accents energize every step. Classic AJ3 DNA is all here, the bold midsole, perforated details, and heritage heel tab, refreshed with the TEX treatment for a versatile, street-ready feel. Subtle contrast stitching and textured panels add depth, while the Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel keeps the look true to the lineage created by Tinker Hatfield.

Underfoot, a cushioned midsole with visible Air in the heel delivers day-long comfort, supported by a sturdy rubber outsole that grips city pavement and court surfaces alike. The padded collar and secure lacing system lock in a stable ride, making the Jordan 3 Retro TEX as wearable as it is striking. Styled in the IH7694-200 colorway, this pair blends Fossil/Starfish/Sail into a palette that’s effortlessly versatile, easy to dress up or down and perfect for rotation year-round. If you’re seeking a standout women’s Jordan that balances timeless design with functional edge, this release lands right on target.

This release earns its place in the collection because it blends the AJ3’s legendary shape with resilient materials and a lively Starfish pop, making it an everyday staple that still turns heads.

title: Jordan 4 Retro Thunder (2023) (GS)
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro Thunder (2023) (GS) comes in a black and tour yellow color scheme.

The Retro Thunder Jordan 4 (2023) (GS) features an upper that is a combination of leather and mesh and is constructed in black and yellow accents. The Thunder colorway features yellow accents on the midsole, lacing eyelets, and lining. The heel of the shoe features an Air unit that provides impact protection and responsive cushioning. The rubber outsole provides grip and durability, while the cushioned midsole provides stability and sturdiness. The inner section is constructed for a snug fit and the insole features both Yeezy and adidas branding. The thick, polyurethane midsole features full-length EVA cushioning and boasts adidas branding on its heel. The rubber outsole sports herringbone traction interspersed with pods.

Five sharp, silver-toned claws stick out of the upper and mimic a bear’s claws. The footbed is crafted from smooth synthetic material and displays ‘BRAVEST STUDIOS’ in a rectangular silver box. The lining comes in a warm brown that matches the color of the fur upper. Finally, the black outsole features a light traction pattern that provides grip on various surfaces.

The upper construction features breathable mesh in white with a slightly loose weave. Aqua accents add splashes of color on the tongue branding, plastic pieces on the midsole, and along the upper. Like running sneakers in the ASICS catalog from the early 2000s, this shoe displays synthetic overlays with black and metallic silver stripes. In terms of technology, gel units in the midsole provide supportive cushioning and protect against impact stress. Padding around the collar and in the tongue contributes to the sneaker’s bulky, Y2K aesthetic.

Our StockX experts like the metallic silver mudguard that protects the toe area and carries a hint of aqua. The grade school–sized ASICS Gel-1130 White Aqua (GS) was originally released on March 3, 2024, and sold for $85.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High Royal Toe
description:
Jordan Brand adds a twist to a classic with the Jordan 1 Retro High Royal Toe, now available on StockX. Releases like the Shattered Backboard 1 and Bred Toe have shifted all eyes on Jordan’s "Black Toe" inspired colorways. The Royal Toe takes inspiration from the original Jordan 1 Royal colorway (which released in 1985) and adds design elements of the Black Toe 1 to create a familiar, but new dialogue.

This AJ 1 features a white and royal leather upper with black leather overlays and detailing. A white midsole, royal outsole, and branded leather tongue tag completes this design. These sneakers released in May of 2020 and retailed for $170 USD.

description:
The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Shadow (2024) is a low-top sneaker with a colorway that is reminiscent of the original 1985 version of the shoe.

This iteration of the Jordan 1 Retro Low OG is completely made of leather. The upper is gray and black, with gray coloring the perforated toebox and the heel, while reflective black adorns the midsole, the lining of the toebox, and the overlays. The Nike Swoosh also appears in gray across the midsole. The Air Jordan logo appears in black on the gray heel tab, and a Nike Air patch can be found on the tongue. The mesh tongue and lining allow for breathability and extra comfort, while the sole is patterned for traction.

Our favorite thing about this shoe is the simple colorway with shiny black leather. It gives the shoe a sleek and stylish look. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Shadow (2024) was released on May 11, 2024, for a retail price of $140.

description:
The adidas Climamog Off White, also known as the adidas Climacool Off White, is a 3D-printed running shoe that offers the breathability of a sandal but features a one-piece design that conforms to the foot’s natural shape.

Inspired by other boundary-pushing models in the adidas catalog and the label’s commitment to sustainability, this slip-on shoe is crafted from polyurethane, a plastic polymer known for its durability and flexibility. The construction boasts a web of crisscrossing lattices, giving the lightweight shoe a futuristic, minimalist feel. In addition, the entire shoe comes in neutral Off White, with the molded 3-Stripes on the side panels making up the only branding details. In terms of comfort, the runner offers arch support and protective padding around the heel.

Our experts at StockX appreciate the way the shoe minimizes waste by reducing the total amount of materials used. The adidas Climamog Off White was released on October 25, 2024, and sold for $140.

The adidas Campus 00s Grey White comes in a grey three, footwear white, and off-white color scheme.

The sneaker has a durable rubber outsole for stability and traction. The sneaker's EVA wedge midsole provides comforting cushioning. The side perforations of the shoe provide ventilation and comfort. The shoe features the classic adidas 3-Stripes branding on the lateral sides. The sneaker has a "CAMPUS" inscription on one side. The shoe's design is completed with the adidas Trefoil logo on the tongue and heel.
​

description:
The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro Mambacita stands out as a touching tribute celebrating Gigi Bryant’s legacy, bringing a beloved silhouette back with fresh, meaningful details. Sporting a dramatic gradient shift from white to black across its engineered mesh upper, this sneaker strikes a balance of elegance and athleticism. Distinct metallic gold accents, from the shimmering Swoosh to the detailed "Gigi" embroidery, enrich the design with subtle opulence.

Every thoughtful detail—from the golden heart with "2" honoring Gigi's jersey number on the heel to the marbled black and white sole—captures the spirit of basketball and the enduring Bryant legacy. title: ASICS Gel-1130 White Midnight (GS)
description:
The ASICS Gel-1130 White Midnight (GS) is a stability running shoe that draws inspiration from the Gel-Kayano series, in particular the Gel-Kayano 14, and the ninth iteration of the GEL-1000 series.

Originally introduced in 2008, the White Midnight (GS) ASICS Gel-1130 features white mesh underlays that provide breathability and create an airy feel. While previous models used genuine leather to create the supportive overlays, this version replaces genuine leather with faux leather. This materials upgrade gives the sneaker a modern look while paying tribute to archived design details. In addition, the sneaker boasts GEL technology in the heel for shock absorption and a TRUSSTIC support system for improved stability.

Our experts at StockX like the Midnight details on the rubber outsole, collar lining, and overlays, which break up the sneaker’s primarily white and silver aesthetic. The grade school-sized ASICS Gel-1130 White Midnight (GS) was released on March 3, 2024, and retailed at $85.

description:

description:

The combination of leather and mesh creates a lightweight yet durable upper, while thick padding around the collar protects the ankle. Twin Jumpman logos, one on the mesh tongue and one on the heel, come in Midnight Navy, while a large white Jumpman decorates the outsole. Like other AJ11 models, this version features a semi-translucent rubber outsole and patches of Diffused Blue on the herringbone traction pattern. Finally, an encapsulated Nike Air unit protects against impact without weighing down the shoe.

Our experts appreciate the tonal stitching along the Diffused Blue mudguard because it contributes to the color contrast between the white mesh and the patent leather. The Jordan 11 Retro Low Diffused Blue was released on August 17, 2024, and retailed at $190.

title: Jordan 3 Retro Green Glow
description:
The Air Jordan 3 Retro Green Glow is an electrifying addition to the Jordan lineage, incorporating a mesmerizing green glow color treatment that first captivated fans on the Jordan 4. This new colorway, set against a backdrop of black, green glow, wolf grey, and white, is a bold reinterpretation of the iconic Jordan 3 silhouette. Designed for the sneaker aficionado who appreciates the blend of classic design and innovative accents, this sneaker is a testament to Jordan Brand's commitment to evolution while honoring its heritage.

Since its original release, the Jordan 3 has been celebrated for its revolutionary design, including the introduction of the visible Air unit and the elephant print detailing. The Green Glow version elevates the classic with its vibrant accents, offering a fresh take on the model's celebrated features. It's a sneaker that bridges the past and the present, appealing to both long-time Jordan enthusiasts and a new generation seeking to make a statement with their footwear.

Launched on March 16, 2024, for $200, the Air Jordan 3 Retro Green Glow quickly lit up the sneaker community, becoming a must-have for collectors and style trendsetters. Its release is celebrated as a moment when the iconic Jordan 3 silhouette was reimagined with a bold, new colorway, inviting wearers to step into the glow of Jordan Brand's innovative legacy.

title: Nike TC 7900 Pale Ivory Gum Light Brown Armory Navy (Women's)
description:
Nike TC 7900 Pale Ivory Gum Light Brown Armory Navy Womens channels early two thousands trail running vibes with a palette that feels warm and wearable. The pale ivory base and gum accented sole evoke nostalgia while grounding the runner in a contemporary lifestyle context. Armory navy and light brown tones add balance, giving the silhouette a layered look that feels intentional without being loud.

This pair resonates with collectors because it bridges performance heritage and modern everyday wear naturally. The TC 7900 design speaks to an era when technical runners became woven into culture beyond tracks and trails, and this execution reflects that crossover without losing the silhouette’s functional identity. It feels like a piece that belongs in both rotation and curated collections.

The Nike TC 7900 Pale Ivory Gum Light Brown Armory Navy Womens was released on 06/15/2024 with a retail price of $120.
secondary_title: Pale Ivory Gum Light Brown Armory Navy (Women's)

title: Nike Air Max 90 Iron Grey
description:
Originally designed as running shoes, the Nike Air Max 90 Iron Grey sticks to its roots with the Waffle sole, a textile/leather upper, and classic TPU details.

The Nike Air Max 90 Iron Grey features a textile upper with leather and synthetic overlays. Most of the sneaker is in iron grey, with the Swooshes appearing in white on the lateral and medial sides. The low top also includes a padded tongue and collar for maximum comfort, and underfoot, Max Air cushioning provides cushioning, while the Waffle sole adds traction and durability.

The Nike Air Max 90 Iron Grey was released in January 2020 and retailed for $120.

title: Nike Free Run 5.0 Black Off Noir
description:
The Nike Free Run 5.0 Black Off Noir is a sock-like boot of a sneaker that offers a lightweight design intended to create a comfortable barefoot feeling with each step.

The Black Off Noir Nike Free Run 5.0 is a sneaker dressed in unrelieved black. The upper is lightweight breathable knit fabric with Flywire loops that run from the laces down the side panel to add stability and structure. A thick textile heel counter offers support and a heel pull tab makes on/off easy for this pair of kicks. A black tongue and black insole both feature swoosh-pinwheel branding. The midsole is constructed from soft, lightweight foam with laser-cut grooves that add flexibility. A rubber outsole at the forefoot and heel provides durability.

The detail of these Nike shoes we enjoy the most are the reflective swooshes on the lateral side. The subtle sheen in daylight glows in the dark when the lights go out. The Nike Free Run 5.0 Black Off Noir was released on June 28, 2021, for a retail price of $100.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High Light Smoke Grey
description:
Jordan delivered another new colorway of their most popular silhouette with the Jordan 1 Retro High Light Smoke Grey, now available on StockX. Following a similar reconstructed design language as the Jordan 1 Union LA from 2018, this Jordan 1 utilizes color blocking and different materials to present familiar colors in a unique format.

The Jordan 1 High Light Smoke Grey is composed of a white leather upper with grey suede overlays and a red leather ankle panel. Black suede on the heel paneling and Swoosh, a white midsole, and black outsole completes the design. This Jordan 1 released in July of 2020 and retailed for $170 USD.

title: Casio G-Shock GA2100-1A1
description: The Casio G-Shock GA2100-1A1 Black, released in 2020, may be the most successful of any new model in quite some time. Immediately sold out everywhere it was available, the GA2100-1A1 was an instant classic. Featuring G-Shock's new carbon core, the body of the GA2100-1A1 is a high-strength resin that is reinforced with carbon fibers. Add the slim profile, blacked-out features and gorgeous analog-digital display it's easy to see why the GA2100-1A1 is a winner.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Atmosphere (Women's)
description:
The women's Air Jordan 1 High Atmosphere follows the classic Black Toe color blocking format with a white and dark navy leather upper. Light pink patent leather on the ankle and vamp nods to the pink bubblegum that Michael Jordan chewed throughout his time on the hardwood. Woven Nike tongue labels and a signature Jordan Wings logo draw inspiration from the original 1985 Jordan 1 design.

The women's Air Jordan 1 High Atmosphere released in December of 2021 and retailed for $170.

title: Nike Kobe 8 Protro What The (2025) (GS)
description:
First released in 2013, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro What The (2025) (GS) returns triumphantly. This eclectic model embodies the spirit of the Kobe 8 series, combining several colors and designs into a single, vibrant sneaker.

The What The (2025) Nike Kobe 8 Protro comes in grade school sizing. It takes an audacious approach to design, featuring a right shoe that showcases a mesh built-in red snakeskin print with a yellow Swoosh and lime green lining. The left shoe is mismatched, showcasing a contrasting blue snakeskin print with a crimson Swoosh that matches its textile lining. A reflective Nike wordmark graces the medial side of the left shoe, with its counterpart getting a yellow Swoosh. The colorful sneaker rides atop a Cushlon midsole, with the forefoot section getting a trusty Zoom Air unit.

What our experts love about the Nike Kobe 8 Protro What The (2025) (GS) is its bold and colorful design that combines nearly 30 colorways from the silhouette’s history to create a wild, mismatched masterpiece. The grade-school sneaker debuted for $120 on April 13, 2025.

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 Black
description:
Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 Black feels like a bridge between skate history and Supreme’s early visual language, pulling inspiration from the mid nineties era that shaped both brands. The black upper gives the shoe a serious and raw tone, while the Supreme influence adds cultural weight that longtime fans instantly recognize. It feels rooted in authenticity rather than trend chasing, designed for people who understand where SB culture comes from.

This release stands out because it honors restraint. Instead of loud graphics, the design relies on mood and legacy, letting subtle details do the storytelling. Collectors gravitate toward Supreme SB Dunks like this because they represent moments when skateboarding, fashion, and attitude aligned naturally, creating pieces that age with meaning rather than noise.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 Black was released on 09/04/2025 with a retail price of $135.

title: adidas SL 72 OG Rhinestone Grey Black (Women's)
description:
The adidas SL 72 OG Rhinestone Grey Black Womens reimagines a running archive staple with a touch of sparkle that feels both playful and elevated. Grey Two sets a soft neutral base, while Core Black overlays maintain the vintage athletic structure that defined the original SL 72. Rhinestone detailing catches the light subtly, adding texture and personality without overwhelming the slim retro profile.

The SL 72 has always been about lightweight heritage and streamlined design, and this version keeps that spirit alive while leaning into modern styling. Fans of adidas archives appreciate when the brand experiments carefully, and the rhinestone accents feel like a fashion forward update rather than a gimmick. It transforms a classic runner into something that bridges sport history and statement streetwear in a way that still feels authentic.

The adidas SL 72 OG Rhinestone Grey Black Womens was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

title: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low Black Black
model: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low
description:
The Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low in Black/Black distills Japanese avant-garde design into an everyday sneaker with standout character. Its signature OG sole, sculpted to look artfully warped, delivers that unmistakable Mihara aesthetic, complete with exaggerated foxing and a chunky rubber profile that turns heads from every angle. A sturdy black canvas upper keeps the palette stealth and versatile, while a tonal rubber toe cap and textured outsole add durability and grip for city streets. Subtle branding on the tongue and heel plate nods to the label’s design language without shouting, creating a refined balance between bold shape and minimalist color.

Engineered for comfort as much as style, the Hank features a cushioned footbed and supportive low-top cut that moves easily from long days on the go to nights out. The monochrome finish pairs effortlessly with wide-leg trousers, cropped denim, or technical layers, making it a go-to for contemporary wardrobes. Released under style code A05FW702, this silhouette captures the spirit of modern luxury sneakers, distinctive, art-forward, and built to last, while the OG sole’s organic waves bring a sculptural dimension that elevates any fit. If you’re seeking a statement shoe that still plays well with everyday looks, this Black/Black colorway is the definition of wearable edge.

Our team loves this product because it blends gallery-worthy design with daily comfort, offering a bold, all-black silhouette that upgrades casual rotation without sacrificing versatility.
primary_title: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low

title: adidas BW Army Lux Black Gum
description:
The adidas BW Army Lux Black Gum is a sophisticated take on the classic military-inspired sneaker. Featuring a sleek black upper crafted from premium materials, this shoe combines style and durability. The iconic gum sole provides excellent traction and a timeless aesthetic, while the luxurious details elevate the overall design to new heights.

Comfort meets style in this reimagined classic. The BW Army Lux boasts a cushioned insole for all-day comfort, making it perfect for both casual wear and more formal occasions. The black colorway offers versatility, easily pairing with a wide range of outfits. With its blend of military heritage and modern luxury, this sneaker is sure to become a staple in any footwear collection.

Our team thinks this product is great for those seeking a versatile, high-quality sneaker that seamlessly transitions from day to night.

title: adidas Samba OG Snakeskin Collegiate Green (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Black Cream White Collegiate Green refreshes the legendary silhouette with a color palette that feels both grounded and expressive. Black leather anchors the upper, contrasted by cream white accents that soften the look and collegiate green details that add character and depth. The familiar gum sole reinforces the Samba’s heritage while keeping the overall presentation clean and balanced.

Collectors appreciate this colorway because it feels versatile without being predictable. The green accent brings a subtle collegiate energy that nods to sport culture while remaining easy to style across different aesthetics. This version of the Samba feels intentional and wearable, proving that thoughtful color placement can keep a decades old design feeling relevant. It is the kind of pair that quietly earns its place in rotation through comfort, history, and effortless appeal.

The adidas Samba OG Black Cream White Collegiate Green was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG True Blue
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG True Blue was a special release that marks the 35th anniversary of the Air Jordan 3 line.

The upper section of this Retro High shoe is constructed of smooth leather. The base is white, the Swoosh is true blue, and the overlays are true blue and cement gray. True blue is also used for the Wings logo on the collar, tongue tag, laces, Nike Air branding on the white insole, and sock liner. Soles with encapsulated AIR units complete the design.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG True Blue debuted on January 14th, 2023 for $180 retail.

title: adidas Harden Vol. 9 Pure Ruby
description:
adidas Harden Vol 9 Pure Ruby brings bold confidence to James Harden’s signature line through a colorway that feels intense and expressive. Pure Ruby amplifies the Harden Vol 9’s futuristic shape, giving it a striking identity that mirrors Harden’s fearless scoring mentality. The color choice feels intentional, leaning into drama and presence rather than subtlety.

This pair resonates with collectors because the Harden line has always been about individuality and control. The Vol 9 silhouette continues that tradition with a look that feels sharp and assertive, appealing to fans who appreciate signature shoes that carry personality. It stands as a reminder that Harden releases thrive when they embrace bold expression and on court authority together.

The adidas Harden Vol 9 Pure Ruby was released on 07/09/2025 with a retail price of $160.

title: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Vintage Birch Black
description:
The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Vintage Birch Black is a lifestyle sneaker that takes its inspiration from training shoes that originally debuted at the Mexico Games in 1966.

The Vintage Birch Black colorway of the Onitsuka Tigers Mexico 66 features an elegant upper of textured birch-colored cow leather. The black tiger stripes coursing across the side panel are in cow suede. A T-toe overlay, an eye stay overlay, and heel overlays are in a richer birch cow suede that matches the sock liner. The flat cotton laces and tongue match the lighter hue of the upper base. Heel-cross reinforcements add both stability and style to this shoe. Onitsuka Tiger branding adorns the heel tab, the tongue tag, and the black insole that has perforations for breathability.

The aspect of this Onitsuka sneaker that we enjoy the most is the subtle yet durable and dependable sole unit. Underneath a thin foam midsole, a rubber outsole is grooved in a consistent pattern for traction and impact absorption. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Vintage Birch was released on July 22, 2023, for a retail price of $130.

title: Nike Air Diamond Turf 49ers (2025)
description:
The Nike Air Diamond Turf 49ers (2025) brings back Deion Sanders' first signature sneaker, originally introduced in 1993, with a bold colorway that pays homage to his time with the San Francisco 49ers. This retro release stays true to the original design with its distinctive midfoot strap, crisp white leather upper, black nubuck overlays, and fire red accented on the Nike Swoosh, liner and parts of the oputsole creating a look that’s both nostalgic and fresh. A bold and distinct colorway that nods to Sanders' legendary career and the 49ers' championship pedigree.

Designed for versatility, the Air Diamond Turf was originally built to support Sanders' dual-sport dominance in both the NFL and MLB. The secure midfoot strap not only delivers standout style but also ensures a snug, comfortable fit. A cushioned midsole enhances support, while the durable rubber outsole offers dependable traction. The tongue and heel branding provide an extra layer of flair, making this sneaker a standout addition to any rotation.

Released on January 24, 2025, the Nike Air Diamond Turf 49ers (2025) retailed for $150. Dressed in white, fire red, black, and metallic gold, this reissue celebrates both the sneaker's heritage and Deion Sanders’ impact on sports and fashion, making it an essential pick for collectors and fans alike.

title: Nike Free RN 2018 Wolf Grey
description:
The Nike Free RN 2018 Wolf Gray is a running shoe that comes in a Wolf Gray colorway with White accents.

The upper of this Free RN 2018 sneaker features a lightweight, breathable material that allows air to circulate freely. The shoe includes Flywire cables integrated into the laces to provide a customizable fit that adapts to your foot's shape and movement for a secure and comfortable feel. The Nike Swoosh is visible on both sides while the Nike Free RN branding is seen on the tongue and heel.

Our experts say that the standout feature of the Nike Free RN 2018 Wolf Gray is its updated Nike Free sole, which employs a tri-star outsole pattern to allow the foot to move more naturally. This unique pattern enhances flexibility and stability while reducing the overall weight of the shoe, making it easier and more comfortable to wear for extended periods of time. The shoe was released on February 17th, 2018, at a retail price of $100.

title: Denim Tears The Cotton Wreath Sweatshirt Black
description:
The Denim Tears The Cotton Wreath Sweatshirt Black is part of the Denim Tears clothing line, which was created by Tremaine Emory.

The Cotton Wreath Sweatshirt Blackade is made from 100% premium cotton material and features a hood and front pocket. The sweatshirt features a ribbed crew neckline, cuff, and hem, which provides a snug fit and extra support and comfort. The sleeves of the sweatshirt are relaxed, allowing a range of motion for the wearer. There is a comfortable fleece lining inside the sweatshirt which provides extra insulation and warmth, making it perfect for colder weather conditions.

We think that the notable feature of the Denim Tears The Cotton Wreath Sweatshirt Black is its graphic design of a cotton wreath, which is printed throughout. The geometric graphic is printed with high-quality ink that will not easily fade, crack, or peel off during regular wear and wash. The sweatshirt was released on January 24th, 2023, at a retail price of $210.
primary_title: Denim Tears The Cotton Wreath Sweatshirt

title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B Pale Ivory
model: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B "Pale Ivory" brings effortless style and skate-focused function to a beloved silhouette. Dressed in a refined mix of Pale Ivory and Summit White with Copper Moon accents and black hits, this colorway balances clean neutrals with subtle contrast for versatile wear on and off the board. Premium suede and leather paneling provide a plush handfeel and long-lasting durability, while classic SB details, like the padded, mesh-backed tongue and supportive collar, lock in comfort for all-day sessions. Perforations at the toe help with breathability, and the Swoosh in Copper Moon adds a standout touch that catches light without overpowering the minimalist palette.

Performance is at the core of the Dunk Low Pro B, Style HJ0367-100. A responsive insole with Nike cushioning absorbs impact on landings, and the flexible cupsole delivers excellent boardfeel without sacrificing protection. The grippy rubber outsole, complete with the SB-modified tread pattern, bites into decks and pavement for reliable traction in varied conditions. Reinforced stitching in high-wear zones and a sturdy overlay at the ollie area extend the life of the shoe, while the classic Dunk profile makes it a go-to for streetwear rotation. Whether you’re stacking clips or keeping it casual, this May 31, 2025 release pairs modern comfort with timeless SB heritage.

Our team loves this product because it blends supple materials, dialed-in cushioning, and skate-ready traction with a crisp, everyday colorway that elevates any fit.
primary_title: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B

title: Nike Dunk Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Sequoia
description:
The Nike Dunk Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Sequoia embraces maximal creativity by transforming the Dunk into a bold art piece. The oversized Swamp Sponge textures and all sequoia palette give the shoe a surreal and almost sculptural feel. It is intentionally exaggerated, leaning fully into Cactus Plant Flea Market’s philosophy of play, distortion, and individuality rather than restraint.

Collectors love this pair because it challenges expectations. This is not a subtle Dunk, it is a conversation starter designed for people who appreciate sneakers as wearable art. Fans of CPFM gravitate toward it for its fearlessness, while Dunk collectors value it as a standout moment in the silhouette’s history. It represents freedom in design, where personality takes priority over convention.

The Nike Dunk Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Sequoia was released on September 17, 2025 with a retail price of $155.
secondary_title: Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Sequoia

title: Jordan 1 Low Black White Grey
description:
The Jordan 1 Low White Black Grey features a white leather upper with black overlays and grey Swooshes. From there, Jordan Wings and Jumpman logo embroideries on the heel and tongue complete the design.

The Jordan 1 Low White Black Grey released in the Summer of 2021 and retailed for $90.

title: Crocs Classic Clog Batmobile
description:
Step into the iconic world of Gotham City with the Crocs Classic Clog Batmobile. Featuring a playful yet sleek design, these Crocs celebrate one of the most iconic vehicles in cinematic history—the Batmobile. The predominatley black colorway with yellow accents mirrors the mysterious and bold spirit of Batman, and mimics the classic design of the iconic batmobile. While the lightweight, comfortable construction of the Crocs Classic Clog ensures you’re ready for both everyday adventures and heroic missions.

Inspired by the legendary Batmobile, these clogs stand out with their distinct black base complemented by the striking yellow details. Whether you’re a fan of the Batman movies or just looking for a fun, unique addition to your wardrobe, this design allows you to showcase your love for one of the most beloved superheroes, and make a bold style statement.

The Crocs Classic Clog Batmobile, released on September 16, 2024, retailed for $70, offering comfort and flair in one dynamic package. Whether you’re hitting the street or lounging at home, these clogs let you embody the spirit of the Batmobile in style. Black and yellow have never looked so cool!

title: UGG Tasman Slipper Caspian Burnt Cedar (Women's)
description:
The UGG Tasman Slipper Caspian Burnt Cedar (Women's) decorates the Tasman silhouette in a bold leopard pattern.

The women's Caspian Burnt Cedar–colored UGG Tasman Slipper retains its lightweight design while adding a calf-hair upper. The rough texture of the calf hair creates additional dimension beneath the leopard print, mimicking many traditional moccasin designs. The lightweight outsole is crafted from sugarcane EVA, which has a smaller carbon footprint than petroleum-based foams. Soft wool in Caspian Burnt Cedar lines the inside, while the iconic UGGbraid winds around the collar and the foam footbed adds a pillowy feel underfoot. Like other Tasman models, this version features a slip-on design and a rounded toe. Completing the look, a heat-embossed UGG logo decorates a leather tag sewn into the UGGbraid.

Our experts at StockX appreciate that this shoe is part of Herproject, an initiative that supports women in the workforce. The women’s-size UGG Tasman Slipper Caspian Burnt Cedar (Women's) was released on August 19, 2024, and originally sold for $110.

title: adidas Handball Spezial Navy Gum
description:
The adidas Handball Spezial Navy Gum takes its inspiration from a 1980s handball shoe.

Dressed in a Navy, Sky Blue, White, and Gum color scheme, this sneaker features a nubuck suede upper. Other details include adidas branding on the tongue, the trademark 3-Stripes on the sides, the "Spezial" Trefoil logo on the lateral in gold foil, and a branded OrthoLite insole. This shoe has a round toe and a lace-up closure system with Navy Blue laces that match the overall theme. A gum rubber outsole completes the vintage look.

The adidas Handball Spezial Navy Gum was first released on 26th August 2020, retailing at $100.

title: Jordan 1 Low SE Patent Varsity Red Black
description:
The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Patent Varsity Red Black Womens brings high shine attitude to a timeless color combination. Glossy patent leather defines the upper, giving varsity red and black a bold and confident finish that immediately stands out. White details break up the contrast, keeping the look balanced while letting the material choice carry the visual impact. The low profile shape keeps it sleek and expressive.

This version appeals to fans who enjoy classic Jordan colorways with a fashion forward edge. The patent treatment adds drama and texture, transforming a familiar palette into something more statement driven. Collectors appreciate how the shine shifts the energy of the shoe without altering its core identity, making it feel special while remaining unmistakably Jordan. It is a pair that feels made for nights out as much as everyday rotation.

The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Patent Varsity Red Black Womens was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

title: Nike Air Tech Challenge II Stone Blue (2025)
description:
The Nike Air Tech Challenge II Stone Blue (2025) revives a legendary court silhouette with a refined palette and modern comfort. Dressed in Sail, Stone Blue, Football Grey, Pure Platinum, and Coconut Milk with a pop of Tart, this colorway brings depth and contrast to the shoe’s angular panels and sculpted midsole. The mid-top profile, padded collar, and supportive overlays nod to classic tennis DNA while offering everyday versatility for streetwear. Perforations at the toe box and quarter help with breathability, and the distinctive heel shape delivers that unmistakable Air Tech Challenge II stance that turned heads in the early ’90s. Style code FZ9033-101 and a release date of June 27, 2025, make this pair a standout for collectors and fans of heritage Nike sneakers. 

Underfoot, responsive cushioning and a durable rubber outsole provide the stability and smooth ride the Air Tech Challenge II is known for, making it as wearable as it is collectible. The layered upper highlights the Stone Blue accents against creamy neutrals, creating an elevated look that pairs effortlessly with denim, athletic staples, and tailored casual fits. Subtle textural shifts between leather-like finishes and crisp synthetics give the shoe a premium feel, while the iconic paneling and Swoosh placement ensure instant recognition. Whether you’re revisiting a favorite era or discovering this model for the first time, the Nike Air Tech Challenge II Stone Blue (2025) blends vintage energy with modern styling for a go-to sneaker in any rotation.

Our team thinks this product is great for anyone who wants a heritage Nike icon with versatile colors, reliable cushioning, and standout design details that elevate everyday wear.

title: Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025) (PS)
description:
The Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025) (PS) revives one of the most iconic colorways in a kid-friendly design that blends heritage style with everyday comfort. Dressed in Summit White with speckled Tech Grey accents, bold Black contrasts, and sharp Fire Red hits, this preschool pair mirrors the timeless look that made the Jordan 4 a legend. Smooth leather panels, the signature grid mesh, and classic support wings deliver the unmistakable AJ4 DNA, while the heel tab and Jumpman branding complete the court-inspired aesthetic. A cushioned midsole softens each step, and a durable rubber outsole with a dependable traction pattern keeps little feet steady on playgrounds, gym floors, and beyond.

Built with active kids in mind, the Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025) (PS) balances structure and flexibility for all-day wear. The padded collar and tongue enhance comfort, and the secure lace-up design helps lock in the fit without sacrificing mobility. Speckled "cement" details across the wings and midsole nod to the original look, making this a standout choice for young sneaker fans and style-minded parents alike. Tied to a 2025-05-24 release and marked by style code IB4388-100, this pair offers an easy way to introduce the next generation to a true court classic while keeping outfits fresh for school, weekend outings, and family occasions.

Our team thinks this product is great for young Jordan fans who want iconic style with reliable comfort and durable traction in a preschool-ready package.

title: Jordan 4 Retro University Blue
description:
Jordan Brand paid homage to MJ’s alma mater with the Air Jordan 4 University Blue. The University Blue colorway draws a close resemblance to the extremely rare Air Jordan 4 UNC PE that was given to Tarheel student-athletes in 2019.

The Air Jordan 4 University Blue features a University Blue suede upper with mesh netting on the quarter panel and tongue. Similar to OG Jordan 4 colorways of the past, the eyelets, heel tab, and sections of the midsole are a speckled Cement Grey. Hits of black appear on the wing eyelets, sole, and Jumpman logo on the heel tab. Two woven labels are stitched to the tongue; one being the classic Jumpman woven label; the other being a Team Jordan jock tag. A black, white, and Tech Grey sole with a clear Air unit completes the design.

The Air Jordan 4 University Blue released in April of 2021 and retailed for $200.

title: adidas Samba OG Cream Earth Strata Maroon (Women's)
description:
The adidas Samba OG Cream Earth Strata Maroon Womens brings warmth and richness to one of the most timeless silhouettes in rotation. Cream White lays down a soft neutral base, while Earth Strata overlays deepen the texture and give the upper a grounded feel. Hits of Maroon add just enough contrast to keep the palette interesting without disrupting the Samba classic proportions.

This colorway feels especially considered, blending vintage sport heritage with tones that lean almost collegiate. Fans who have followed the Samba resurgence know that the magic is in these subtle adjustments, where color alone reshapes the personality of the shoe. The maroon detailing gives it a refined edge, making it feel both nostalgic and current, a combination that keeps the Samba at the center of everyday style conversations.

The adidas Samba OG Cream Earth Strata Maroon Womens was released on December 1, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

title: Nike Book 1 Blue Blood
description:
The Nike Book 1 Blue Blood introduces a blue denim vintage-inspired design that nods to Devin Booker’s collegiate team, the Kentucky Wildcats.

The Blue Blood Nike Book 1 boasts a blue denim upper with frayed edges, giving it a raw, deconstructed aesthetic. A tonal Swoosh graces both the lateral and medial sidewalls, with an embroidered white outline highlighting it and more embroidered details, including the number "1" stitched on the lateral rear and a blue mini Swoosh on the vamp. The laces and inner lining are dressed in royal blue accents to match the University of Kentucky uniforms, with the Wildcats logo on the tongue nodding to the "Be True To Your School" Dunks from 1985. Exposed foam padding and the off-white midsole round off the pre-aged aesthetic, and the sneaker rides on a Cushlon 2.0 foam midsole housing an Air Zoom unit.

What our experts love about the Nike Book 1 Blue Blood is its deconstructed aesthetic, which gives the sneaker a raw, vintage-inspired look that makes it stand out. The sneaker released for $140 on April 10th, 2025.

title: Gymshark Onyx 5.0 Seamless T-shirt Black/Onyx Grey
description:
The Gymshark Onyx 5.0 Seamless T Shirt Black Onyx Grey represents the core of Gymshark’s training philosophy, focusing on movement, comfort, and consistency above all else. The Onyx 5.0 line is built for people who actually train, and this short sleeve version keeps things simple with a seamless construction that feels smooth against the skin. The black and onyx grey palette reinforces a clean and disciplined look that fits naturally into any workout environment.

Fans love this piece because it becomes a dependable part of their routine. It stretches without losing shape, breathes during intense sessions, and still looks sharp enough to wear outside the gym. Collectors of Gymshark apparel appreciate how the Onyx range evolves through refinement rather than trend chasing, delivering pieces that feel purposeful and durable. This shirt earns its place through performance and reliability, not hype, which is exactly why it resonates so strongly with long term Gymshark supporters.

The Gymshark Onyx 5.0 Seamless T Shirt Black Onyx Grey was released on May 8, 2025 with a retail price of $50.

title: Nike Romaleos 4 Black White
description:
The Nike Romaleos 4 Black White was made available as part of the brand's commitment to continue producing workout sneakers. Designed for stability and strength, the shoe arrives in a black/black-white colorway.

The Nike Romaleos 4 Black White boasts a broad, flat outsole, which is supported by a midsole. Adjustable straps can be found over the laces stitched at the midfoot to provide added support. Furthermore, the ankle flexion is reduced by the heel-to-toe drop, which appears in kind­ and is required at the lift’s bottom, teaming up with a predictably rigid midsole to enable substantial explosiveness off the ground. The sneaker also features rubber treads to deliver added traction. Designed for high-intensity workouts, the adjustable straps at the midsole ensure total lockdown by providing a firm fit. Also, it ensures comfort during training.

The Nike Romaleos 4 Black White was released at a retail price of $200 on April 1st, 2020.

title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Bleached Coral
description:
Following the classic Black Toe theme, the Air Jordan 1 High OG Bleached Coral features a smooth white leather upper with black overlays and light grey Durabuck heel wraps. Tradition Nike woven tongue labels and Jordan Wings Logos on the collars add a retro feel. From there, a white and light grey Air sole completes the design.

The Air Jordan 1 High OG Bleached Coral releases in July of 2022 and retails for $180.

title: Versace Irregular Biggie Sunglasses Black/Black (VE4361)
description:
The Versace Irregular Biggie Sunglasses, Black/Black (VE4361), are versatile and suitable for either gender. Their black frame gives them even more neutrality and will look good when worn with various looks. Oversized and in an unusual shape, these sunglasses have an edgy, urban, and youthful style.

They are constructed of acetate, a high-quality, sturdy, and durable plastic. These sunglasses are made with dark gray lenses and protect your eyes on sunny and cloudy days. These medium-size sunglasses have an eye size of 53, a bridge width of 18mm, and an average temple size.

Our team likes the thickness of the eyeglass frames on the Versace Irregular Biggie Sunglasses, Black/Black (VE4361). We are also enthused with the black/gold color combination and the placement of the gold Medusa Medallion on the temples. The Medusa Medallion is the official Versace logo. When they were released, the original retail price was $345.

title: Nike Dunk Low UNC (GS)
description:
Dressed in all leather in a classic two-tone color block, this Nike Dunk Low UNC 2021 with Grade School sizing (GS) is available in Grade School size. The upper on the Nike Dunk Low UNC 2021 (GS) is crafted from smooth white leather, with perforations on the toe box to increase airflow around the foot. The shoe's white base is contrasted by University Blue overlays; University Blue is also the color used on the Swoosh, heel, and heel tag, where the Nike brand name is embroidered in white. "Nike" also appears in University Blue on the lightly padded tongue. The sneaker is completed by a white rubber midsole undergirded by a University Blue outsole.

The Nike Dunk Low UNC 2021 (GS) was released in June, 2021, at a retail price of $85.

title: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Barons
description:
The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Barons is a commemorative sneaker that celebrates the 30th anniversary of Michael Jordan’s time with the Birmingham Barons, a Double-A affiliate team of the Chicago White Sox.

The low-top Barons Jordan 1 Retro Low OG boasts a leather upper in white, black, and Wolf Gray, a colorway that pays tribute to the baseball team’s colors. While the base comes in white, Wolf Gray overlays provide subtle color blocking. Small perforations on the vamp and the mesh material of the tongue allow the foot to breathe, even though the upper is constructed entirely from smooth leather. The flat tongue displays a woven tag with ‘NIKE AIR’ lettering in Wolf Gray, while the Air Jordan Wings can be found on the heel tab.

Our experts at StockX like the way the black accents on the laces, the Swoosh logos, and the leather heel tab contrast the Wolf Gray and white across the upper. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Barons was released on July 20, 2024, and sold for $140.

title: Nike NOCTA Glide Drake White Black
description:
The Nike NOCTA Glide Drake White Black blends performance inspired structure with Drake’s understated approach to design. The Glide silhouette feels streamlined and futuristic, while the white and black palette keeps the look clean and versatile. Subtle gold accents add depth without overwhelming the design, giving the shoe a composed and confident presence that fits naturally into modern lifestyle wear.

Fans love this release because it reflects Drake’s design philosophy of refinement over noise. The NOCTA Glide feels intentional and wearable, appealing to people who want sneakers that feel premium without relying on flash. Collectors appreciate how the collaboration balances performance cues with everyday style, making the shoe feel relevant across settings rather than locked into a single use or moment.

The Nike NOCTA Glide Drake White Black was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

title: adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball Carbon
model: adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball
description:
For the adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball Carbon, designer Jerry Lorenzo's luxury fashion brand Fear of God and the iconic German sneaker company collaborated to create a basketball shoe with style that pops.

The Carbon iteration of the Fear of God x adidas Basketball sneaker features a base of premium black knit with a tonal neoprene collar on an upper on unrelieved black-on-black. The signature adidas side-panel three stripes appear as a TPU molded cage overlay that adds support to this shoe. A black bungee on the ankle adds flexibility and comfort. The tongue, laces, sock liner, and insole are also black. An embossed adidas logo graces the toe of the upper, while a black bar is adorned with the Fear of God logo at the heel.

One of the most impressive aspects of this sneaker is the sole unit that provides cushioning, support, and grip. A thick, white midsole composed of Lightstrike rests on a white rubber outsole with a herringbone traction pattern. The adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball Carbon was launched on December 3, 2023, for $250 retail.
primary_title: adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball

title: Jordan 6 Retro DMP (2020)
description:
Please note: Due to the manufacturing packaging, pairs may show slight scuffing on the heel tab. Jordan Brand brings back another popular release with the Jordan 6 DMP (2020), now available on StockX. The original Defining Moments Package debuted in 2006 as a tribute to Michael Jordan’s pair of three-peat championships in the 1990’s with the Chicago Bulls. This Jordan 6 colorway was included in the package alongside an Air Jordan 11 in a similar colorway. This is the first time that these sneakers have been retroed.

This Jordan 6 DMP is composed of a black nubuck suede upper with gold detailing. A gold dog tag styled hang tag, translucent outsole, and Jumpman heel embroidery completes the design. These sneakers released in January of 2020 and retailed for $200.

title: Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG Kobe Bryant Phantom Black
description:
The Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG Kobe Bryant Phantom Black translates Kobe Bryant’s legacy into elite level football performance through a design that feels focused and uncompromising. The Phantom 6 Low silhouette is built for precision and control, and the all black execution reinforces a mentality of discipline and intent. It feels serious and purposeful, allowing performance innovation to take priority over flash or excess branding.

Fans and collectors value this release because it honors Kobe through mindset rather than symbolism alone. The Phantom Black colorway reflects his approach to mastery and preparation, making the boot feel emotionally resonant while remaining technically elite. It stands as a crossover tribute that connects Kobe’s legacy to another sport defined by control, intelligence, and relentless pursuit of excellence.

The Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG Kobe Bryant Phantom Black was released on December 15, 2025 with a retail price of $305.

title: Nike Air Max 90 Black Green Strike
Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro QS Kobe Bryant Lakers Home
model: Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro QS
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro QS Kobe Bryant Lakers Home takes inspiration from a pivotal moment in basketball history—the 2002-2003 NBA season, when Kobe Bryant made waves during his sneaker free agency. Paying homage to the Black Mamba’s legendary career with the Lakers, this edition showcases a classic white leather upper accented with varsity maize and varsity purple details, reminiscent of the Lakers’ iconic home jersey. The addition of Bryant's jersey number and the Kobe logo stitched on the heel solidifies its place as a collector’s piece.

This sneaker balances nostalgia with premium design. Every element, from the debossed Kobe logo on the outer heel to the clean yet bold colorway, exudes sophistication and style. The versatility of this color palette makes it a statement both on and off the court. Whether you're a lifelong Lakers fan or just appreciate the legacy of Kobe Bryant, this pair delivers a meaningful blend of history and sneaker culture.

Released on December 6, 2024, at a retail price of $130, the Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro QS Kobe Bryant Lakers Home is more than just a sneaker—it’s a celebration of basketball heritage. Featuring white, varsity maize, and varsity purple hues, this limited edition is a must-have.
primary_title: Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro QS

title: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Family Reunion Seongsu
Jordan 5 Retro Medium Soft Pink (PS)
description: The Jordan 5 Retro Medium Soft Pink (PS) scales down the iconic basketball shoe for pre-school sizes in a pastel-themed colorway. The shoe features White, Medium Soft Pink, and Black. The design retains the signature details of the Jordan 5, including the molded collar, lace locks, and mesh side panels. The combination of White leather and soft Medium Soft Pink accents provides a light, playful take on the aggressive silhouette. This edition is set for release on October 11, 2025, with a retail price of $105. The crisp White upper is accented gently by the Medium Soft Pink on the midsole details and inner lining, with small touches of Black providing minimal contrast. This shoe successfully translates the aggressive, high-performance look of the Jordan 5 into a fun, accessible size. Our team finds the classic profile of the Jordan 5 beautifully softened by the application of White and delicate Medium Soft Pink, offering high style in a durable pre-school format.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Flyknit 2 White Pure Platinum
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Flyknit 2 White Pure Platinum features a white and Pure Platinum Flyknit and nubuck upper. From there, nubuck on the eyestays and logo and "Ultra" construction on the white midsole complete the design.

The Nike Air Force 1 Flyknit 2 White Pure Platinum released in May of 2019 and retailed for $110.

title: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 QS Boucle Desert Moss Fierce Pink
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 QS Boucle Desert Moss Fierce Pink delivers textured contrast through bold material choice and vibrant accenting. Desert moss and baroque brown create an earthy foundation, while fierce pink and midwest gold details inject high energy contrast. The boucle fabric adds depth and dimension, transforming the familiar silhouette into something tactile and expressive.

Fans appreciate this release because quick strike editions often experiment with unexpected textures and palettes. The mix of moss and pink feels daring yet cohesive, offering a standout look that still respects the Air Force 1’s proportions. Collectors value how the design pushes beyond standard leather builds into more layered material storytelling. It stands as a statement driven iteration that merges heritage form with bold texture and color innovation.

The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 QS Boucle Desert Moss Fierce Pink was released on December 19, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

title: Salomon XT-6 Vanilla Ice Almond Milk
description:
The Salomon XT-6 Vanilla Ice Almond Milk is a high-octane sneaker fit for challenging speed hikes over trails of various terrain. These sneakers also offer style and panache with every step.

This rough and ready trail shoe begins with an upper base made of a single layer of mesh in Creamy White. TPU film in Creamy White and beige runs over the upper, adding both style and structural support. The toecap and heel are especially fortified. A Quicklace lacing system offers one-pull tightening for a secure fit. Dual-density EVA cushioning in beige and cream creates a midsole to offer springy comfort over rugged terrain. The downhill chassis construction and the lugs geometry of the white rubber outsole complete the look and capability of this shoe.

The detail we enjoy most about this Creamy White sneaker is the multicolored Salomon branding tag that runs down the tongue, adding signature brightness. The Salomon XT-6 Vanilla Ice Almond Milk was released on February 1, 2024, for $200 retail.

title: Anta Kai 2 Triple Black
description:
The Anta Kai 2 Triple Black brings a sleek and disciplined look to Kyrie Irving’s Anta signature line, leaning fully into performance driven minimalism. The all black execution strips the Kai 2 down to pure form, emphasizing shape, structure, and intent without distraction. It feels focused and serious, reflecting Kyrie’s precision oriented approach to the game and his preference for footwear that performs without excess noise.

Collectors are drawn to this release because it highlights Anta’s growing confidence in design. The Kai 2 silhouette feels modern and controlled, and the triple black palette makes it adaptable both on court and off. Fans appreciate how the shoe feels purposeful and grounded, offering a signature model that communicates control, balance, and intensity rather than flash, making it a favorite for those who value subtle dominance in basketball footwear.

The Anta Kai 2 Triple Black was released on May 31, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

title: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Border
description:
The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Border revisits the original spirit of the Air Max 95 by restoring the larger visible Air units and pairing them with crisp contrast. The black border framing the white and jade elements gives the shoe a sharp and graphic look that highlights the iconic sole design. The Big Bubble execution brings the silhouette closer to its earliest form, emphasizing innovation and visibility in a way longtime fans immediately recognize.

Collectors love this release because it feels archival and intentional. The Air Max 95 has always been about pushing boundaries in cushioning and form, and the Big Bubble detail reinforces that legacy. Fans appreciate how the black border sharpens the overall look, making the shoe feel bold but still classic. It stands as a celebration of Nike’s willingness to honor its design history while delivering something that feels fresh and exciting on foot.

The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Border was released on November 26, 2025 with a retail price of $190.
